Job Description:

Own your opportunity to turn data into measurable outcomes for our customers’ most complex challenges. As a Data Scientist Principal at GDIT, you’ll power innovation to drive mission impact and grow your expertise to power your career forward.

This role exists to turn a multi-billion-record, multi-payer healthcare claims warehouse, the Healthcare Fraud Prevention Partnership (HFPP) Trusted Third Party (TTP), into fraud, waste, and abuse (FWA) findings trusted enough for Partners and investigators to act on.

The team's models and tooling increasingly depend on machine learning and generative AI, and this is the role that owns what "trustworthy" means for both. Roughly half your time goes to building models, the other half to setting the standards the rest of the Data Science team builds against. This is a senior individual-contributor role with no direct reports.

HOW A DATA SCIENTIST PRINCIPAL WILL MAKE AN IMPACT:

  • Set the modeling and validation standards the Data Science team works against; how models get documented, monitored, and checked for drift and bias. You'll review the team's models against that bar before they go to production and recommend what must change first.

  • Write and maintain the program's responsible-AI and GenAI policy. The harder half is generative AI inside the FWA pipeline itself, like case narrative summarization or investigator-facing drafts, where a weak output lands in front of an investigator. Internal tooling such as code assistants needs a policy too, and it's the easier one to write.

  • Build and ship FWA models yourself. Supervised risk scoring against the claims warehouse, feature engineering at claim-record scale, and validation under heavy class imbalance and fraud schemes that shift faster than confirmation arrives.

  • Walk HFPP Partners and internal auditors through how a given model or AI-assisted step works, including validation results and controls. Expect to defend methodology choices to people whose job is finding the gaps in them.

  • Decide what's worth piloting as generative AI capability shifts and say no to what isn't ready for a healthcare FWA context yet.

  • Work across a multi-disciplinary team of Data Scientists, BI Developers, and FWA Subject Matter Experts (100% remote, distributed across the US). Governance questions come to you regardless of which sub-team raised them.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO SUCCEED:

  • Master's degree in a quantitative field (statistics, computer science, engineering, applied mathematics, economics, or related), or a Bachelor's in one of those fields with equivalent hands-on experience.

  • 8+ years building, validating, and deploying ML models on real-world data, including a track record of setting technical standards that other data scientists work against.

  • Working knowledge of responsible-AI and model-risk practice: documentation, monitoring, bias and drift detection, and what production-ready governance looks like for a model whose output drives decisions about providers.

  • Experience evaluating generative AI and LLM use cases for both feasibility and risk, including cases where your answer was that an LLM shouldn't be used yet.

  • Competence in Python and SQL, including feature engineering inside a data warehouse at very large scale.

  • 2+ years working with healthcare claims data (Medicare, Medicaid, or commercial), plus working knowledge of medical terminology and healthcare coding systems (ICD-10, CPT, HCPCS, DRG).

  • Experience presenting technical and governance decisions to clients, partners, or auditors. You should be able to defend a methodology choice to a technical reviewer and explain that same decision to someone who isn't one.

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Prior experience in a formal model-risk or responsible-AI role, even outside healthcare.

  • Graph or network analytics, entity resolution, or record linkage.

  • Experience piloting generative AI tools in a regulated or high-scrutiny setting.

  • AWS and/or Snowflake environments, including Snowpark or model lifecycle tooling.

  • Experience with payer coverage policy (LCDs, NCDs, private carrier policies) and industry claim edits (NCCI).

GDIT IS YOUR PLACE:

At GDIT, the mission is our purpose, and our people are at the center of everything we do.

  • Growth: AI-powered career tool that identifies career steps and learning opportunities.
  • Support: An internal mobility team focused on helping you achieve your career goals.
  • Rewards: Comprehensive benefits and wellness packages, 401K with company match, and competitive pay and paid time off.
  • Flexibility: Full-flex work week to own your priorities at work and at home.
  • Community: Award-winning culture of innovation and a military-friendly workplace.

OWN YOUR OPPORTUNITY

Explore a career in data science and engineering at GDIT and you’ll find endless opportunities to grow alongside colleagues who share your determination for solving complex data challenges.

Our benefits package for all US-based employees includes a variety of medical plan options, some with Health Savings Accounts, dental plan options, a vision plan, and a 401(k) plan offering the ability to contribute both pre and post-tax dollars up to the IRS annual limits and receive a company match. To encourage work/life balance, GDIT offers employees full flex work weeks where possible and a variety of paid time off plans, including vacation, sick and personal time, holidays, paid parental, military, bereavement and jury duty leave. GDIT typically provides new employees with 15 days of paid leave per calendar year to be used for vacations, personal business, and illness and an additional 10 paid holidays per year. Paid leave and paid holidays are prorated based on the employee’s date of hire. The GDIT Paid Family Leave program provides a total of up to 160 hours of paid leave in a rolling 12 month period for eligible employees. To ensure our employees are able to protect their income, other offerings such as short and long-term disability benefits, life, accidental death and dismemberment, personal accident, critical illness and business travel and accident insurance are provided or available. jobs.description:
Hi, thanks for checking out our job board!
If you're an entrepreneurial-minded builder who loves to work with great people to solve wicked problems that have a meaningful impact, read on to see if this position might be a good fit for you!
THE COMPANY
Blended Technologies is bringing modern SaaS to the wine industry. Our products will give winemakers the tools to manage all aspects of the winemaking process from grape to bottle, and will allow winery owners to optimize their business with tailored workflows, inventory tracking, tasting room management, direct-to-consumer sales, and CRM. We help owners and winemakers spend less time on tax and compliance paperwork and more time making great wine and keeping customers happy.
We are a fully-funded seed-stage startup rounding out our initial engineering team that is conceiving, designing, building, and bringing our product to market. We are offering competitive salary and benefits as well as single-digit-employee-number equity.
THE ROLE
Being one of the first engineering hires at a startup is a special thing – you’ll never have a greater impact, you’ll never have more opportunity, you’ll never get a bigger piece of the pie, and you’ll never have more fun. This position reports directly to an experienced CTO with decades of experience at Google, Netflix, Apple, Twilio and other tech-focused companies.
We’re looking for a senior frontend engineer to help design and build our service from the ground up. You should have built big things before, have opinions about what works and what doesn’t, and can work independently on even bigger things. There isn’t always going to be a clear map that explains how to get where we want to go, so you should be comfortable trying to understand our customer needs really well, be given some UI sketches, a data schema, and coworkers to collaborate with, and be excited to figure out the rest from there.

What We're Looking For:

  • 5+ years of experience at 2-3+ tech-focused companies
  • Expert knowledge of React/TypeScript
  • Expert knowledge of HTML/CSS
  • Solid grasp of UX design fundamentals and the ability to translate an idea into reasonable basic UI

The more experience with any/all of these, the better:

  • GraphQL
  • Chakra or another UI component toolkit
  • React Native
  • Solid knowledge of HTTP protocol
  • Even more UX design skills than mentioned above
  • Writing GraphQL resolvers on the backend
  • MongoDB
  • AWS Cognito/Lambda/DocumentDB/API Gateway/CloudFormation
  • Writing good technical documentation
  • Working knowledge of managed cloud-service software development, esp. AWS
  • Working knowledge of building software in containerized deployments, with full CI/CD
  • A passion for leading and mentoring engineers
  • A desire to work directly with customers (winemaker customer visits are pretty great)

About Zero21

As recruiters helping to build the next generation of industry disruptors, we are committed to expanding the startup ecosystem so that exceptional talent from diverse communities can gain greater access to more early stage companies.
We work only with equal opportunity employers who welcome candidates from underrepresented, underestimated, and traditionally overlooked communities to further diversity, equity, and inclusion in the next cohort of industry-disrupting unicorns.
To all recruitment agencies: Zero21 does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias or our team members. Zero21 is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Account Executive

Cupix, a leader in 3D virtualization and digital twin technology for the AEC / Construction market has an immediate opening for an Account Executive to join our rapidly growing Sales Team. Cupix’s cloud-based software platform and mobile capture app create the easiest possible way of generating 3D digital twins of physical spaces, providing spatial intelligence to remote teams and facilitating actionable insights. Our products digitally disrupt several industries, including real estate brokerage, architecture design, construction, and facility management.

In this role, you’ll be responsible for owning a regional territory and applying an understanding of Cupix’s products, sales methodology, processes, qualification techniques, and customer base while selling to strategic account with a focus on companies that can benefit our world class 3D digital twin software for the construction, architecture design, BIM/VDC, and facility management industries. The primary function of this position is to acquire new accounts and upsell or cross-sell leveraging existing accounts in your target territory.

You'll work closely with both the global sales team and your local territory team, reporting to the VP of Sales.

To be successful in this role, you’ll perform the following:

  • Working from your virtual office, develop a deep understanding of Cupix’s products, value proposition, competitive advantages, and industries served, with a demonstrated ability to explain technical concepts and technology to a variety of audiences.
  • Develop sales plans for territory development to build rapport and create and win opportunities.
  • Network within your assigned territory / region, and travel as needed to customer sites.
  • Provide sales management with reports on sales activities and projects as requested forecasts.
  • Manage and maintain accurate contacts, accounts, and opportunity information within our CRM system (Salesforce).
  • Achieve or exceed monthly and quarterly targets
  • Obtain repeat business, referrals, and references by applying the understanding of the unique requirements of your customers
  • Approach all deals with a customer-focused mentality and a long-term consultative approach.
    Collaborate cross-functionally with key internal partners such as BDR, Customer Success, Product, Marketing, Accounting, and Legal.

Your Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience
  • 3+ years of demonstrated successful software sales, preferably with B2B software companies focusing on architectural design, construction, facility management, or the 3D reality capture industry
  • Ability to develop trusted relationships
  • Experience at a high-growth startup is a plus
  • Proven ability to develop and manage pipeline and forecasting
  • Experience with CRM systems
  • Highly organized, with strong attention to detail
  • Analytically driven with the ability to understand the difference between interesting and actionable data
  • Collaborative team player and self-starter
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities at the same time
  • Growth mindset - desire to continue to improve, simplify, scale new and existing processes, and professional growth

Cupix is a VC-backed fast-growing startup providing machine-vision based, end-to-end, SaaS products that can transform 360 photos taken by off-the-shelf 360 cameras to a virtual 3D space. Our products are being used by tens of thousands of users, including professional photographers, real-estate brokers, construction jobsite managers, and facility security officers worldwide. We have three offices in the Silicon Valley bay area, Dallas, TX, and Seoul, Korea.

The Company has signed thousands of contracts with Fortune Global 100, Fortune 500, midmarket, public sector and government organizations who selected Rimini Street as their trusted, proven mission-critical enterprise software solutions provider and achieved better operational outcomes, realized billions of US dollars in savings and funded AI and other innovation investments.

We are actively seeking a talented and experienced Sr. Support Engineer specializing in SAP FICO- 100% Remote Mexico to join our dynamic team. The Sr. Support Engineer will report directly to the Regional Manager, SAP Delivery.

Position Summary

Rimini Street is seeking a Sr. Support Engineer, SAP FICO with deep expertise in Controlling (CO), particularly Product Costing and Material Ledger, to support complex, global SAP environments.

This role is part of our global support team and is responsible for delivering hands-on troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and client-facing support for mission-critical SAP applications. The ideal candidate combines strong functional and technical capabilities and thrives in diagnosing and resolving complex financial and controlling issues in live production systems.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Provide expert-level support for SAP FICO, with strong emphasis on:

    • Product Costing (CO-PC)

    • Material Ledger

    • Cost Center and Profit Center Accounting

    • Month-end close and controlling processes

    • Costing and variance analysis

    • Cross-module integrations (FI, MM, SD, PS)

  • Perform root cause analysis in highly customized SAP environments

  • Support SAP Project Systems (PS), including:

    • WBS structures

    • Project cost integration

  • Work directly with clients to:

    • Provide clear, actionable solutions

  • Support global customers in a 24x7 support model, ensuring SLA adherence

    • Product Costing (CO-PC)

    • Material Ledger

  • Proven experience troubleshooting:

    • Month-end close issues

    • Costing variances and settlement processes

  • Strong understanding of:

    • CO-FI integration

    • Cross-functional processes (MM, SD, PS)

  • Hands-on experience with SAP Project Systems (PS) configuration

  • Experience working in production support environments

  • Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills, including ability to debug complex issues

  • Ability to communicate clearly with both technical and business stakeholders

  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and in a global, virtual team environment

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with SAP S/4HANA

  • Exposure to:

    • FSCM / Treasury

    • Asset Accounting (with understanding of financial impact)

  • ABAP debugging or strong collaboration with development teams

  • Experience in global or multi-country SAP environments

Profile We Are Targeting

  • Hands-on problem solver, not just an implementation lead or architect

  • Strong experience in support environments, not only project delivery

  • Comfortable working in complex, highly customized SAP landscapes

  • Able to own issues end-to-end

  • Strong client-facing presence, with clear and structured communication

  • Proactive, solution-oriented, and customer-focused

Location

Remote - Mexico

Why Rimini Street?

We are looking for talented, passionate people to help us build our future at Rimini Street. We hire only the best, the most extraordinary professionals and provide compensation, bonuses, and benefits to match the skills of our top-performing team members. Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy growing together, and get excited about learning new skills? Are you looking for an opportunity to make a true impact as part of a team of extraordinary professionals? This is the place for you.

Our work is challenging and meaningful. We start and end each day with a sense of achievement and purpose guided by our core values, the Four Cs:

  • Company

    • We dream big and innovate boldly.

  • Colleagues

    • We believe in leaving the world a better place than we found it. With the Rimini Street Foundation, we’ve made positive impacts in six continents for over 425 charities.

Accelerating Company Growth

  • Nasdaq-listed under ticker symbol RMNI since October 2017

jobs.excerpt: ROLE SUMMARYThe Field Medical Outcomes (FMO) Business Unit Lead is responsible for the leadership, execution, and coordination of an FMO business unit spanning multiple therapeutic areas.
jobs.description:
ROLE SUMMARY

The Field Medical Outcomes (FMO) Business Unit Lead is responsible for the leadership, execution, and coordination of an FMO business unit spanning multiple therapeutic areas. As a leader of leaders, this role manages and develops a team of FMO Team Leaders, ensuring alignment of people, priorities, and resources with U.S. Medical Affairs strategies and business unit objectives. The FMO Business Unit Lead partners cross-functionally with U.S. Medical Affairs, Global Medical Affairs, Payer Account Medical, Medical Outcomes & Analytics, Commercial leadership, and FMO and Medical Affairs leaders to develop and execute customer-centric medical strategies that support business unit goals while ensuring compliance with Pfizer and external policies, guidelines, and regulations.

As a member of the FMO Lead Leadership Team, the FMO Business Unit Lead helps shape the vision, strategic direction, and implementation of cross-functional customer engagement across the business unit. The role has direct people management responsibility for FMO Team Leaders whose teams deliver medical outcomes support through health care economic information (HCEI), real-world evidence (RWE), population health insights, customer collaborations, evidence generation activities, and data-driven approaches that address the needs of organized customers and healthcare decision-makers. The role also partners with Commercial Group Leads to align FMO activities with business priorities while maintaining appropriate medical governance, compliance, and reporting standards.

ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

Personnel Management

  • Lead, manage, develop, and coach Field Medical Outcomes Team Leaders across the business unit spanning multiple therapeutic areas.
  • Guide work prioritization and resource allocation across Team Leaders and authorize team-related expenditures, including travel, training, supplies, and other business expenses.
  • Ensure appropriate colleague deployment and account prioritization based on business unit priorities.
  • Retain key talent within the FMO organization and contribute to the identification, selection, and development of Team Leaders and colleagues.
  • Develop and maintain a high-performing culture across the leadership team and broader FMO organization.
  • Manage performance reviews, salary planning, promotions, colleague development, retention, engagement, and conflict resolution in partnership with People Experience.
  • Conduct supervisory field days with colleagues to support development, coaching, and alignment across the business unit.

Strategy and Business Planning

  • Help shape and execute medical plans aligned with U.S. Medical Affairs strategies and objectives across the business unit's therapeutic areas.
  • Drive strategic planning activities for the assigned business unit.
  • Ensure alignment with the medical content approval process and timely approval of medical content in accordance with Pfizer policies and SOPs.
  • Integrate customer insights into national tools, resources, programs, and strategic initiatives through cross-functional and cross-business-unit collaboration.
  • Represent the Field Medical Outcomes Lead on teams across Pfizer U.S., Global, and other business units to support Field Medical Governance and strategic initiatives.
  • Serve in leadership roles on internal workstreams and committees where strategic decisions are developed and executed.
  • Collaborate compliantly with HQ Medical Affairs, FMO leaders and colleagues, Medical Affairs colleagues, and Commercial partners to shape and implement customer-centric medical strategies.
  • Partner with Commercial Group Leads to align FMO activities, resource planning, reporting, and operational priorities across the business unit while maintaining appropriate medical governance and compliance standards.

Operational Management

  • Maintain current knowledge of FDA regulations and other requirements impacting interactions with healthcare professionals and organized customers.
  • Anticipate, adopt, and lead teams in effectively leveraging evolving digital capabilities that enhance medical communications and customer engagement.
  • Champion the adoption of innovative technologies, digital solutions, and AI-enabled capabilities that enhance team efficiency, customer engagement, and data-informed decision-making.
  • Lead adaptation to changes in the regional and national healthcare landscape.
  • Maintain strong market and customer knowledge and stay informed on scientific and medical literature relevant to the business unit's therapeutic areas.
  • Maintain compliance with all applicable Pfizer SOPs, policies, and guidance documents.
  • Ensure Field Medical Outcomes Team Leaders' activities are conducted and documented in compliance with internal and external policies, guidelines, and regulations and that required training is completed on time.
  • Ensure direct reports and their teams provide objective, scientifically sound medical information regarding Pfizer products and disease states using pharmacoeconomic models, outcomes tools, and data analytics.
  • Participate in budget planning activities with the Field Medical Outcomes Lead.
  • Manage and oversee administrative and project management support resources across the business unit.
  • Ensure effective, compliant communication and collaboration among HQ Medical Affairs, FMO leaders and colleagues, Commercial partners, and other cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with the Medical Governance team to support organizational priorities and compliance.
  • Demonstrate accountability and decision-making with alliance partners and external collaborators that impact the broader organization.
  • Effectively communicate and advocate for the value of FMO colleagues with internal and external stakeholders.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

Education / Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in a health science required.
  • PharmD, PhD, or equivalent terminal doctoral degree (e.g., Doctor of Nursing Practice, Doctor of Physical Therapy) highly preferred.
  • 12+ years of relevant experience required with a Bachelor's degree, 10+ years of relevant experience with an MBA/MS, or 7+ years of relevant experience with a PharmD, PhD, JD, or equivalent terminal doctoral degree.
  • Previous Pfizer or other relevant FMO management experience as a direct line manager required.
  • Significant demonstrated leadership skills in a matrixed environment required.

Skills

  • Demonstrate a breadth of diverse leadership experiences and capabilities, including the ability to influence and collaborate with peers, develop and coach others, oversee and guide the work of colleagues to achieve meaningful outcomes, and create business impact.
  • Demonstrated ability to inspire field medical professionals around a compelling vision for success, embodying Pfizer's Core Values of Equity, Courage, Joy, and Excellence.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills, with strong self-awareness.
  • Demonstrated leadership skills with the ability to inspire, motivate, develop, and lead a team in a complex, changing environment focused on generating a positive medical customer experience.
  • Strong strategic, analytical, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability and interest to manage and lead a diverse team of geographically dispersed Team Leaders and professionals across the U.S.
  • Ability to work independently, demonstrating flexibility and organizational awareness, and adapting to changes within short timeframes.
  • Decisive, with the ability to exercise good judgment; organized and able to prioritize a significant volume of projects and a large workload.
  • Ability to manage resources, programs, and multiple projects developed in a remote environment while demonstrating excellent judgment in a continuous improvement environment.
  • Rapidly adopt and utilize new digital technology and other resources with medical customers and record medical interactions (e.g., iPad, OneMed, Teams, on-demand video-conferencing).
  • Work within a matrixed, multi-disciplinary team to foster strong Pfizer/customer professional relationships aligned with Pfizer Medical objectives.
  • Effectively manage through and lead change in an evolving external healthcare environment; demonstrate change agility and flexibility to new opportunities (e.g., new therapeutic areas) and organizational change.
  • Problem-solve and network enterprise-wide as appropriate to identify solutions.
  • Maintain self-awareness and continually choose behaviors and responses based on their impact on one's own and others' performance and engagement.
  • Be a self-starter, accountable, with a sense of urgency in delivering results that have medical impact and yield a positive customer experience.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Familiarity with internal/external SOPs, rules, and regulations governing Pfizer/customer interactions and relationships.
  • Expertise or experience within the business unit's designated therapeutic area(s) is highly desirable.
  • Previous FMO experience or broader Field Medical experience.

Other Job Details:

Last Date to Apply for Job: October 11th, 2026

Additional Location Information: US - remote

Eligible for Relocation Package: No

The annual base salary for this position ranges from $254,100.00 to $423,500.00. In addition, this position is eligible for participation in Pfizer’s Global Performance Plan with a bonus target of 25.0% of the base salary and eligibility to participate in our share based long term incentive program. We offer comprehensive and generous benefits and programs to help our colleagues lead healthy lives and to support each of life’s moments. Benefits offered include a 401(k) plan with Pfizer Matching Contributions and an additional Pfizer Retirement Savings Contribution, paid vacation, holiday and personal days, paid caregiver/parental and medical leave, and health benefits to include medical, prescription drug, dental and vision coverage. Named after a Robert Heinlein story about a company that specialized in solving impossible problems, We Also Walk Dogs has spent over a decade serving online progressive organizations and charities. We're a small, friendly, and clever company. And we all work remotely.

Is this the job for you?

  • Do you keep production systems running? According to our external monitoring, we've kept 99.98% uptime this past year, and gone three months without downtime, while very actively working on the product. We need someone with the expertise and discipline to help us keep that going.
  • Do you think in the cloud? After starting with a fully on-premises deployment, today we're serving millions of end-users from AWS. But we know that intelligently deploying new tools and cloud capabilities can help us do things we could never do with just a rack of servers, and we need a DevOps engineer who can take us there.
  • Can you can wear a lot of hats? We're a small company and not much for bureaucratic divisions. The boss codes; the project manager gives sales demos; most everyone, including you, does a shift of at least a few hours each week answering our clients' support tickets.

If this sounds like you, please apply!

Must haves:

  • You need to care about maintaining a high-quality deployment. We've kept our uptime record with solid automation and monitoring, jumping on oddities before they become problems, and digging into root causes when things go wrong. We need you to be able to continue that tradition.
  • You need vision as well as execution. We need you to not only keep things running smoothly, but also help lead us where we need to go next. You need expertise in modern tools and AWS capabilities, and a strategic sense of how we can use them for efficiency, manageability, performance, and reliability.
  • You need to be in touch with others' needs. We're a small, tight-knit crew where everyone pitches in. Empathy with clients and end-users is also core to our business. Everyone on the team works directly with clients.

Nice to haves:

  • Experience working with all-remote teams.
  • Experience with Django, MySQL, and Ansible.
  • Experience with AWS features and patterns like VPCs, ELBs, SQS, auto-scaling groups, multi-zone deployments, and so on.
  • That said, experience with our stack is maybe the least important factor here; Even if you've used Rails instead of Django, Postgres instead of MySQL, or Azure instead of AWS, we want to hear from you.

Why work for us?

  • Competitive salary. We are a self-funded, for-profit company.
  • Remote work. Hours and location are flexible as long as you get the work done. In this day and age you shouldn't have to relocate to San Francisco for awesome work.
  • Four weeks paid time off. We encourage you to take vacation; we are not the sort of workplace that pressures anyone into 60-hour weeks.
  • A free, great health insurance policy and 401(k)
  • Work with an awesome team for awesome causes.

About Us

Since 1989, SHI International Corp. has helped organizations change the world through technology. We’ve grown every year since, and today we’re proud to be a $16 billion global provider of IT solutions and services.

Job Summary

The Senior Director, Data & AI leads SHI's AI + Infrastructure organization within the Microsoft Services Practice. This leader brings together Agentic Solutions, Cloud Platform, Data & Intelligence, and AI Security & Governance to build and deliver connected Microsoft solutions across Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Microsoft Foundry, agents, data platforms, and the security and governance capabilities required to operate them responsibly.

The Senior Director runs the organization as a business, with ownership of service maturity, solution development, headcount planning, utilization, delivery quality, capacity, pipeline support, and measurable client outcomes. This role leads managers and practice leaders responsible for Agentic Solutions, Cloud Platform, Data & Intelligence, and AI Security & Governance and remains accountable for their effectiveness, development, and delivery performance.

Aligned to Microsoft's Fabric IQ and Foundry IQ investments, this role connects cloud foundation, business data, enterprise knowledge, agentic experiences, and trust. The Senior Director helps SHI move clients from isolated pilots to secure, governed, production-ready platforms and solutions while creating repeatable paths for growth.

This role sits at the center of SHI's Microsoft Services growth plan, turning Fabric IQ and Foundry IQ alignment into a working operating model that builds stronger solutions, improves delivery execution, develops talent, and creates repeatable paths for growth.

This is a remote position with a Home Office setup based in New York City, Charlotte, Chicago, Atlanta, Austin, Denver, Los Angeles, San Francisco, or Seattle.

Role Description

​

Strategic Leadership and Practice Development

  • Set and execute a unified direction for AI + Infrastructure, connecting Agentic Solutions, Cloud Platform, Data & Intelligence, and AI Security & Governance through one operating model.

  • Translate Microsoft's Fabric IQ, Foundry IQ, Azure, and agent investments into a clear SHI services roadmap, capability plan, and investment agenda.

  • Establish clear ownership, decision rights, handoffs, delivery standards, and quality expectations across the organization.

  • Build modular, repeatable offerings that combine cloud, data, AI, and governance capabilities around defined customer outcomes.

  • Use portfolio, pipeline, delivery, and capacity data to prioritize investments, manage tradeoffs, and improve practice health.

People Leadership Through Managers and Directors

  • Lead, coach, and develop the leaders responsible for Agentic Solutions, Cloud Platform, Data & Intelligence, and AI Security & Governance.

  • Build leadership depth through regular one-on-ones, development planning, succession planning, and clear career paths.

  • Own workforce planning across the organization, including hiring, onboarding, retention, skills development, and capacity alignment to backlog and pipeline.

  • Create a culture of shared accountability in which teams solve for the full customer outcome rather than optimize isolated technology workstreams.

Technical Direction Across Data, AI, and Security

  • Maintain a platform-aware perspective across Agent 365, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, Model Context Protocol, Azure, landing zones, platform engineering, FinOps, Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, data engineering, data visualization, and data readiness.

  • Sponsor reusable reference architectures, delivery frameworks, statements of work, work breakdown structures, templates, and accelerators.

  • Rely on practice leaders and principal architects for deep technical direction while maintaining alignment across disciplines.

  • Create a practical path from assessment and platform readiness through implementation, adoption, optimization, and transition to managed services.

Delivery Excellence and Client Outcomes

  • Provide executive oversight for complex, multi-workstream engagements that span cloud, data, AI, agents, security, and governance.

  • Hold leaders accountable for scope quality, staffing readiness, delivery methodology, risk management, timelines, budgets, and customer communication.

  • Review project health, utilization, realization, margin, capacity, and quality signals and act early when performance moves off plan.

  • Protect customer trust by ensuring teams make supportable commitments, apply appropriate governance, and transition solutions into sustainable operations.

  • Serve as an executive sponsor and trusted advisor for strategic clients, connecting platform decisions to measurable business outcomes.

Business Growth and Market Development

  • Grow AI + Infrastructure services revenue by improving solution relevance, supporting strategic pursuits, expanding enterprise client relationships, and developing repeatable offers.

  • Partner with Solution Architecture, Sales, Project Management, Digital Workplace, and Managed Services to shape opportunities and deliver connected customer outcomes.

  • Manage utilization, capacity, backlog, pipeline health, and delivery performance to improve profitability and support sustainable growth.

  • Build strong relationships with Microsoft field, engineering, and partner teams to align priorities, improve co-sell execution, and strengthen SHI's market credibility.

  • Capture customer evidence, references, and measurable outcomes that support retention, expansion, and market recognition.

Executive and Cross-Functional Communication

  • Serve as an executive advisor to enterprise clients, connecting business priorities to Microsoft cloud, data, AI, agent, security, and governance strategies.

  • Communicate practice priorities, portfolio health, performance, risks, and investment needs to senior leadership, including the Vice President, Microsoft Services.

  • Run a consistent operating cadence across leaders that covers pipeline, staffing, project health, financial performance, capability development, and customer outcomes.

  • Turn operating data into decisions and actions rather than reporting activity without accountability.

  • Escalate delivery, capacity, security, compliance, and customer risks early, with clear options and recommended actions.

Behaviors and Competencies

  • Strategic Thinking: Can analyze complex situations, drive organizational transformation, and adapt strategies to changing market conditions.

  • Leadership: Can lead strategic team initiatives, inspire others to take leadership roles, and foster a culture of shared responsibility and continuous improvement.

  • Communication: Can lead and model exceptional communication at all levels of the organization, develop and implement communication strategies, and coach others to improve their communication skills.

  • Collaboration: Can lead complex team projects, inspire others to collaborate effectively, and foster a culture of mutual respect and shared purpose.

  • Problem-Solving: Can lead strategic problem-solving initiatives, inspire others to improve their problem-solving skills, and foster a culture of proactive problem-solving.

  • Customer-Centric Mindset: Can lead strategic initiatives focused on improving the overall customer experience. Inspires and mentors others to adopt a customer-centric approach, fostering a culture of customer focus throughout the organization.

  • Results Orientation: Can inspire a culture of results-orientation across the organization, setting high standards and holding everyone accountable for achieving results.

  • Adaptability: Can drive strategic transformations, inspire others to embrace change, and foster a culture of continuous adaptation.

  • Strategic Implementation: Can lead the development and execution of comprehensive strategic plans, inspire and guide teams, and drive organizational change to achieve strategic objectives.

  • Continuous Improvement: Can lead others in identifying and implementing major improvements and proactively drive continuous improvement across the organization.

Skill Level Requirements

Your Success at SHI

People who are successful in this role tend to demonstrate:

  • The ability to connect cloud, data, agents, and governance into practical solutions that clients can adopt and operate.

  • A talent development mindset that grows managers and practice leaders into confident, accountable leaders.

Other Requirements

  • Commitment to continuous learning as Microsoft cloud, data, AI, agent, and security platforms evolve.

The estimated annual pay range for this position is $225,000 - $325,000 which includes a base salary and bonus. The compensation for this position is dependent on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location and, therefore, will vary from individual to individual. Benefits may include, but are not limited to, medical, vision, dental, 401K, and flexible spending.

What You'll Work On

Outbound Prospecting and Cold Outreach

  • Research and identify target accounts and key decision-makers within each organization
  • Conduct outbound outreach via phone and email to cold and warm prospects daily
  • Write clear, personalized, non-spammy cold emails and follow-up sequences that generate responses
  • Handle objections confidently and keep conversations moving toward a booked meeting

Lead Qualification and Pipeline Management

  • Qualify inbound and outbound leads against defined ideal customer profile criteria
  • Conduct discovery conversations to understand prospect pain points, timelines, and fit
  • Book qualified meetings for the sales team with full context and qualification notes
  • Log all outreach activity, call notes, and next steps accurately in the CRM after every interaction

CRM and Reporting

  • Maintain clean and current pipeline records across all active prospects
  • Track activity volume, response rates, and meeting conversion metrics consistently
  • Meet daily and weekly outreach targets and monthly meeting booking goals

What You Bring

  • Prior B2B sales development, outbound sales, or lead generation experience — this is the primary qualification for this role
  • Excellent spoken and written English communication skills, highly preferred for a role that involves daily business-to-business conversations and correspondence
  • Comfortable making outbound calls and sending cold emails to business decision-makers with a confident, professional, and natural communication style
  • Experience with a CRM platform for logging activity, tracking pipeline, and managing follow-up sequences
  • Organized and self-directed with the ability to manage a high volume of outreach without losing quality or responsiveness
  • Comfortable with rejection and persistent enough to follow up without being pushy

Nice to Have

  • Experience selling into a specific vertical such as technology, SaaS, professional services, or similar B2B categories
  • Familiarity with sales engagement platforms such as Apollo, Outreach, Salesloft, or similar tools
  • Background in a high-growth startup or fast-paced B2B sales environment
  • Experience running multi-touch outbound sequences combining phone, email, and LinkedIn

How to Apply

Please include:

  1. Your updated resume
  2. A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself, describing your B2B sales development experience, and giving an example of how you approach prospecting a new account from research through to first outreach

Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

If you are a confident B2B communicator who can prospect intelligently, qualify rigorously, and book meetings consistently, this role gives you the structure and the direct impact to do your best work.

Application Process Overview

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

1. Initial Application - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
2. Video Introduction - Record an video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
3. Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
4. Recruitment Interview - Initial screening with our talent team
5. Executive Interview - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
6. Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
7. Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification
8. Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team

Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations.

We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

Requirements

  • At least 1 year of previous experience in ABA services, healthcare, behavioral health, or patient intake.
  • Experience handling phone-intensive responsibilities involving both inbound and outbound calls.
  • Familiarity using Lumary and Salesforce is preferred
  • Strong experience communicating with families, patients, or caregivers.
  • Ability to communicate with compassion, patience, professionalism, and care.
  • Ability to follow structured intake forms and decision-tree workflows with minimal supervision.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to manage follow-ups and maintain organized patient records.
  • Professional demeanor when handling sensitive and patient-facing interactions.
  • Availability to provide weekend coverage.
  • Experience collecting referrals, diagnosis documents, and insurance information.

Basic Requirements

  • Must speak and write English clearly and professionally.
  • Must have relevant work experience.
  • Must be able to provide an NBI Clearance and/or Local Police Clearance before onboarding (mandatory).

Technical Requirements

  • Internet: Stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps).
  • Audio: Noise-canceling headset.
  • Video: Working webcam for virtual meetings.

Gainwell Technologies is seeking an experienced Financial Cash Control Supervisor to support financial operations for California’s Medi-Cal program.

jobs.description:
At TE, you will unleash your potential working with people from diverse backgrounds and industries to create a safer, sustainable and more connected world.

​

Job Overview

The Environment Specialist provides environmental technical expertise and compliance support across multiple manufacturing sites, and supports the implementation and continuous improvement of business environmental compliance programs while ensuring environmental risks, regulatory requirements, permits, and company standards are effectively identified, managed, and maintained. This individual will also serve as a regional environmental subject-matter expert, partnering with site EHS, Operations, Engineering, Facilities, Legal, and business leadership to proactively identify environmental risks, strengthen compliance systems, and support compliant manufacturing operations.

Job Requirements

  • Provide environmental technical support and subject-matter expertise to manufacturing sites across the assigned region.
  • Evaluate compliance with applicable federal, state, and local environmental regulations, permits, company standards, and other environmental requirements.
  • Support and/or lead environmental legal compliance audits, risk assessments, and compliance reviews; assist sites in developing corrective actions and verify the effectiveness of significant corrective actions.
  • Provide technical support for air permitting and emissions compliance, including permit applicability evaluations, emissions inventories, permit applications and modifications, emission and throughput calculations, compliance monitoring, recordkeeping, and regulatory reporting.
  • Periodically verify that environmental permits, registrations, and authorizations remain aligned with actual site equipment, processes, materials, production volumes, emission sources, discharges, and operating conditions.
  • Provide technical oversight and support for hazardous and non-hazardous waste management, including waste characterization, generator-status determination, accumulation and storage, labeling, transportation and disposal, manifests, vendor management, and regulatory documentation.
  • Provide technical support for wastewater and stormwater compliance, including permitting, sampling and monitoring requirements, analytical-data review, discharge limitations, treatment-system performance, inspections, reporting, and investigation of potential unauthorized discharges.
  • Support site programs for spill prevention and response, chemical management, storage tanks, environmental releases, and environmental emergency response.
  • Support investigation and management of environmental incidents, releases, permit deviations, exceedances, Notices of Violation (NOVs), and other significant environmental events. Lead or support root-cause analysis and development of corrective and preventive actions.
  • Review and validate environmental compliance data used for permit tracking, emissions calculations, regulatory reporting, waste reporting, wastewater reporting, and other environmental submissions to ensure accuracy, completeness, and appropriate documentation.
  • Monitor environmental corrective actions and assist sites in prioritizing closure based on regulatory and environmental risk. Escalate overdue or high-risk actions as appropriate.
  • Analyze environmental audit findings, incidents, regulatory events, and compliance trends across sites to identify repeat and systemic risks and develop scalable corrective actions, tools, standards, and best practices.
  • Develop and maintain standardized environmental compliance tools, procedures, permit matrices, compliance calendars, checklists, and technical guidance to improve consistency across the region.
  • Coordinate and provide technical oversight of environmental consultants, laboratories, waste vendors, and other environmental service providers.
  • Monitor emerging environmental regulations and evaluate potential impacts to regional manufacturing operations.
  • Promote sharing of environmental compliance best practices, regulatory lessons learned, and significant environmental events across sites to prevent recurrence and drive continuous improvement.

What your background should look like

Education/Experience

  • Generally requires a Bachelor's degree in Environmental Engineering, Environmental Science, Chemical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Environmental Health & Safety, or a related technical discipline, with a minimum of 8 years of progressive environmental compliance experience, preferably within manufacturing or industrial operations. Master's degree or higher, or local equivalent, may be preferred at this level.
  • Demonstrated technical experience across multiple environmental regulatory programs, including air permitting and emissions, hazardous waste, wastewater/stormwater, chemical management, spill prevention, and environmental regulatory reporting.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently interpret environmental regulations and permit conditions, determine regulatory applicability, assess manufacturing operations for potential compliance gaps, and develop practical risk-based solutions.
  • Working knowledge of ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems and environmental compliance-management/data systems is preferred.
  • Professional environmental certifications such as CHMM, PE, QEP, REM, or equivalent are preferred but not required.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, project-management, and communication skills, with demonstrated ability to influence and provide technical guidance across multiple organizational levels and functions.
  • Ability to travel to manufacturing sites within the assigned region as required.

Competencies

SET : Strategy, Execution, Talent (for managers)

ABOUT TE CONNECTIVITY

TE Connectivity plc (NYSE: TEL) is a global industrial technology leader creating a safer, sustainable, productive, and connected future. As a trusted innovation partner, our broad range of connectivity and sensor solutions enable the distribution of power, signal and data to advance next-generation transportation, energy networks, automated factories, data centers enabling artificial intelligence, and more.

Our more than 90,000 employees, including 10,000 engineers, work alongside customers in approximately 130 countries. In a world that is racing ahead, TE ensures that EVERY CONNECTION COUNTS. Learn more at and on LinkedIn, Facebook, WeChat,Instagram and X (formerly Twitter).

COMPENSATION
• Competitive base salary commensurate with experience: $121,600-$182,400 (subject to change dependent on physical location)
• Posted salary ranges are made in good faith. TE Connectivity reserves the right to adjust ranges depending on the experience/qualification of the selected candidate as well as internal and external equity.
• Total Compensation = Base Salary + Incentive(s) + Benefits

BENEFITS
• A comprehensive benefits package including health insurance, 401(k), disability, life insurance, employee stock purchase plan, paid time off and voluntary benefits.

EOE, Including Disability/Vets

IMPORTANT NOTICE REGARDING RECRUITMENT FRAUD
TE Connectivity has become aware of fraudulent recruitment activities being conducted by individuals or organizations falsely claiming to represent TE Connectivity. Please be advised that TE Connectivity never requests payment or fees from job applicants at any stage of the recruitment process. All legitimate job openings are posted exclusively on our official careers website at te.com/careers, and all email communications from our recruitment team will come only from actual email addresses ending in @te.com. If you receive any suspicious communications, we strongly advise you not to engage or provide any personal information, and to report the incident to your local authorities.

We are building an extraordinary company and looking for talented, energetic, and motivated people to join our team. You can learn more about our Company, Culture and Values here:

Job Description

The Certified Medical Coder is responsible for reviewing patient medical records and assigning accurate diagnosis and procedure codes for physician and facility services. This position ensures compliance with federal regulations, payer requirements, and coding guidelines while supporting timely claim submission, reimbursement accuracy, and overall revenue cycle performance. The Certified Medical Coder works closely with providers, billing staff, and other revenue cycle team members to maintain coding accuracy and reduce claim denials.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Review medical records, provider documentation, and encounter forms to determine appropriate diagnosis and procedure codes.
  • Assign accurate ICD-10-CM, CPT, and HCPCS Level II codes based on documentation and coding guidelines.
  • Ensure coding compliance with CMS, Medicare, Medicaid, commercial payers, and regulatory agencies.
  • Audit medical records for completeness, accuracy, and documentation deficiencies.
  • Communicate with providers regarding coding clarification requests and documentation improvement opportunities.
  • Identify and resolve coding-related claim denials and rejections.
  • Maintain productivity and quality standards established by the organization.
  • Stay current with coding updates, payer policies, and industry regulations.
  • Assist with internal coding audits and compliance reviews.
  • Collaborate with billing, collections, and revenue cycle teams to support reimbursement optimization.
  • Participate in ongoing education and training related to coding and compliance.
  • Maintain confidentiality of patient information in accordance with HIPAA regulations.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Completion of an accredited medical coding program preferred.
  • Current medical coding certification required.
  • Minimum of 1-2 years of coding experience preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of ICD-10-CM, CPT, and HCPCS coding systems.
  • Understanding of medical terminology, anatomy, physiology, and healthcare reimbursement methodologies.
  • Knowledge of payer guidelines, claim processing, and revenue cycle management.
  • Proficiency in Electronic Health Records (EHR) and practice management systems.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Associate's degree in Health Information Management, Medical Coding, Healthcare Administration, or related field.
  • Experience coding specialty services such as family practice, urgent care, behavioral health, orthopedics, cardiology, or surgical specialties.
  • Prior experience with coding audits and denial management.

Key Competencies

  • Accuracy and attention to detail
  • Critical thinking and analytical skills
  • Time management and productivity
  • Knowledge of healthcare regulations
  • Communication and collaboration
  • Compliance and ethical decision-making
  • Problem-solving abilities

Physical Requirements

  • Prolonged periods of sitting and computer work.
  • Ability to review electronic medical records and coding documentation for extended periods.
  • Ability to work independently in an office or remote environment.

Medical Coding Certifications

The following certifications are commonly recognized and align with medical coding positions:

AAPC Certifications

Certified Professional Coder (CPC)

  • Most widely recognized physician-based coding certification.
  • Focuses on outpatient and professional-fee coding.

Certified Outpatient Coder (COC)

  • Designed for hospital outpatient and facility coding.

Certified Inpatient Coder (CIC)

  • Focuses on inpatient hospital coding.

Certified Risk Adjustment Coder (CRC)

  • Specializes in Hierarchical Condition Category (HCC) and risk adjustment coding.

AHIMA Certifications

Certified Coding Associate (CCA)

  • Entry-level certification for coders beginning their careers.

Certified Coding Specialist (CCS)

  • Advanced certification focusing on hospital inpatient and outpatient coding.

Certified Coding Specialist - Physician-based (CCS-P)

  • Advanced certification for physician-office and outpatient coding.

Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT)

  • Includes coding knowledge and broader health information management responsibilities.

Registered Health Information Administrator (RHIA)

  • Advanced credential focused on health information management, compliance, and leadership.

Recommended Certification Requirements

For most physician practice and revenue cycle organizations:

Required:

  • CPC, CCS-P, CCS, or CCA

Preferred:

  • CPC, CCS-P, CCS, CRC, RHIT, or RHIA

Where:

This is a fully remote, US based position with minimal to no travel required. You may be asked to travel up to 4 times per year for quarterly planning. The EverCommerce team is distributed globally, with teams in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., New Zealand, and Australia. With a widely distributed team, we are used to working remotely across different time zones. This role can be based anywhere in the United States or Canada – if you’re close to one of our offices, we can set you up in-office or you can work 100% remotely. Please note that you must be eligible to work without sponsorship to qualify for this position, and this role may require travel to our Corporate Headquarters in Denver, Colorado, or to other office locations around North America.

Position Summary:

We are seeking an experienced mid-level Environmental Cost Estimator to support environmental remediation projects. You will be responsible for supporting environmental projects for the USEPA, USACE,/DoD clients and various agencies across the United States and territories. Work assignments may include proposal support, remedial design support, oversight of remedial action (RA), in situ thermal treatment, remediation, demolition, mine-waste cleanup, landfill cap construction, contaminated sediment removals, and groundwater treatment (both in-situ and pump-and-treat) and stabilization projects.

This position is fully remote with up to 15-20% travel required.

Responsibilities/Duties

  • Developing engineering studies, plans, designs, and specifications for the remediation of environmental contamination.
  • Supporting Program, Operations, and Project Managers by analyzing project requirements and preparing detailed cost estimates. Role will include attending pre-bid site walks, determining scopes of work, perform quantity take-offs, calculate pricing by required task and phasing, obtain competitive bids from subcontractors, review and understand blueprints and project specifications, assist with value engineering assessments, and evaluate change orders.
  • Perform thorough review of bid materials including general conditions, schedule, scopes of work, site logistics, means and methods, constructability, and other information relative to ensuring competitiveness, completeness, and risk mitigation.
  • Analyze project documents to identify necessary resources including labor, materials quantities, means, methods, equipment, restrictions, schedule, and any other requirements for ensuring successful completion of projects.
  • Develop FFP and/or CPFF cost estimates including labor, equipment, material / supply, and subcontractor requirements.
  • Prepare initial project schedule to support cost estimate. Include tasks consistent with WBS structure. The period of performance, including any optional periods that may be exercised, should be identified.
  • Assemble and present the prepared estimate, including all backup information, rates, costs, units, quotes, etc.
  • Maintain cost database for all projects bid, and work with company resources to continually refine the database for site-specific, regional, and scope-specific data.
  • Interfacing with program and project managers, senior technical staff, the government customer, and RA Contractors.
  • Reporting of observations and compliance with contract documents.
  • Solicit subcontractor and vendor/supplier bids.

Requirements:

  • Minimum of 5 years previous environmental construction and remediation experience with at least 2 years as an Estimator or Estimate to Lead.
  • Bachelor’s degree in an engineering field related to Environmental Studies such as: Civil Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or related field.
  • Experience preparing bids for USACE and/or EPA remedial action contracts and task orders.
  • Hands-on experience and general knowledge of estimating, including budgeting, scheduling, change management, construction, and reporting.
  • Knowledge of cost estimating software and methodologies.
  • Experience supporting engineering, environmental, procurement, and construction projects.
  • Ability to interpret bid documents for cost, estimating, and change management.
  • Ability to prioritize and organize, work well under pressure, and meet deadlines.
  • Ability to work flexible hours as required to meet deadlines.
  • Knowledge and experience of CERCLA, DoD, DOE, EPA, and/or RCRA projects.
  • Ability to conduct completion inspections, document project status and maintain records.
  • Working knowledge of Federal and state occupational regulations, including US Army Corps of Engineers and EM 385, 1-1 Safety and Health Manual.
  • Ability to prepare daily reports documenting activities and findings.
  • Excellent interpersonal communication skills (both written and oral) including the ability to comfortably engage with varying levels of leadership, RA Contractors, subcontractors, internal and external stakeholders, etc.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in the Microsoft Office suite of software, specifically in Excel and Word.
  • Intermediate proficiency level with Microsoft Office Suite. Estimating software (B2W, Hard Dollar, HCSS, Sage Timberline) experience a plus.
  • Working knowledge of scheduling software (Primavera or MS Project).

Desired Skills

  • US Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) CQM certification preferred, not required.
  • Experience working with USACE, USAF, EPA, or NASA clients.
  • Experience at a federal government remediation or construction sites.
  • OSHA 40-hr. and 8-hr. HAZWOPER Training.
  • M.S. degree in engineering field related to Environmental Studies.
  • EIT Certification (or capability to test and pass FE exam within one year) or Registered PE (or capability to obtain registration within one year), depending on experience.

jobs.description:
8x8 connects our customers and teams globally, empowering CX leaders with performance and insights to make smarter decisions, delight customers, and drive lasting business impact.

The Business Value Consultant (BVC) is an expert in contact centre and unified communications technologies, solution connectivity challenges and options, and business processes. They bring first-hand experience from within the contact centre industry, with the ability to apply that understanding to sales engagements and recommend solution designs. This combination of technical and business experience, together with a clear understanding of the product development lifecycle and the broader technology landscape, positions this individual contributor as a trusted advisor to 8x8, the Sales organisation, and the prospect and customer community. The role also supports internal departments across the organisation as a resource and subject matter expert (SME) for both 8x8 products and industry trends.

As part of the Global Sales Team, the BVC provides support on strategic and critical opportunities for prospects. The consultant conducts deep discovery into current business operations and challenges to position the best solution for the customer, and may run sessions to help determine the Return on Investment (ROI) a customer could see after implementing 8x8 solutions, creating a foundation for budgetary and business planning. They contribute to the successful onboarding of potential customers onto the platform while providing best practice guidance on hosted contact centre, unified communications, workforce optimisation, self-service, emerging communication technologies (including AI and its impact on communications), and customer experience. They also support ongoing retention for existing 8x8 customers through deep data analysis and optimisation, sharing data-based recommendations such as configuration changes, better use of underutilised features, or new products and services for the existing deployment. The consultant may provide on-site or remote support for early-stage go/no-go situations, development of strategic opportunities, delivery of on-site sales consulting services for prospects, and subsequent post-visit reports.

The successful BVC must be able to present 8x8 solutions effectively to prospect and customer personnel at varying levels, including C-level, business unit or operations management, and technology professionals. This role is integral to the overall success of the Sales, Solutions Engineering and Customer Success organisations, ensuring a positive customer experience throughout.

Responsibilities

  • Become an expert in the 8x8 product portfolio including CCaaS, UCaaS CPaaS and AI solutions, and demonstrate solutions as needed to develop and explain the recommended solution architecture.

  • Develop fluency in new and emerging technology offerings from our Technology Ecosystem Partners.

  • Support the global sales team on request for strategic or critical opportunities, identifying gaps and red-flag issues that could be barriers to successful implementation or increase the risk of not meeting prospects' expectations.

  • Work collaboratively with prospects' contact centre teams and business unit leaders to provide change management support, facilitate sound decision-making, review options and considerations in system design, and provide insight into the trade-offs between them.

  • Engage in contact centre reviews with prospects, examining business processes, current technology strategy and required metrics to collaboratively clarify priorities. Analyse customers' contact centre analytics, processes and metrics to identify gaps, and provide a roadmap of recommendations to move from current state to successful deployment against their strategic objectives.

  • Provide internal guidance and mentoring across all project areas, including call flow design, workforce management, quality monitoring, key metrics, and the unique dynamics of contact centre operations.

  • Ensure customers realise maximum value from their investment by driving proper methodologies, processes and best practices across all consulting engagements.

  • Strengthen credibility as a contact centre and customer experience expert by delivering presentations on contact centre issues for consulting projects, and representing 8x8 at industry conferences and events.

  • Produce materials such as on-site reports and analysis of results, and contribute to the creation and optimisation of templates for the BVC team.

  • Stay abreast of current developments in telecommunications, UCaaS, CCaaS, CPaaS, self-service, automation, VoIP technologies, AI solutions and industry trends.

  • Engage with the Centre of Excellence as the CX consultant for contact centre proof of concepts.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years in a consulting role with CCaaS and UCaaS experience.

jobs.excerpt: The Senior Specialist, Benefits & HRIS is the day-to-day engine behind our health and welfare and retirement programs and the primary administrator of our HRIS.
jobs.description:
The Senior Specialist, Benefits & HRIS is the day-to-day engine behind our health and welfare and retirement programs and the primary administrator of our HRIS. Supporting approximately 1,000 employees across multiple states, this role handles the hands-on execution that keeps benefits accurate and compliant in every jurisdiction we operate in, and keeps our HR data clean, secure, and reportable.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You will work with meaningful independence on established programs and processes, escalating plan design decisions, budget commitments, and novel compliance questions to the Manager or Director. It suits someone who takes real satisfaction in getting the details right — reconciling a carrier file, catching an eligibility error before it becomes a claim problem, and explaining a deductible clearly to an employee who is worried about a bill. This person works independently, knows when to escalate, and maintains accuracy and composure during high-volume periods.

Requirements

Benefits Administration

  • Administer all health and welfare plans day to day, including medical, dental, vision, HSA/FSA, life and AD&D, short- and long-term disability, EAP, and voluntary benefits.
  • Process enrollments, qualifying life events, terminations, and COBRA notifications; audit for accuracy and timeliness.
  • Coordinate benefits continuation and premium payment for employees on leave of absence: maintain carrier eligibility during leave, calculate and collect employee premium contributions, track arrears, and partner with Payroll on catch-up deductions upon return. Work from leave status, type, and dates provided by HR Business Partners, who own leave administration.
  • Reconcile carrier invoices and eligibility files monthly; research and resolve discrepancies with carriers and the broker.
  • Execute open enrollment under the direction of the Manager: configure and test the system, prepare and distribute communications, deliver employee education sessions, respond to questions, and complete the post-enrollment audit.
  • Support the annual renewal cycle by compiling census, claims, and utilization data for the broker and Manager, and by preparing analysis to inform plan design and contribution recommendations.
  • Administer the 401(k) plan operationally: contribution and loan feeds, eligibility and enrollment monitoring, and preparation of data for nondiscrimination testing, Form 5500, and the annual plan audit.
  • Serve as first-line support for employee benefits questions, claims issues, and eligibility inquiries; escalate complex disputes and exception requests.
  • Maintain vendor relationships at the service level — open and track tickets, hold carriers to service standards, and flag performance concerns to the Manager.

HRIS Administration & Reporting

  • Serve as primary day-to-day administrator for UKG: process transactions, maintain configuration within established design, manage security role assignments, and test releases.
  • Maintain data integrity through recurring audits, validation checks, and reconciliation across HRIS, payroll, benefits carriers, and the 401(k) recordkeeper.
  • Monitor integrations and EDI feeds to downstream systems; triage failures, resolve routine errors, and escalate structural issues to the Manager and vendor support.
  • Audit that leave status changes entered by HR Business Partners flow correctly through to benefits eligibility and carrier feeds, and flag gaps before they result in a coverage lapse.
  • Build and maintain standard and ad hoc reports and dashboards — headcount, turnover, benefits enrollment and cost, and EEO and compliance reporting.
  • Contribute to system projects and module rollouts as a functional resource: document current-state processes, write test scripts, execute testing, and support training and go-live.
  • Create and maintain process documentation and job aids; train HR partners, managers, and employees on self-service functionality.

Compliance Support

  • Prepare and distribute required participant notices on the annual compliance calendar; maintain plan documents, SPDs, and wrap documents in current form.
  • Compile data and documentation for ACA reporting (1094-C/1095-C), Form 5500, plan audits, and regulatory inquiries.
  • Maintain HIPAA privacy practices in daily handling of protected health information.
  • Track state and local regulatory changes affecting benefits; surface new requirements and their operational impact to the Manager.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years of hands-on benefits administration experience, including exposure to a multi-state US environment.
  • 3+ years of hands-on HRIS administration experience in a cloud HCM platform (UKG, Workday, ADP Workforce Now, Paylocity, Dayforce, or similar).
  • Working familiarity with ERISA, ACA, COBRA, HIPAA, Section 125, and FMLA benefit continuation requirements as they apply to daily administration.
  • Experience supporting an open enrollment cycle end to end.
  • Strong Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, reconciliation of large files) and solid reporting ability.
  • Demonstrated discretion handling confidential employee, medical, and compensation data.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain plan provisions to a non-technical audience.
  • CEBS, CBP, PHR, or SHRM-CP coursework or certification, or progress toward one is preferred.
  • Participation in an HRIS implementation, module rollout, or platform migration highly desirable.
  • Exposure to 401(k) plan audit and Form 5500 preparation is preferred.

Compensation is based on experience; $83,000+ based on experience

About Us

We are a global climate technologies company engineered for sustainability. We create sustainable and efficient residential, commercial and industrial spaces through HVACR technologies. Best-in-class engineering, design and manufacturing combined with category-leading brands in compression, controls, software and monitoring solutions result in next-generation climate technology that is built for the needs of the world ahead. 

Whether you are a professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring your first opportunity, or recent graduate with an advanced degree, we have opportunities that will allow you to innovate, be challenged and make an impact. Join our team and start your journey today!

The Territory Sales Executiveis responsible fordriving sales growth across Copeland’s HVACR portfolio, including electronics, controls, compressors, condensing units, and related parts. This role focuses on developing strong relationships with wholesalers, contractors, and distribution partners while delivering technicalexpertise, training, and market insights to expand Copeland’s presence within the assigned territory.

  • Ability to engage in the sales process across all levels of the customer's organization.

Remote Work Arrangement:   

This role is fully remote. As a remote colleague, you may be required to travel to a Copeland site regularly to collaborate with your team or customers as needed. Copeland is committed to fostering a productive and connected culture, so you will have the opportunity to work with your team and leader to understand your team operating principles to collaborate effectively.  

This role requiresfrequent travel within the territory, averaging 25-50% overnight travel, depending on your location within the territory. The territoryis Eastern New York State (not including New York City).

 

Our compensation philosophy is simple: we pay a competitive base salary, within the local market in which we operate, and reward performance during our annual merit review process. In accordance with Colorado EPEWA, the salaryrange for this role is $85,000-$95,000 annually, commensurate with the skills, talent, capabilities, and experience each candidate brings to a role.Additionally, we have a quarterly bonus program and provide a company vehicle.

Our Commitment to Our People

Across the globe, we are united by a singular Purpose: Sustainability is no small ambition. That’s why everything we do is geared toward a sustainable future—for our generation and all those to come. Through groundbreaking innovations, HVACR technology and cold chain solutions, we are reducing carbon emissions and improving energy efficiency in spaces of all sizes, from residential to commercial to industrial.

Our employees are our greatest strength. We believe that our culture of passion, openness, and collaboration empowers us to work toward the same goal - to make the world a better place. We invest in the end-to-end development of our people, beginning at onboarding and through senior leadership, so they can thrive personally and professionally.

Flexible and competitive benefits plans offer the right options to meet your individual/family needs: medical insurance plans, dental and vision coverage, 401(k) and more. We provide employees with flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave, vacation and holiday leave. 

Together, we have the opportunity – and the power – to continue to revolutionize the technology behind air conditioning, heating and refrigeration, and cultivate a better future. Learn more about us and how you can join our team!

Our Commitment to Inclusion & Belonging

At Copeland, we cultivate a strong sense of inclusion and belonging where individuals of all backgrounds, and with diverse perspectives, are embraced and treated fairly to enable a stronger workforce. Our employee resource groups play an important role in culture and community building at Copeland.
