jobs.excerpt: A DAY IN THE LIFEAs a Manager Engineering – Instrumentation and Controls Engineering, you will be responsible for the instrumentation and controls engineering program for the company's gas generation segment; with an emphasis on reciprocating engine and aeroderivative gas turbine generating facilities and the associated balance of plant equipment.
jobs.description:
A DAY IN THE LIFE

As a Manager Engineering – Instrumentation and Controls Engineering, you will be responsible for the instrumentation and controls engineering program for the company's gas generation segment; with an emphasis on reciprocating engine and aeroderivative gas turbine generating facilities and the associated balance of plant equipment. You'll act as the company program engineering representative from proposal stage through execution, helping define company engineering and gas business plans for the gas generation segment, and ensuring that all final engineering products meet client reliability, operability, and constructability requirements. The Manager Engineering – Instrumentation and Controls Engineering, must have strong technical knowledge and experience in the technologies used in gas generation(including balance of plant) design, be program management and process oriented, and must have strong interpersonal and leadership skills.

STEP INTO THE ROLE

  • Company program engineering representative during all phases from conception through construction completion of gas generation pursuits. As the company program manager, responsibility will include interactions with Blattner Business Units, reciprocating engine and gas turbine generator suppliers, balance of plant equipment providers, to establish long lasting relationships.
  • Understand client design criteria and intent, and determine how clients and the energy market are evolving on design trends, philosophy, and criteria on gas generation plant design.
  • Will travel to Client office and/or project sites as required to foster client relationships, idea propagation, and problem solving.
  • Builds an understanding of the strategic dynamics that are essential to the gas generation market.
  • Coordinates and supports engineering activities, making detailed plans to accomplish goals and directing the integration of client and company technical activities. Works with clients to ensure the company and client understand design standards and philosophies for processes.
  • Participates in defining the Company engineering and gas business plans necessary goals and actions for the gas generation segment.
  • Develops and facilitates safety standards for the gas generation Engineering program and Company.
  • Ensures projects are designed and constructed in compliance with all applicable and prudent industry standards, including those provisions specific to reciprocating engine and combustion turbine installations and fuel gas systems.
  • Root cause analysis expert for Engineering and Instrumentation and Controls items of the Company.
  • Develop and implement consistent policies, standards, and procedures for the Program management; specifically regarding engineering design standards utilized by Company for reciprocating engine and gas turbine generating facilities. Implement guardrails specific to design philosophy and criteria within Company Program.
  • Owns the design basis for all power block instrumentation and controls. Collaborates and ensures integration with Blattner Business Units responsible for electrical design for generators and services. This includes protection and generation control, generator step-up and auxiliary transformers, medium voltage switchgear and collection, generator protection and synchronizing, station service and emergency power, grounding and lightning protection, cable and raceway systems, and lighting.
  • Owns the design basis for all balance of plant instrumentation and controls. Collaborates and ensures integration with Blattner Business Units responsible for electrical design for power to equipment. Reviews electrical interface design for balance of plant equipment, including fuel gas conditioning and compression, inlet air and filtration systems, lube oil and cooling systems, water treatment, cooling systems, emissions control equipment, fire protection and detection, and plant control system integration.
  • Stays current on new technologies and industry practices. Seeks opportunities to add value to projects with application of best available technology for specific projects. Performs economic analysis / value engineering to determine cost effective solutions and prepare recommendations to procurement team.
  • Analyzes technology, resource needs, and market demands to plan and assess the feasibility of projects and engineering initiatives.
  • Facilitates creation and maintains library of design basis documents for all segments within Company. Must ensure Managers of Procurement are current with design basis for client and scope of work prior to kick-off meeting of estimating new project.
  • Be an available technical resource to support engineering leads review of owner, contractor, and company scopes for completeness, and note gaps or overlaps, with particular attention to the terminal points between the generating equipment supplier, balance of plant vendors, and company scope.
  • Supports constructability reviews of engine and turbine power block layouts, modular and skid-mounted equipment, and pre-assembled cable and conduit systems to reduce field labor and improve installation quality.
  • Supports the instrumentation and controls requirements of plant startup, first fire, synchronization, and performance testing, and ensures commissioning needs are reflected in the design.
  • Verifies and owns complete protection and controls for power block and BOP.
  • Acts as the escalation point for instrumentation and controls commissioning issues, including protection and control settings, monitoring systems, controls testing, and controller interfaces.
  • Preliminary engineering to final review of design, installation, and commissioning for power generation block and BOP instrumentation and controls.
    • Redundancy of instrumentation, controls hardware, and logic design
    • Winterization for instrumentation and control devices
    • Control Loop Diagrams
    • Instrument Loop Diagrams
    • Controls narratives and logic
  • Owner of all controller communication protocol and interface design, including distributed control system (DCS) at power block level.
  • Owner of data historian configuration and representation of available data points, including internally configured points. This includes ensuring DCS provides points for historian.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

  • Four-year Engineering degree in electrical or mechanical engineering from an ABET accredited college
  • 5+ of progressive engineering experience in gas power generation, with two or more years of leadership experience.
  • Registered Professional Engineering (PE) license is strongly preferred.
  • Must have a valid driver’s license and an acceptable motor vehicle driving record (MVR).
  • Up to 25% travel required, subject to fluctuations as needs dictate.

WHAT SETS YOU APART

  • Knowledge of reciprocating engine and gas turbine equipment and the associated balance of plant equipment and their applications.
  • Knowledge of multiple communication protocols and integration of same – MODBUS, Profi-Bus, Foundation Field-Bus, etc.
  • Civil, Mechanical-Instrumentation and Controls, and Electrical power engineering principles and familiarity with computer and analytical tools as they relate to equipment sizing, construction design, 3-D Modeling.
  • Familiarity with computer tools/programs used for instrumentation and controls programming and commissioning – communications protocols, vibrations monitoring, instrumentation programming and calibration, transformer monitoring.
  • Familiarity with Continuous Emissions Monitoring Systems (CEMS) specifications, regulatory protocols, equipment, commissioning, and certification.
  • Familiarity with Emissions Control Systems – primarily Selective Catalytic Reduction (SCR) specifications, regulatory requirements, equipment, controls design, commissioning, and safety compliance.
  • Familiarity with engineering standards/best practices related to power generation.
  • Interpersonal skills – ability to influence and persuade groups toward common objectives.
  • Effective communication skills (oral, written, listening, presentation) to work with owners, vendors, and employees.

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

  • Competitive pay

  • 100% employer paid HDHP insurance premiums for employees

  • 401(k) with company match

  • HSA and FSA options

  • Dental and Vision insurance

  • Education Assistance (Tuition Reimbursement)

  • Work/Life balance

  • Employee/Family focused culture

  • Gym on site

  • And more!

$147,232.00 - $213,486.00 Individual Compensation to be determined based on the applicant's applicable experience and qualifications balanced against internal equity.

WHO ARE WE?


With more than 115 years of construction experience, Blattner has played a vital role in building America’s critical infrastructure, ranging from railroads and highways to dams and mines. Since 1997, the company has focused on renewable energy solutions and is responsible for some of the most significant solar, wind and storage projects in the U.S. Today, Blattner has installed over 20% of America’s utility-scale wind, solar and energy storage capacity. Blattner Company is the parent company of Blattner Energy and D.H. Blattner & Sons, of which all are members of the Quanta Services family of companies. Company headquarters are in Avon, Minnesota.

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations.

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things.

Role

You will own the UX of ActAI's core app experience. This means designing the end-to-end flows users go through every day - how they start tasks, how they follow along as the AI works, how they stay in control, and how they recover when something goes wrong.

This is a UX role for a HCI product. You need to understand both user needs and AI system behavior well enough to design product flows that feel clear, reliable, and controllable.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own UX for ActAI's core app surfaces across iOS, Android, and web.

  • Design complete user flows for AI-assisted tasks - from intent capture through to task completion, including handoff, progress tracking, and error recovery.

  • Design how the app surfaces what the AI is doing, what decisions it has made, and what the user needs to confirm or adjust.

  • Map and design the full range of AI states a user encounters - loading, thinking, acting, waiting, completing, stalling, failing, and recovering.

  • Work with product, engineering, and ML teams to define user requirements and translate them into concrete design solutions.

  • Conduct usability research to understand where users lose trust, feel uncertain, or disengage.

  • Produce wireframes, user flows, and high-fidelity designs that engineering can build from directly.

  • Contribute to the design system and shared UX patterns for AI app surfaces.

  • Design for both simple everyday interactions and complex multi-step AI workflows within the same product.

What You Will Need

  • Experience as a UX designer on consumer mobile or web apps, with a strong portfolio.

  • Solid skills in user flow design, wireframing, and high-fidelity prototyping in Figma.

  • Ability to design for systems that are asynchronous, non-deterministic, and context-dependent.

  • Clear thinking about user trust, control, feedback, and transparency in AI-driven product experiences.

  • Experience conducting user research and turning findings into design decisions.

  • Comfortable working in fast-moving teams with evolving product scope.

  • Ability to balance simple consumer UX with complex AI system behavior.

  • Good judgment on usability, edge cases, failure handling, and recovery flows.

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product

For design roles, we expect candidates to submit a portfolio as part of the application process.

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 2 rounds of interviews and a design assessment.

Applications are evaluated by our team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

jobs.description:
Real Estate Transaction Coordinator – California Transactions & Compliance | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours
Industry: Residential Real Estate

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a detail-oriented Real Estate Transaction Coordinator to manage the administrative, documentation, and compliance side of California residential real estate transactions.

You’ll support agents from the time a purchase agreement is executed through the close of escrow, ensuring transaction files remain organized, deadlines are tracked, required disclosures and documents are completed, and all parties stay informed throughout the process.

This is an operations-focused role requiring strong organization, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple transactions at different stages simultaneously.

If you understand California real estate transactions and know how to keep files, deadlines, disclosures, and stakeholders organized from contract to closing, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Transaction & File Management

  • Open and manage transaction files from executed purchase agreement through close of escrow
  • Maintain accurate records within the transaction management platform
  • Review contracts, addenda, disclosures, and supporting documents for completeness
  • Maintain organized transaction files according to brokerage recordkeeping and compliance requirements
  • Prepare and organize documents for review, approval, and signature
  • Keep transaction records current throughout the transaction lifecycle
  • Identify missing or incomplete information before it creates delays

Deadlines & Compliance

  • Track critical transaction deadlines, including:
    • Contingency periods
    • Inspection windows
    • Loan contingencies
    • Appraisal contingencies
    • Close-of-escrow dates
  • Proactively monitor deadlines and alert agents when action is required
  • Collect and confirm required California disclosure forms and transaction documents
  • Help ensure files meet California and brokerage compliance requirements
  • Review files for missing signatures, documents, or required information
  • Follow up on outstanding compliance items
  • Maintain accurate documentation throughout the transaction

California Transaction Documentation

  • Work with California residential real estate contracts and disclosures
  • Support documentation involving forms such as:
    • Transfer Disclosure Statement (TDS)
    • Natural Hazard Disclosure (NHD)
    • Seller Property Questionnaire (SPQ)
    • Agent Visual Inspection Disclosure (AVID)
  • Ensure required documents are appropriately collected and organized
  • Monitor transaction files for outstanding documentation
  • Support agents in maintaining complete transaction records

Communication & Coordination

  • Act as a point of contact between:
    • Real estate agents
    • Buyers and sellers
    • Escrow/title officers
    • Lenders
    • Clients
    • Other transaction partners
  • Keep relevant parties informed about transaction progress and outstanding requirements
  • Follow up on pending documents, signatures, approvals, and transaction items
  • Coordinate information between internal and external stakeholders
  • Help keep transactions progressing smoothly from contract through closing
  • Communicate professionally and clearly throughout the transaction lifecycle

Documents & Electronic Signatures

  • Prepare and route transaction documents for electronic signature
  • Use DocuSign, DocuSign Rooms, Dotloop, or similar platforms
  • Track outstanding signatures and follow up as needed
  • Confirm completed documents are properly stored within transaction files
  • Maintain accurate document organization and version control
  • Support agents with transaction-related administrative documentation

Closing & Transaction Support

  • Coordinate additional transaction items such as:
    • Home warranty orders
    • Repair documentation
    • Vendor scheduling
    • Outstanding signatures and approvals
  • Support agents with administrative tasks related to active transactions
  • Monitor outstanding items as transactions approach closing
  • Help ensure required documentation is complete before close of escrow
  • Maintain organized records throughout the closing process
  • Manage multiple active transactions without sacrificing accuracy

Requirements

  • 1–3+ years of experience as a Transaction Coordinator, Escrow Assistant, or in a similar real estate transaction support role
  • Working knowledge of California residential real estate transactions
  • Familiarity with California:
    • Contracts
    • Transaction timelines
    • Disclosure requirements
  • Strong understanding of transaction coordination from executed contract through close of escrow
  • Experience managing multiple transactions, files, and deadlines simultaneously
  • Experience using transaction management and electronic signature platforms
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to proactively track deadlines and follow up on outstanding items
  • Ability to identify missing or incomplete transaction documentation
  • Ability to work independently without constant supervision
  • Comfortable communicating with agents, clients, lenders, escrow/title teams, and other transaction partners

A California Real Estate License is not required for this role.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting multiple real estate agents or a full brokerage team
  • Experience with DocuSign Rooms, Dotloop, or similar transaction management platforms
  • Experience working with California disclosure forms such as:
    • TDS
    • NHD
    • SPQ
    • AVID
  • Previous experience coordinating with escrow/title companies
  • Experience working directly with lenders and other transaction partners
  • Experience working within a real estate brokerage or transaction coordination environment
  • Bilingual Spanish/English communication skills

Tools & Technology

DocuSign | DocuSign Rooms | Dotloop | Transaction Management Platforms | Electronic Signature Tools | Real Estate Documentation Systems | Email | Calendar & Scheduling Tools

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Are highly organized and comfortable managing multiple deadlines simultaneously
  • Have hands-on familiarity with California residential real estate transactions
  • Pay close attention to details and quickly identify missing or incorrect information
  • Understand the importance of documentation and compliance
  • Proactively follow up without needing constant supervision
  • Communicate clearly and professionally with agents, clients, and external partners
  • Are comfortable working with contracts, disclosures, transaction documents, and real estate systems
  • Can stay calm and organized while managing transactions at different stages
  • Take ownership of your work
  • Understand that small documentation or deadline errors can create larger transaction issues

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may begin by reviewing active transaction files and identifying upcoming contingency, inspection, appraisal, loan, or closing deadlines.

You could then review newly executed contracts, organize disclosures, prepare documents for electronic signature, follow up on missing paperwork, and update transaction files.

Throughout the day, you’ll communicate with agents, escrow/title officers, lenders, clients, and other transaction partners to ensure outstanding requirements are addressed.

As transactions approach closing, you’ll monitor remaining documentation and administrative items to help ensure files stay organized and transactions continue moving forward.

In short: you keep California real estate transactions organized, compliant, documented, and moving from executed contract through close of escrow.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Accuracy and completeness of transaction files
  • On-time tracking of transaction deadlines
  • Timely collection of required documents and disclosures
  • Reduced missing or incomplete documentation
  • Consistent follow-up on outstanding items
  • Accurate electronic signature and document routing
  • Smooth coordination between agents and transaction partners
  • Timely escalation of potential deadline or compliance issues
  • Ability to manage multiple active transactions simultaneously
  • Organized files through close of escrow

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Hands-on involvement throughout the California residential transaction lifecycle
  • Ownership of transactions from executed contract through close of escrow
  • Work directly with agents, lenders, escrow/title teams, clients, and other transaction partners
  • Exposure to California-specific disclosures and transaction processes
  • Fully remote working environment
  • Opportunity to deepen expertise in real estate operations and compliance
  • Potential career growth into:
    • Senior Transaction Coordinator
    • Lead Transaction Coordinator
    • Real Estate Operations Coordinator
    • Transaction Operations Manager
    • Brokerage Operations Manager

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Initial Screening with Pavago
  4. Client Interview
  5. Final Selection & Onboarding

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you have experience as a Transaction Coordinator, Escrow Assistant, or real estate transaction professional and understand California residential real estate transactions, disclosures, deadlines, and close-of-escrow processes, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and help keep real estate transactions accurate, organized, compliant, and moving smoothly from contract to closing.

​​We are seeking an experienced ServiceNow ITOM & CMDB Architect to lead the design, implementation, optimization, and governance of ServiceNow IT Operations Management (ITOM) and Configuration Management Database (CMDB) capabilities.

This role will be responsible for establishing a scalable and sustainable CMDB foundation, implementing ServiceNow Discovery and Service Mapping, defining the Configuration Management strategy, and ensuring that infrastructure and application data can be effectively leveraged across ITSM, ITOM, Security, Asset Management, and AIOps capabilities.

The ideal candidate combines deep ServiceNow technical expertise with strong IT infrastructure, CMDB, configuration management, and enterprise architecture experience. The individual must be comfortable operating at both the strategic/architectural level and the hands-on technical level.

Key Responsibilities

ITOM & CMDB Architecture

  • Define the overall ServiceNow ITOM and CMDB architecture and roadmap.
  • Establish CMDB architecture aligned with ServiceNow CSDM principles.
  • Define CI classes, attributes, relationships, identification rules, reconciliation rules, and data ownership.
  • Develop standards for CI lifecycle management, naming conventions, data quality, and governance.
  • Design CMDB integration architecture across infrastructure, applications, cloud, network, security, and asset management platforms.
  • Establish the relationship between CMDB, Asset Management, ITSM, ITOM, CSDM, and Service Mapping.

ServiceNow Discovery

  • Lead the implementation and optimization of ServiceNow Discovery.
  • Configure and troubleshoot Discovery schedules, credentials, MID Servers, probes, sensors, patterns, and discovery behavior.
  • Develop Discovery strategies for:
  • Windows/Linux servers
  • Databases
  • Network devices
  • Cloud infrastructure
  • Virtual environments
  • Storage
  • Applications
  • Containers/Kubernetes
  • Identify and resolve Discovery gaps and inaccurate CI population.
  • Establish Discovery coverage and data-quality metrics.

Service Mapping

  • Design and implement ServiceNow Service Mapping.
  • Build application and business service maps.
  • Establish mapping standards and service ownership.
  • Configure and troubleshoot horizontal and top-down discovery.
  • Develop application dependency models that support Incident, Problem, Change, Impact Analysis, and AIOps use cases.
  • Partner with application and infrastructure teams to validate service relationships.

CMDB Data Quality & Governance

  • Establish a sustainable CMDB governance model.
  • Define CMDB data ownership and accountability.
  • Establish data-quality KPIs, including:
    • Completeness
    • Correctness
    • Compliance
    • Uniqueness
    • Relationship accuracy
    • CI freshness
  • Establish processes for duplicate CI remediation.
  • Develop CMDB Health and Data Manager strategies.
  • Define CI lifecycle processes from creation through retirement.
  • Establish governance for manual versus automated CI creation.

CSDM

  • Lead adoption of the Common Service Data Model (CSDM).
  • Define appropriate CSDM classes and relationships.
  • Establish alignment between:
    • Business Services
    • Technical Services
    • Application Services
    • Business Applications
    • Application Components
    • Infrastructure CIs
  • Develop CSDM maturity roadmap.
  • Ensure CMDB architecture supports enterprise service management and future ServiceNow capabilities.

Integrations

  • Architect CMDB integration with enterprise technologies such as:
  • Microsoft Azure/AWS
  • VMware
  • Active Directory
  • SCCM/MECM
  • Intune
  • ServiceNow Asset Management
  • Monitoring platforms
  • Endpoint management platforms
  • Network management platforms
  • Security platforms
  • Enterprise application repositories

  • Generally, requires a bachelor’s degree and 8 years of related experience, a master’s degree and 6 years of related experience, or 11 years of related experience and no degree.
  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in ITOM configuring Discovery and building Service Maps
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience establishing foundational Configuration Mgmt Database (CMDB).
  • Demonstrated experience designing enterprise – scale CMDB solutions.
  • Strong understanding of IT Infrastructure and enterprise technology environments.
  • Experience with cloud technologies, particularly Azure and/or AWS
  • Strong understanding of ITIL and Configuration Mgmt processes.

Minimum Years of Experience

  • Certified Technical Architect (CTA) certification preferred

As part of the hiring process, candidates will be required to verify and provide documentation demonstrating the required ServiceNow certifications, licenses, or credentials.

About Collectly

Collectly is a fast-growing healthcare technology company transforming revenue cycle management (RCM) through AI-driven automation. Millions of patients navigate inefficient billing systems every day, while providers face delayed payments, rising administrative burden, and operational complexity.
Collectly applies artificial intelligence to automate workflows, accelerate cash flow, and modernize the patient financial experience; enabling healthcare organizations to operate more efficiently and focus on delivering care.
There could not be a hotter space to play in. Healthcare is a $4.9T industry and is adopting AI technology at 2.2x the rate of the rest of the economy. RCM is at the heart of this transformation as it has a clear and demonstrable ROI to our customers.

The Opportunity

We are hiring a Strategic Account Executive to drive high-impact enterprise revenue during a critical phase of growth.
The role is focused on sourcing, developing, and closing complex six and seven figure deals with large healthcare organizations. You will own a defined set of strategic accounts and operate as a senior deal leader. The ideal candidate is capable of navigating complex buying committees, diagnosing deeply rooted revenue cycle challenges, and building compelling business cases that resonate at the executive level.
This is not a transactional sales role. It is designed for a seller who thrives in long, consultative sales cycles, brings discipline to opportunity strategy, and can consistently win in complex, multi-stakeholder environments.
You will partner closely with leadership, product, and marketing to expand our presence within large healthcare systems and deliver measurable value to the organizations we serve.

Key Responsibilities

    Lead Complex Deal Strategy:

  • Operate as the quarterback for complex, multi-threaded opportunities involving numerous stakeholders and decision makers.
  • Develop clear win strategies, champion maps, and executive alignment plans.
  • Navigate procurement, legal, security, and compliance processes typical within large healthcare organizations.
  • Maintain disciplined deal execution through structured opportunity planning and internal collaboration.

    • Elevate Discovery and Value Diagnosis:

  • Conduct high-quality discovery that surfaces operational challenges across the revenue cycle.
  • Diagnose workflow inefficiencies, patient billing friction, and revenue leakage that impact healthcare organizations.
  • Translate these insights into compelling ROI and operational improvement narratives that resonate with executive buyers.
  • Position Collectly as a strategic partner in improving the patient billing experience while helping healthcare organizations collect what they are owed.

    • Build and Maintain Strategic Pipeline:

  • Develop and maintain a healthy pipeline of strategic opportunities through targeted outbound activity and account planning.
  • Partner with Sales Development and Marketing to penetrate priority healthcare systems.
  • Build multi-threaded engagement across clinical, operational, and financial stakeholders within targeted accounts.
  • Maintain disciplined opportunity management and accurate forecasting.

    • Operate with Precision and Accountability:

  • Maintain strong command of pipeline health, opportunity progression, and close plans.
  • Use data to evaluate deal momentum and identify risks early.
  • Collaborate closely with leadership to continuously refine strategic sales motion and execution.
  • Operate with a high degree of ownership over both individual performance and team success.

What Success Looks Like

    Within the first 90 days:

  • Develop a deep understanding of Collectly's platform, buyer personas, and healthcare revenue cycle workflows.
  • Build a clear strategic plan for their assigned territory and target accounts.
  • Establish strong internal alignment with product, marketing, and sales leadership.
  • Create early-stage pipeline within priority health systems.

    • Over two quarters, success includes:

  • Closing strategic six-figure opportunities.
  • Building a predictable pipeline of enterprise healthcare opportunities.
  • Developing strong executive relationships within large health systems.
  • Consistently progressing complex deals with clear strategy and momentum.

Qualifications

    Required

  • 7+ years of B2B SaaS experience selling revenue cycle management technology or solutions within healthcare.
  • Demonstrated success closing 6-7 figure contracts in multi-stakeholder sales environments.
  • Proven ability to navigate complex healthcare buying processes including finance, IT, compliance, and procurement.
  • Strong enterprise sales methodology experience (MEDDPICC, Challenger, GAP selling, or similar).
  • Consistency in meeting or exceeding quota in strategic or enterprise sales roles.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently drive complex opportunities from discovery through close.
  • Alignment with Collectly's GTM Values:
  • We are owners - we have humility and put the team first.
  • We know our numbers - we are data-driven and understand how to impact our business internally and our customers' business externally.
  • We are AI powered - we automate easy repetitive tasks and research so we can solve harder problems and have a greater impact.
  • We are one with the Buffalo - we expect that there will be challenges along the way and, like the Buffalo, we confront these challenges head on by running INTO the storm.

Core Competencies

  • Deep expertise in enterprise qualification and deal strategy.
  • Strong discovery and diagnostic skills in complex operational environments.
  • Ability to build executive-level business cases that quantify financial and operational value.
  • Highly disciplined pipeline management and forecasting capabilities.
  • Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management.
  • High ownership with strong internal collaboration.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced startup environment.
  • Deep curiosity and a growth mindset.
  • Experience with a modern sales technology stack.

Preferred

  • Experience selling directly into health systems, IDNs, or large healthcare provider organizations.
  • Background selling revenue cycle, patient financial experience, or healthcare workflow automation solutions.
  • Experience in early-stage or high-growth startup SaaS companies.
  • Familiarity with AI-driven or automation technology within healthcare operations.

Why You'll Love It Here

  • Unlimited PTO: We believe in work-life balance and encourage you to recharge when you need it.
  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Fully paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your dependents, because your well-being matters to us.
  • Equity Opportunities: Share in our success with stock options - your hard work will drive our growth.
  • Retirement Planning Made Easy: Enjoy a 401(k) with a generous company match to secure your future.
  • Student Loan Support: We help lighten the load with contributions toward your student loans.
  • Compensation Range: This role offers a competitive on-target earnings package with a strong base salary, uncapped commission, and meaningful equity - designed to reward top performers closing complex, high-value strategic deals.

jobs.title: Head of Marketing
jobs.excerpt: Zenara Health — Head of Marketing AI-Native Healthcare SaaS · Remote (India-based) · Full-time · US-overlap hours About the Company Zenara Health is an AI-powered psychiatric practice platform built by a psychiatrist, for psychiatrists.
jobs.description:
Zenara Health — Head of Marketing

AI-Native Healthcare SaaS · Remote (India-based) · Full-time · US-overlap hours

About the Company

Zenara Health is an AI-powered psychiatric practice platform built by a psychiatrist, for psychiatrists. We are changing how psychiatric care is delivered — giving clinicians a comprehensive clinical picture before every first appointment, automating the revenue their practice has always been entitled to, and building the care-management infrastructure that keeps patients supported between visits.

We are an early-stage company with real customers, a product in market, and a founding team that has been in this industry for twenty years. We earn revenue from real customers from day one — this is not a burn-the-cash, monetize-someday startup. If you want to build a marketing function that actually matters, this is the role.

About the Role

As Zenara's Head of Marketing, you will own the full commercial marketing function — from brand and positioning to demand generation, PR, events, customer retention, and team leadership. You will manage a Digital Marketing Manager from day one and build the team from there.

This is a hands-on leadership role: you will set the strategy and you will do the work, at least in the early stage. We are looking for someone equally comfortable building a messaging framework and running a campaign in Instantly. We already have strategic leadership in place — what we need is someone who can execute that strategy at an exceptional level and bring the expertise to hone it. You should be the person who can tell us "this channel won't work as well as LinkedIn for psychiatrists, here's the spend it takes to land 10 doctors, and here are the campaigns that get us there."

This role is based in India and focuses on the US behavioral-health market. A solid understanding of American healthcare buyers, psychiatric concerns, and how to present AI-powered tools to skeptical clinical audiences is essential. You will work US-overlap hours and communicate fluently with American healthcare professionals.

This is a marketing role, not a sales role — we have a separate sales motion. As the business scales and our leadership structure evolves, this role has a path to grow in scope and seniority.

Reporting line: This role sits within the commercial leadership team and reports to the Head of Commercial, who leads the GTM and marketing function. You will work closely with Ravi Hariprasad (Founder & CEO) on clinical messaging and product narrative, and with the GTM lead on sales alignment and pipeline. You will have a direct report from day one and are expected to grow the team as the business scales.

What You Will Own

Product marketing is the core of this role. The following areas sit alongside that core — you own the full function.

1. Growth & Demand Generation

Own the strategy, execution, and performance of marketing initiatives that create qualified top-of-funnel demand.

  • Develop and execute online and offline campaigns (content, email, events, partnerships, conferences).
  • Lead top-of-funnel lead generation in collaboration with sales and leadership.
  • Build and manage campaign calendars aligned with product launches, ICP segments, and sales priorities.
  • Monitor and report ROI by channel and campaign (cost, conversion, pipeline impact).
  • Continuously experiment, iterate, and improve messaging and channels based on performance data.

2. Positioning & Messaging

Develop credible, distinct narratives for psychiatrists, practice managers, and healthcare operators. Convert technical AI features into clinical value propositions. Every piece of material should answer: "Why should a psychiatrist care?"

3. Go-to-Market Execution

Launch new products, features, and services with clearly defined target profiles, use cases, and proof points. Produce a full suite of GTM collateral — one-pagers, pitch decks, case studies, ROI calculators, sales-enablement tools, and prospect documents — each engaging, concise, and clinically relevant.

4. Sales Enablement

Create pitch decks, case studies, ROI narratives, battle cards, objection-handling guides, and demo scripts. Equip the sales/GTM team with everything they need to close.

5. Content Strategy

Own the editorial calendar, thought-leadership program, and product narratives across blogs, emails, and social. Define themes, direct the Digital Marketing Manager on execution, and ensure cohesive messaging across all channels.

6. PR & Media Relations

Build Zenara's external narrative, secure coverage in psychiatric and health-tech publications, and manage the founder's thought-leadership profile.

7. Conferences & Events

Own the salon kit, booth strategy, lead capture, and post-event follow-up. APA and future conference presence is a significant part of the commercial motion.

8. Customer Experience & Retention

Own post-acquisition engagement with our pioneer and Flow customers, the onboarding journey beyond the first call, and community health.

9. Brand & Voice

Own the Zenara brand voice, visual-identity standards, and consistency across all channels and materials.

10. Competitive Intelligence

Track the behavioral-health technology market, build battle cards, identify differentiation, and feed insights into product and GTM strategy.

11. Web & Landing Pages

Write conversion-focused copy with design and SEO. Manage website content, optimize landing pages, and ensure the site clearly articulates value and drives conversion.

12. Performance Tracking

Own funnel metrics, campaign ROI, content performance, and website conversion. Optimize on outcomes, not assumptions.

13. Customer Storytelling

Interview customers, extract compelling stories, and turn them into case studies and success narratives that show real-world value.

Your First 90 Days

  • Weeks 1–2: Immerse in Zenara's products, customers, and competitive landscape. Review current materials and interview customers to understand their motivations and challenges. Meet your direct report and assess the existing marketing function.
  • Month 1: Develop the core positioning and messaging framework. Create initial sales-enablement materials. Begin building the content calendar and themes. Design the first demand-generation campaign. Set the priorities and operating cadence for your team.
  • Months 2–3: Launch the first batch of content (blogs, case studies, updated web copy). Run the first demand-gen campaign and track performance. Establish measurement frameworks. Begin regular competitive tracking and market research. Start shaping the team-growth plan.
  • Ongoing: Refine positioning from market feedback. Expand the content library. Support sales with targeted materials. Optimize campaigns through ROI analysis. Take on increasing ownership of overall marketing strategy as the team grows.

Values & Vibe (Who You Are)

  • You see marketing as clarity, conversion, and demand generation — not creativity for its own sake.
  • You excel at interpreting complex technical products and expressing them in terms that resonate with buyers, then building the programs that convert positioning into pipeline. You find feature-led, outcome-blind marketing inadequate.
  • You write for the buyer, not yourself. You know psychiatrists care less about "AI-powered LLMs" and more about reducing documentation time to increase patient interaction.
  • You have marketed to healthcare professionals and understand the dynamics of clinical buyers. You balance technical credibility with approachable messaging and have launched products in regulated sectors.
  • You are a strong writer — persuasive, succinct, and correct. You can craft a one-pager that fully engages.
  • You measure your work and optimize on data, not opinion.
  • You know that in healthcare, offline channels (conferences, field partnerships, provider networks) matter as much as digital ones.
  • You command AI rather than being commanded by it. You use AI tools to multiply your output — you are not someone who cuts and pastes from a model all day. In this era, raw intelligence and the ability to be a peer with the best AI tools is what sets the bar.
  • You operate both strategically and executionally. You set direction and you do the work.

What Success Looks Like

  • Clear, resonant positioning that connects with target buyers — confirmed by sales feedback.
  • GTM materials the sales team actually uses, regularly.
  • Active demand-generation programs that yield qualified top-of-funnel leads.
  • Rigorous campaign ROI tracking — you know cost per lead, conversion rates, and pipeline impact by channel.
  • A consistent, high-quality content calendar across blogs, emails, and social.
  • A website that communicates value and drives conversion.
  • Case studies and customer narratives that show real-world outcomes.
  • Competitive intelligence that meaningfully informs product and GTM.
  • Materials that meet clinical review standards — accurate, credible, compliant.
  • A marketing function — and a team — that is stronger, more strategic, and more effective than when you joined.

Requirements

Requirements

Required

  • 8+ years in B2B SaaS marketing, with a track record of positioning and launching products to enterprise/clinical buyers, operating at a senior, full-function level.
  • Experience owning or significantly driving demand generation / campaign-led growth — you've designed and executed programs that generate pipeline, not just collateral.
  • Experience managing at least one direct report — this is a people-management role from day one.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate both strategically and executionally — you set direction and do the work.
  • Full-funnel marketing experience across content, email, paid, events, and PR.
  • Experience running or contributing to PR and media relations — building brand narrative beyond owned channels.
  • Experience with conference and event marketing — booth strategy, lead capture, field marketing (healthcare preferred).
  • Experience marketing to US healthcare buyers (providers, practices, health systems) — solid grasp of the buyer journey and clinical decision-making.
  • Fluency with marketing performance metrics (CAC, conversion, funnel drop-off, ROI by channel) — you track, analyze, and optimize on data.
  • Excellent writing — compelling, concise, clinically relevant copy. (Please include a writing sample with your application.)
  • AI-fluent — you actively use AI tools to multiply your output and quality.
  • Undergraduate /Post graduate degree from a top-tier institution (IIT / IIM / BITS / NIT / equivalent top-20 Indian institute, or comparable global institution).
  • Willingness to work US-overlap hours (IST evenings) and communicate fluently with American healthcare professionals.
  • Strong written and asynchronous communication — clear briefs, positioning docs, and campaign plans.

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience building a marketing function from scratch (or near-scratch) at an early-stage company.
  • Experience in behavioral health or mental health.
  • Background marketing AI/technology products to clinical audiences.
  • Familiarity with psychiatric or behavioral-health clinical context — you understand what a psychiatrist cares about without needing it explained.
  • Experience with community marketing or customer-retention programs.
  • Familiarity with HubSpot or other marketing-automation platforms.
  • Understanding of healthcare compliance (HIPAA, clinical-accuracy standards).
  • Experience managing multi-channel campaigns (content, email, paid, events).

Nice to Have

  • Basic design skills for quick collateral (Canva, Figma).
  • SEO and content-marketing experience.
  • Video content and webinar experience.
  • Prior experience at a startup (Series A or earlier).

Process

  • Initial fit screen (US-overlap comfort and basics).
  • A short case/campaign exercise — e.g., "Build a digital marketing campaign to attract 300 psychiatrists to Zenara Assess in 30 days" — presented to the hiring team.
  • Final fit and depth interviews with leadership.

Schedule

Evening IST hours with 4–8 hours of daily overlap with US Pacific (9am–5pm PT).

Benefits

Compensation & Benefits

  • Compensation: ₹50–70 LPA, based on skills and experience.
  • Remote work anywhere in India.
  • Equipment allowance.
  • Locally recognized holidays (India).
  • Flexible paid-time-off policy.
  • Direct access to founder and commercial leadership.
  • The opportunity to build — and lead — a marketing function from the ground up.

Full-Stack Developer

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

We are looking for a Full-Stack Developer with strong experience in TypeScript, React, Next.js, and Postgres to build and ship features across a modern client portal.

You’ll own features from design through production, working across the frontend, backend, database, and integrations as needed. This is a hands-on role where you’ll be expected to think beyond the happy path, build reliable features, and improve the codebase as you go.

You’ll work closely with a small engineering and product team, receiving fast feedback and having significant ownership over what you build.

What You’ll Own

End-to-End Feature Development

  • Take features from design prototype through production
  • Build frontend interfaces using TypeScript, React, and Next.js
  • Handle route handlers, database migrations, emails, and UI as part of a complete feature
  • Work across candidate profiles, roles and candidates pages, interview flows, billing, and other portal features
  • Ensure features are production-ready rather than focused only on the happy path

Data & UI Resilience

  • Build features that handle real-world data and edge cases
  • Account for empty states, error states, long names, lengthy CVs, and multiple applications
  • Ensure UI states are clear, intentional, and user-friendly
  • Identify potential edge cases before they become production issues
  • Improve existing features when you identify reliability or usability gaps

Testing & Code Quality

  • Write automated tests for areas that currently lack coverage
  • Add regression coverage for new features and important workflows
  • Keep the codebase stable and maintainable
  • Identify and resolve issues discovered through testing or code review
  • Leave each area of the codebase better than you found it

Database & Backend

  • Write and review Postgres migrations
  • Work confidently with SQL, joins, and database relationships
  • Read and reason about row-level security policies
  • Maintain predictable Supabase Auth and Realtime behavior
  • Understand how frontend, backend, and database changes work together

Third-Party Integrations

  • Work with integrations such as Stripe, Resend, Workable, and SparkHire
  • Connect third-party services to product features when required
  • Troubleshoot integration-related issues
  • Read and understand the existing Python FastAPI service when features interact with AI or data functionality

Code Review & Collaboration

  • Write clear and well-documented pull requests
  • Provide enough context for reviewers to understand and approve changes efficiently
  • Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback
  • Progress toward reviewing API and database migration pull requests independently
  • Collaborate directly with engineering and product team members in a fast feedback environment

Requirements

  • 2–4 years of experience shipping production TypeScript and React applications
  • Strong experience with Next.js, ideally including App Router, Server Components, and Route Handlers
  • Solid understanding of SQL and relational databases
  • Ability to write joins, read migrations, and understand database relationships
  • Understanding of Postgres and row-level security concepts
  • Experience building production-ready UIs with thoughtful empty, loading, and error states
  • Experience working in a monorepo or codebase where features span frontend, backend, and database layers
  • Experience writing and maintaining automated tests
  • Familiarity with pull requests and modern code-review workflows
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills
  • Ability to own features independently from requirements through deployment
  • Strong written communication and attention to detail

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience with Supabase
  • Experience with Stripe or Resend
  • Experience working with Workable or SparkHire integrations
  • Familiarity with Python and FastAPI
  • Experience with unit or integration testing
  • Experience working with AI or data-focused backend services
  • Experience using tools such as CodeRabbit or similar AI-assisted code review tools
  • Previous experience working in a small, fast-moving product team

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

  • Can take a feature from a brief to production without needing every task broken down
  • Think about migrations, edge cases, testing, and integrations alongside the UI
  • Care about how features behave with real-world data
  • Communicate proactively when you encounter blockers
  • Welcome feedback and use it to improve your work
  • Are comfortable working across both frontend and backend systems
  • Prefer shipping small, reliable improvements consistently
  • Take pride in leaving the codebase cleaner and more stable than you found it

What Success Looks Like

  • Features move efficiently from design to production
  • New functionality works reliably across real-world data scenarios
  • Strong automated test coverage across key areas of the portal
  • Database migrations and security policies remain reliable and well-structured
  • Pull requests are clear, focused, and easy to review
  • Third-party integrations work consistently across product workflows
  • Bugs and edge cases are identified and addressed proactively
  • The codebase becomes more stable and maintainable over time

Typical Day

Your day may start with a design prototype, feature request, or product comment. You’ll work across the stack to turn that requirement into a production-ready feature—writing the database migration, building the UI, implementing the route handler, connecting required integrations, and adding tests.

Other days may involve fixing an edge case that surfaced in production, such as a candidate with multiple applications causing an unexpected issue in a list view. You’ll investigate the problem, implement the fix, test it, and deploy the improvement.

The team operates with a tight feedback loop, so expect short standups, direct collaboration, and most decisions to happen through comments and pull requests rather than lengthy meetings.

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application Review
  2. AI Rating & Recruiter Screening
  3. Technical/Client Interview
  4. Final Selection & Onboarding

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things.

Role

As an Applied AI Engineer, you will turn model capabilities into real product behavior. You will own problems end-to-end, from shaping model behavior, to building the systems around it, to ensuring it performs reliably in production.

This role sits at the intersection of machine learning, systems, and product, focusing on making AI actually work for users, not just in demos, but in real-world usage.

Focus

  • Build and ship AI features end-to-end (model → system → user experience)

  • Design and iterate on prompts, tools, memory, and agent workflows

  • Turn raw model outputs into structured, reliable, and predictable behaviors

  • Debug issues across the full stack (model, orchestration, infra, UX)

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning. jobs.title: Senior Organic Search Strategist (Remote, £38-41k)
jobs.excerpt: Ellipsis is emerging as a market leader in “GEO” for B2B technology companies.
jobs.description:
Ellipsis is emerging as a market leader in “GEO” for B2B technology companies. This is a high-impact, varied role in a fast-moving and ambitious agency.

The transition to AI search has put a lot of the SEO industry on the back foot. Ellipsis has always been consultative/strategic in our approach; we started building AI search products in 2021 on GPT-2, and thus this has been a time for us to thrive.

Today, we think we have a better understanding of AI search than almost anyone else. We have the tracking product (built in-house), the data (~25 million AI answers for analysis, with more tracked weekly), and the execution end-to-end from strategy, to writing, to in-house design, to optimization, and performance reporting.

As our newest Senior Organic Search Strategist, you will own the organic search strategy for your own portfolio of clients: deciding what work we do, when we do it, and why. You’ll be a strategic partner who understands each client’s goals, requirements, and position in the market, and who turns that understanding into a programme of work that our Content, Writing, and Design teams can execute -- and that actually helps the client win.

We have an increasingly varied (and growing) portfolio of clients, and are adding a second senior strategist to the team to support that growth, provide our sales team with more strategic support with prospective clients, and continue improving our understanding and execution of AI search strategy. It is an exciting time to join us.

What you’ll do

The Senior Organic Search Strategist role is varied, fast-paced, and requires excellent strategic judgement. You’ll be responsible for a mixture of big-picture strategy across your client portfolio and hands-on strategic deliverables -- everything from minor content updates to full-site technical SEO audits -- giving you both the perspective to set direction and the depth to know exactly what it takes to execute it.

Ellipsis’ understanding of AI search is cutting edge, and we have proven experience of ensuring our clients win. The heart of this role is doing just that -- you’ll own the organic search strategy for a portfolio of clients, and shoulder the responsibility for ensuring we recommend and execute the right work, at the right time, for each of them.

Our Content Managers own day-to-day client relationships and delivery, but you’ll join client calls alongside them to present strategy, explain performance, and make the case for a course of action. You’ll need to be confident building a clear, evidence-based argument, presenting it to multiple stakeholders, and handling challenge or pushback appropriately live on calls.

In practice, the role breaks down into five areas:

1. Owning client strategy

You’ll plan -- and ensure we effectively execute -- GEO strategies for your portfolio of clients. This starts with deeply understanding each client: their goals, their requirements, their position in the market, and how we can help them win. From there, you’ll translate that understanding into a clear programme of work, brief it into our Content and Writing teams, and keep it pointed at the outcomes the client actually cares about.

We are strategic partners to our clients, not the type of agency where the answer is always “do more content”. A large part of your judgement will go on knowing when to stick with an established strategy and when to pivot -- and on being able to explain that reasoning to the client either way.

2. Piloting our technology

Ellipsis has built its own proprietary technology for AI search, and our strategists are its primary pilots. You’ll use our tooling day-to-day to identify the right work for each client at the right time, and you’ll be expected to feed back on what works (and what doesn’t) so we can get better faster. The tooling does the groundwork; your judgement is what turns its output into a recommendation worth making.

3. Driving performance

You’ll be across performance for every client in your portfolio -- not just reporting on it, but proactively driving forward the optimizations that will improve it. When a page underperforms, a competitor moves, or an AI engine changes how it cites, you’ll be the first to spot it and the one with a plan for what we do next.

4. Supporting our sales team

You’ll support our sales team with strategic data and analysis for prospective new clients. This means quickly grasping what a prospect needs and how we can deliver it, then providing the sales team with the information they need to present this in a compelling way. Speed matters here: a sharp, well-evidenced strategic view early in the process is often what wins the work.

5. Hands-on strategic work

Alongside the big-picture strategy, you’ll carry out both routine and in-depth strategic work for your clients. Routine work includes minor content updates, analysis of existing pages, and handling ad hoc queries and requests from clients; in-depth work includes full-site technical SEO audits, CRO audits, and similar. You’ll need to be comfortable moving between the two, managing your time effectively, and hold yourself to the same high standard on both.

At Ellipsis, we pride ourselves on continuous improvement. As a senior member of the Strategy team, you’ll be right at the heart of how we turn research into recommendations, and will have the opportunity to have a significant impact in shaping and improving our strategic playbook, our tooling, and our processes as we continue to grow. If you’re obsessed with -- and skilled in -- working out what will actually move the needle for a client, and then making it happen, this could be a dream role for you.

Requirements

We’re looking for an experienced strategist who can own the direction of a client account and be trusted to make -- and defend -- the calls that go with it. We’d expect at least 4-5 years of experience in SEO, organic search strategy, or a similar client-facing strategic role, ideally in an agency or consultancy environment. Beyond this, strong analytical skills, a critical eye for data and processes, and the confidence to make a clear recommendation from imperfect data are hard requirements.

You’ll need to be confident in getting up to speed fast on unfamiliar B2B and SaaS topics, and in translating a client’s commercial goals into a programme of search work that will actually deliver against them. Hands-on experience with technical SEO audits and CRO is a strong advantage.

A working understanding of GEO -- and a genuine curiosity about how AI search actually works -- is expected at this level. But, as we’ve said, we think we currently have a stronger understanding of AI search than almost anyone else! So what we’re really looking for is somebody with a strong fundamental understanding of organic search, but also an eagerness to learn, a willingness to look at problems differently, and the ability to move quickly.

Strong critical thinking is a must-have at Ellipsis! If the data doesn’t support the strategy, or a client is asking for work that won’t move the needle, you’ll need to be confident in saying so -- and in proposing a better path. We are looking for candidates who can spot gaps or friction within our current processes and systems, and help drive forward improvements.

As a 100% remote team, we carefully balance collaboration with an environment that enables everyone to do their best work. You’ll communicate with the team through Basecamp (our project management software) and Google Meet, and with clients through Slack, Email, and video calls, so strong communication skills are critical. The majority of the team is located in Europe, and we have clients all over the world. You’ll thus be expected to regularly attend meetings between 9am–5pm GMT, with occasional calls outside these times.

Beyond the above, the ideal candidate will be able to demonstrate the following soft skills:

  • Confident, evidence-led communicator: You can make a complex strategic case simply, to clients and colleagues alike, and hold your ground constructively when it’s challenged.
  • Receptive to feedback with no ego and solutions-oriented: You can take a constructive critique, act on it, and get better. At Ellipsis, continuous improvement is more important than being right.
  • High level of self-awareness, a “people person”: You’ll be dealing with clients and members of the team on a daily basis, so this is an integral part of the role.
  • Self-driven work ethic: You need to be self-motivated, proactive, and see projects through to completion.

Benefits

Compensation

  • This is a full-time, 100% remote role. You’ll be a full team member, and involved in our team projects, work, and meetups.
  • Competitive salary with pension benchmarked to UK rates and based on experience.
  • £38-41k/year salary, depending on experience.
  • 28 days of paid holiday
  • An additional 1 paid holiday day a year with each year of tenure, up to a maximum of 5 additional days.
  • 4-day work week, once a month.
  • Genuinely flexible working.
  • Regular team retreats (~1 per year); last was Istanbul, previously in Edinburgh, Oxford, Madrid, and Budapest.
  • Time and budget for learning and development.
  • Enhanced maternity/paternity leave, and sick pay.

Application process

It’s important we find the best candidate for this position, and our selection process will reflect this. You’ll be required to attend at least three interviews (by video call) and carry out a (paid) freelance project with us before we make an employment offer.

Much of our company Wiki is externally accessible, and you’re encouraged to read through this before applying. We have a very useful guide to our interview process available here. This tells you what we’re looking for and reading this will significantly increase your chance of success!

Please apply through Workable: . We will decide who progresses to the next stage based on the form you submit, your cover letter, and your CV. Please give us a good reason to select you! Taking the time to research the role, what we’re looking for, what we do, and what you can do for us will increase your chance of success. Your cover letter is where you have the space to do this.

Whilst we love AI and sit at the leading edge of its adoption, we want to hear from you rather than from ChatGPT. Your application is where we want to see how you think, in your own words.

The deadline for submission is the end of the day, on 30th September 2026. We’ll be in touch with all candidates following the close of applications.

We do great work for clients and are building an ethical business that lets everyone do their best work. If you think you could be the next person to join our team, please apply!

We are looking for a talented UI/UX Designer to design and implement easy-to-use designs for the new features of our app. It would also be a great plus if you have created assets for Unity games before.

UI/UX Designer responsibilities include gathering user requirements, designing graphic elements and analyzing our mobile app and proposing redesigning parts of it, as well as designing new features. To be successful in this role, you should have experience with design software and wireframe tools. If you also have a portfolio of professional design projects that includes work with web/mobile applications, we’d like to meet you.

In this role, you will get to be on the front lines of an early-stage venture-backed startup! You will have the autonomy to make your own decisions regarding which part of the app need more work in our Android and iOS apps, and grow with the company. Ultimately, you’ll create both functional and appealing features that address our user’ needs and help us grow our user base.

Responsibilities:

  • Gather and evaluate user requirements in collaboration with product managers and engineers

  • Understand product specifications and user psychology to develop user scenarios, task flows, wireframes, prototypes, and mockups to effectively conceptualize and communicate detailed functions, interactions, and workflows

  • Support design solutions by establishing company brand standards, creating and maintaining detailed design documentation, demonstrations, and artifacts, aiding in the cross-functional implementation of design initiatives including style guides, leading the standardization of fonts, colors and images

  • Contribute to the utilization, evolution, and maintenance of foundational UX frameworks and touchpoints, including: user personas, key user journeys, and key performance indicators on relevant initiatives that help drive research, testing, and design parameters

  • Create surveys for research through various media platforms to gather feedback on user's ease of use and satisfaction interfacing on company websites and products. Identify and Find creative and elegant ways to solve UX problems (e.g. usability, affordability, responsiveness)

  • Tracking the impact of your work via guest feedback and data insights to help the team identify opportunities for continued iteration

  • Conduct A/B testing and adjust designs appropriately based on user feedback and product analytics

  • Staying abreast of competitor products, industry trends and best practices for UX design and processes, and for any project, gathering sufficient information to support appropriate UX design for the given platform and technology, and sharing the knowledge among the team.

  • Design the aesthetics and graphic user interface elements, like menus, tabs and widgets. Create original graphic designs (e.g. images, sketches and tables).

  • Help Agile UX processes by interacting with Product Management and development team by driving end-to-end interaction design: collaborating in the design of the information architecture and defining how the user navigates and interacts with the product.

  • Create project deliverables that clearly and persuasively communicate the UX strategy and the reasoning behind it. These deliverables include: project plans, discovery findings, research protocols, research findings, personas, task lists, workflows, wireframes, page maps, interaction and behavior specifications, and anything else required to describe UX plans and strategies.

  • Translate industry-related data and topics into engaging visuals and graphics

  • Create visual designs for marketing material such as newsletters, email templates, and campaigns

  • Design mobile game assets and pass them on to Unity developers to be used in games.

  • Other duties as assigned

Required Skills and Experience

  • Demonstrated talent in creating and implementing UI/UX design, service design, information architecture or equivalent experience in a related field (psychology, engineering, data analytics, etc)

  • Eye-catching portfolio showcasing a high level of craft with a strong foundation in visual and interaction design, demonstrating user design experience best practices

  • Up-to-date knowledge of design software like Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop

  • Experience creating storyboards and web/mobile mapping and working knowledge of wireframe tools (e.g. Figma and InVision)

  • Experienced in prototyping, user testing and analysis

  • Expertise in human interface guidelines, standards, and best practices as they apply to platforms

  • Highly detailed communication of design principles as well as UX/UI guidelines

  • Strong communication and storytelling skills

  • An ability to articulate design decisions with grace, logic and data

  • Experience in data driven design by developing, evaluating, and producing results from test and learn processes

  • Experience presenting research and testing findings and solution recommendations

  • An ability to influence strategy by engaging product and engineering partners

  • Ability to prioritize and manage several milestones and projects efficiently

  • Account for challenges using problem-solving skills and seek to optimize data for the best possible outcome

  • Experienced building simple clean interfaces for complex products

  • Experience working in products that engage users with a complex underlying workflows and processes

  • Continued education and research into UX trends and current design strategy and technologies

  • Be open to receiving feedback and constructive criticism

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Experience working in an Agile development environment

  • Familiar with realtime 3D game editors such as Unity, Unreal, or similar.

  • Experience with gaming products and Unity assets

  • Experience using web and mobile analytics tools, such as Google Analytics, Firebase Analytics, MixPanel

  • Familiar with programming languages such as Javascript, C#, or similar for UI scripting.

Our app allows people to compete with each other playing simple games like replicas of Candy Crush, Tetris, Beer Pong etc. all within one app. What's special with our app is that we send the winner their money via PayPal! We also organize eSports tournaments, where many users can compete to win a big cash prize. We are a small team, and work 100% remotely!

We are seeking a mission-driven Data Scientist to join our growing Stars team, with a primary focus on CAHPS (Consumer Assessment of Healthcare Providers and Systems) — the member experience survey component of our Star Ratings strategy. This role is responsible for modeling member survey response and satisfaction behavior, identifying the operational and service drivers behind CAHPS measure performance, and translating those insights into targeted interventions that move specific Star Rating cut points.

This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of healthcare, member experience, and survey methodology — directly shaping the strategy behind one of the most influential and least understood components of the Star Ratings program.

  • Collaborate with Stars, member experience, and operations leaders to understand CAHPS performance drivers and translate them into analytical solutions.
  • Segment members by likelihood to respond to the CAHPS survey and by predicted satisfaction, to prioritize outreach and intervention.
  • Build and fine-tune models predicting member-level risk of low CAHPS domain scores, including Getting Needed Care, Getting Appointments and Care Quickly, Customer Service, Care Coordination, Rating of Health Care Quality, and Rating of Health Plan.
  • Analyze item-level CAHPS survey data, not just composite or domain scores, to isolate which specific survey questions are driving measure performance.
  • Build pipelines that track CAHPS survey administration cycles — sampling, fielding, and response rates — and validate case-mix adjustment logic against CMS/NCQA methodology.
  • Model statistical significance and year-over-year variance to distinguish genuine performance shifts from survey noise or sampling error.
  • Coordinate with CAHPS survey vendors on sampling methodology, fielding timelines, and case-mix adjustment specifications.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to version, test, and deploy models using Git, CI/CD pipelines, and virtual machine (VM) environments.
  • Partner with member experience, call center, provider network, Compliance, and Legal teams to ensure CAHPS-related data outputs and interventions align with CMS guidance.
  • Build dashboards tracking measure-level CAHPS performance against Star Rating cut points and prior-year trend for each domain.
  • Help standardize definitions, documentation logic, and reporting workflows to scale CAHPS analytics enterprise-wide

By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions.
