Join Us as a Clinical Research Associate – Make an Impact at the Forefront of Innovation

We have successfully supported the top 50 pharmaceutical companies and more than 750 biotechs, spanning 2,700 clinical trials across 100+ countries in the last 5 years.

As part of our global team, you’ll have the opportunity to perform and coordinate all aspects of the clinical monitoring and site management process. As a Clinical Research Associate (Level II), you'll conduct remote or on-site visits to assess protocol and regulatory compliance and manage required documentation. You will manage procedures and guidelines from different sponsors and/or monitoring environments (i.e., FSO, FSP, Government, etc.). Acting as a site processes specialist, you will ensure that the trial is conducted in accordance with the approved protocol, ICH-GCP guidelines, applicable regulations, and SOPs to guarantee subjects' rights, well-being, and data reliability. You will ensure audit readiness and develop collaborative relationships with investigational sites. Detailed tasks and responsibilities assigned to your role are outlined in the task matrix.

This role is for experienced, independent monitors with experience completing onsite visits regionally across the US. Up to 75% travel is a requirement.

What You’ll Do:
• Monitors investigator sites with a risk-based monitoring approach: applies root cause analysis (RCA), critical thinking and problem-solving skills to identify site processes failure and corrective/preventive actions to bring the site into compliance and decrease risks. Ensures data accuracy through SDR, SDV and CRF review as applicable through on-site and remote monitoring activities. Assess investigational product through physical inventory and records review. Documents observations in reports and letters in a timely manner using approved business writing standards. Escalates observed deficiencies and issues to clinical management expeditiously and follow all issues through to resolution. May need to maintain regular contact between monitoring visits with investigative sites to confirm that the protocol is being followed, that previously identified issues are being resolved and that the data is being recorded in a timely manner. Conducts monitoring tasks in accordance with the approved monitoring plan. Participates in the investigator payment process. Ensures a shared responsibility with other project team members on issues/findings resolution. Investigates and follows-up on findings as applicable.
• Participates in investigator meetings as necessary. Identifies potential
• investigators in collaboration with the client company to ensure the acceptability of qualified investigative sites. Initiates clinical trial sites according to the relevant procedures to ensure compliance with the protocol and regulatory and ICH GCP obligations, making recommendations where warranted. Performs trial close out and retrieval of trial materials.
• Ensures that required essential documents are complete and in place, according to ICH-GCP and applicable regulations. Conducts on-site file reviews as per project specifications.
• Provides trial status tracking and progress update reports to the Clinical Team Manager (CTM) as required. Ensures study systems are updated per agreed study conventions (e.g. Clinical Trial Management System).
• Facilitates effective communication between investigative sites, the client company and the PPD project team through written, oral and/or electronic contacts.
• Responds to company, client and applicable regulatory requirements/audits/inspections.
• Maintains & completes administrative tasks such as expense reports and timesheets in a timely manner.
• Contributes to the project team by assisting in preparation of project publications/tools, and sharing ideas/suggestions with team members.
• Contributes to other project work and initiatives for process improvement, as required.

Education and Experience Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in a life sciences related fieldor a Registered Nursing certification or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualification.
• Previous experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (comparable to 1 years as a clinical research monitor) or completion of PPD Drug Development Fellowship.
• Valid driver's license where applicable.
In some cases an equivalency, consisting of a combination of appropriate education, training and/or directly related experience, will be considered sufficient for an individual to meet the requirements of the role.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

• Proven clinical monitoring skills

• Demonstrated understanding of medical/therapeutic area knowledge and medical terminology
• Demonstrated ability to attain and maintain a working knowledge of ICH GCPs, applicable regulations and procedural documents
• Well-developed critical thinking skills, including but not limited to: critical mindset, in-depthinvestigation for appropriate root cause analysis and problem solving
• Ability to manage Risk Based Monitoring concepts and processes
• Good oral and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with medical personnel
• Ability to maintain customer focus through the utilization of good listening skills, attention to detail and the ability to perceive customers’ underlying issues
• Good organizational and time management skills
• Effective interpersonal skills
• Attention to detail
• Ability to remain flexibile and adaptable in a wide range of scenarios
• Ability to work in a team or independently as required
• Good computer skills: solid knowledge of Microsoft Office and the ability to learn appropriate software
• Good English language and grammar skills
• Good presentation skills

Working Conditions and Environment:
• Work is performed in an office/ laboratory/clinical/and/or home office environment with exposure to electrical office equipment.
• Frequent drives to site locations. Frequent travel, generally 60-80% but more for some individuals. May also include extended overnight stays.

Checkmarx is the AI-powered application security leader helping the world’s most security-conscious enterprises secure the software that powers modern life. We’re trusted by 1,600+ customers in 70+ countries, including some of the largest enterprises and governments in the world. Guided by research-led innovation and a developer-first mindset, we help every developer, security team, and enterprise build software that is risk-free by design.

About the Role

As a Customer Success Manager (CSM), you'll be the trusted advisor who ensures our clients don't just adopt Checkmarx; they thrive with it.

You'll own the client relationship end-to-end, driving adoption, measurable value, and long-term partnership across some of the most security-conscious enterprises in the world.

This role is for someone who loves building relationships, solving problems before they escalate, and turning product usage into real business outcomes.

What You'll Do

  • You'll serve as the primary point of contact for your client portfolio, building relationships from the practitioner level to the executive suite. You'll understand what success looks like for each client and make sure Checkmarx solutions map directly to their business goals.

  • You'll keep a close eye on usage trends, sentiment, and health indicators, stepping in early to resolve issues and manage escalations with calm, clear communication.
  • You'll be the connective tissue between Support, Technical Account Management, Product, Training, Professional Services, and Account Management, giving each team the context they need to deliver for the client.
  • You'll run tight, purposeful client meetings, keep documentation current, and continuously look for ways to improve how we deliver success, sharing client trends and feedback back into Product.
  • You'll build deep working knowledge of the Checkmarx platform relevant to your clients, and use your understanding of the application security landscape to guide smarter conversations and recommendations.

Requirements

What You Bring

  • 2-4 years of experience as a Customer Success Manager (CSM) in enterprise SaaS

Teletherapist (child, family, adult):

Full-time, Part-Time (minimum of 7 sessions per week)

Are you ready to make a career move that is exciting, challenging, and rewarding? Are you interested in joining a progressive company that provides teletherapy throughout Virginia and beyond? Well, we have that opportunity if you are licensed in the state of Virginia as an LCSW, LPC, or LCP! **Those with clinical licenses in multiple states are encouraged to apply.**

if you are considering, or have tried, to have your own private practice, MySpectrum will continue to provide you with all the perks without the headaches. With our Teletherapist position, you can work from home with a steady stream of clients and steady income. You focus on your clinical work while we handle the rest!

MySpectrum offers outpatient counseling and coaching to children and adults, focusing on the Autism Spectrum, Substance Abuse Spectrum, Mental Health Spectrum, and Whole Life Spectrum. We work with every person, on every spectrum and are seeking skilled Therapists throughout the state of Virginia who are interested in providing teletherapy to our clients. If you don't specialize in any one area, but find yourself to be an out-of-the-box thinker and relationship-driven Therapist who can engage clients virtually, this may be the fit you are looking for. We are seeking a diverse group of Therapists who enjoy their work, like to have fun, and are passionate about offering the most creative and innovative ways to treat clients. We want to serve clients who haven't otherwise been able to find the right fit for therapy, who don't fit the mold of other practices who have more narrow focuses, who may have barriers to getting to an office for therapy, and most of all, want to reduce the stigma associated with receiving therapy. If you have a special niche, and are wanting to find a place where you can build an established client base from your own home or office, we look forward to hearing from you. **Instead of worrying about building your own private practice, we will do that for you.** In addition to having remote locations through teletherapy, we have a home office in North Chesterfield, VA, where you can visit and obtain in-person support.

Some of the aspects of being in private practice that we will take care of for you at MySpectrum include:

  • Credentialing with insurance carriers
  • Billing (you get paid on a bi-weekly basis regardless of if we do)
  • A teletherapy platform that integrates with an electronic health record
  • Marketing
  • Scheduling

  • Provide therapy virtually in standard 45-60 minute blocks
  • Complete Assessments

  • Complete Progress Notes

  • Experience working with diverse populations
  • Desire to be a part of a growing company by offering input, thoughts, and considerations for how to best meet the needs of our clients. We all are a team and each person's input is valued; we expect those who join us to be willing to contribute to our overall growth!
  • Flexibility to commit to joining us now, and the drive to stick with us so that your caseload can grow
  • **Must have high-speed internet access
  • **Must have HIPAA protected space to use on a consistent basis for sessions
  • **Must be comfortable working remotely and seeing clients via telehealth

Benefits and Perks:

  • You can create your own hours
  • Work from home or from your own office
  • You can live anywhere in the state of Virginia
  • Competitive compensation based on a 60/40 split (bi-weekly pay based on sessions conducted, not on what we have collected from insurance; you receive 60% of what we bill insurance regardless of if we get paid)

  • Retirement planning with up to 3% company match
  • Casual environment that promotes fun and creativity
  • A therapy practice where you don't have to worry about the business aspects! Just be a Therapist!

Windchill Integration Developer - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

Job Title: Windchill Integration Developer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$180,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.


Job Summary:
We are seeking an experienced Windchill Integration Developer to design, build, and operate integrations connecting PTC Windchill with ERP, MES, CAD, and other engineering and manufacturing systems. In this role you will own the technical integration layer between Windchill and the broader enterprise systems landscape. The ideal candidate will bring deep hands-on Windchill integration experience and a strong understanding of enterprise integration patterns, middleware platforms, and PLM-to-ERP data flows. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.
Key Responsibilities
  • Design and develop integrations between Windchill and ERP systems (SAP, Oracle EBS, Oracle Cloud) using Info*Engine, web services, and middleware platforms.
  • Build CAD integrations for Creo, SolidWorks, AutoCAD, Catia, and NX with Windchill, including check-in/check-out workflows and metadata mapping.
  • Develop integrations between Windchill and MES, MOM, and quality systems.
  • Build REST and SOAP services for Windchill data using OData, Info*Engine, or custom Java services.
  • Implement message-based and event-driven integrations using middleware (MuleSoft, Boomi, OIC, SAP CPI).
  • Design and operate robust error-handling, alerting, and resubmission patterns, applying disciplined engineering practices and partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure outcomes are durable, well-documented, and aligned with broader team and platform standards.
  • Profile and optimize performance of high-volume integrations, applying systematic measurement, targeted improvements, and data-driven validation to deliver quantifiable gains in throughput, latency, or resource efficiency.
  • Lead migration efforts to retire legacy point-to-point integrations and replace them with modern, middleware-mediated patterns, planning phased cutovers, building backward-compatibility shims where needed, and ensuring each migration step is reversible and well-monitored.
  • Collaborate with PLM, ERP, and CAD functional teams to align integrations with business processes.
  • Develop integration documentation, message specifications, and runbooks, applying disciplined engineering practices and partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure outcomes are durable, well-documented, and aligned with broader team and platform standards.
  • Provide hands-on post-go-live and hypercare support, working closely with operations teams to triage incidents quickly, identify root causes, and drive durable fixes that improve long-term system stability.
  • Mentor and coach junior and mid-level engineers through code review, design review, pair programming, and structured knowledge sharing, helping the broader team grow in technical maturity and confidence over time.
  • Continuously evaluate emerging integration tools and patterns, assessing maturity, fit for purpose, and total cost of ownership, and make grounded recommendations on which to adopt, pilot, or defer based on real engineering needs.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of PLM integration experience with a strong focus on Windchill.
  • Hands-on experience with Info*Engine and Windchill Java API.
  • Experience designing PLM-to-ERP integrations (SAP, Oracle).
  • Working knowledge of CAD integration patterns.
  • Experience with middleware platforms such as MuleSoft, Boomi, OIC, or SAP CPI.
  • Strong SQL skills and familiarity with Windchill data model.
  • Experience with REST and SOAP web services.
  • Excellent troubleshooting and documentation skills.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • PTC Windchill certifications.
  • Experience with ThingWorx or IIoT integration.
  • Exposure to API management platforms.
  • Familiarity with event-driven and Kafka-based integration patterns.
  • Experience operating Windchill in the cloud.

jobs.excerpt: More than one million people in the United States today are fighting blood cancer.
jobs.description:
More than one million people in the United States today are fighting blood cancer. While a traditional allogeneic stem cell transplant has been the best hope for many, the transplant itself can prove fatal or lead to serious conditions, such as graft vs. host disease. Orca Bio is a commercial-stage biotechnology company redefining the transplant process by developing next-generation cell therapies with the goal of providing significantly better survival rates with dramatically fewer risks.With our purified, high-precision cell therapies we hope to not only replace patients' blood and immune systems with healthy ones, but also restore their lives.
Position Summary: the Senior Director, Field Market Access will report to the Head of Market Access and lead our high-performing team of U.S. Payer Account Directors. This team is responsible for expanding patient access, removing reimbursement barriers, and supporting TREGZI’s revenue and profitability goals.

This leader will provide strategic direction to maximize TREGZI’s access and value across payer and customer segments. The role will oversee field market access execution, payer strategy, the product value proposition, and tactical planning to support continued commercialization and lifecycle management. The Senior Director will also establish performance metrics and lead internal and external access and disease-education strategies.

Responsibilities

    • Lead the U.S. Payer Account Director team, establishing clear priorities, performance expectations, and account engagement strategies.
    • Ensure market access insights and perspectives are integrated into brand strategy, commercialization plans, and lifecycle management objectives.
    • Evaluate healthcare market trends that may affect product access, reimbursement, pricing, and contracting strategy.
    • Direct and execute pricing and access strategies for TREGZI and potential future indications, including reimbursement analysis and, when appropriate, contracting and discount strategies.
    • Develop pre- and post-launch market engagement strategies that effectively communicate the brand’s value proposition and support patient access.
    • Lead market access analytics and evaluate team and business performance against defined KPIs.
    • Partner with Medical Affairs and other stakeholders to anticipate evolving payer evidence requirements and develop long-range evidence strategies.
    • Recruit, develop, and retain a high-performing team while fostering a results-driven, customer-focused, and collaborative culture.
    • Develop and manage operating budgets consistent with corporate financial objectives.
    • Ensure compliance with corporate policies and procedures and all applicable U.S. healthcare laws and regulations.

Qualifications

    • Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or other advanced degree preferred.
    • 10+ years of relevant market access experience, including experience leading high-performing payer or field market access teams.
    • Comprehensive knowledge of the U.S. healthcare system, payer landscape, reimbursement environment, and related access challenges and opportunities.
    • Deep functional expertise in market access, pricing and contracting, lifecycle management, and the integration of patient access and support services.
    • Strong financial and analytical capabilities.
    • Demonstrated success developing scalable, customer-focused market access strategies.
    • Strong understanding of the commercialization process, reimbursement integration points, and clinical development.
    • Commercial experience across areas such as marketing, sales, product launches, pricing, or contracting.
    • Prior cell therapy or stem cell transplant experience.
    • Ability to travel as required.
The anticipated annual salary range (listed above) for this job is based on prior experience in the role/industry, education, location, internal equity, and other job-related factors as permitted by law. For remote-based positions, this range may vary based on your local market. Full-time employment positions will also be eligible to receive pre-IPO equity and annual bonus, in addition to competitive medical, dental, and vision benefits, PTO, 401(k) plan, life and accidental death and disability coverage, and parental leave benefits. Other perks include subsidized daily lunches and snacks at our on-site locations.

Who we are

We are driven by a passion for science and compassion for patients. We act with urgency to ensure our treatments are one day accessible to all who need them.
We live by our core values of passion, courage, and integrity. Excellence in our work means the chance to unlock a better quality of life for our patients, and with that comes tremendous responsibility.
We innovate on a path that hasn’t been paved. We embrace an entrepreneurial spirit and take calculated risks to achieve our mission. We aren’t afraid to ask “why not” and challenge the status quo.
We maintain a start-up culture of camaraderie and leadership by example, regardless of title.
We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and recognize that celebrating our differences creates stronger, lasting solutions that better serve our team, our patients and their healthcare providers.

Highlights:

About Fundraise Up

We’re Fundraise Up - a global fundraising platform built to make donating to nonprofits fast, seamless, and accessible to all. Every month, our technology powers tens of millions of dollars in donations across the globe. We focus on innovation that directly impacts results: faster load times, higher conversion rates, global payment support, and accessibility-first design.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading nonprofits, including UNICEF, the Alzheimer’s Association, and a wide range of global NGOs. With a 4.9/5 rating across top software review platforms, we’re recognized not just for our impact - but for the quality of the product we deliver.

A Truly Global Product

We operate in the enterprise segment, serving nonprofit organizations across North America, the United Kingdom, Australia, and Europe.

We’re building a large and complex product ecosystem that serves nonprofits, donors, and partners around the world. The platform includes a modern checkout experience and customizable widgets (each a standalone SPA), donor, organization, and partner portals, admin tools, and several internal apps.

The Team

We are a distributed team of 160+ product professionals, including 80+ engineers. Our team members are mainly based across Spain, Poland, Portugal, Georgia, Armenia, Serbia, Turkey, and Cyprus. Despite our scale, we operate like a focused team — where every task matters and every voice is heard. We value thoughtful collaboration, strong engineering practices, and a product mindset.

About the Role

You'll run the programs employees feel most directly: payroll, variable compensation, equity, and benefits, across every country, entity, and contractor arrangement we operate in. You'll bring order to a complex, distributed environment — building calendars, controls, and processes that make sure people get paid accurately and on time, every time. This is a hands-on role for someone who traces issues to the source rather than passing them along, and who builds systems other people can trust.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end global payroll delivery for employees and contractors, ensuring payments, deductions, reimbursements, and changes are accurate, timely, compliant, and reconciled.
  • Calculate and validate variable compensation and bonuses for executives and non-GTM employees, coordinating finalized inputs, payroll execution, controls, and reconciliation with the GTM variable-pay partner.
  • Build and run a global payroll calendar with clear cutoffs, review cycles, approvals, funding timelines, and reimbursement service levels.
  • Design and administer equity and long-term incentive programs — grants, vesting, exercises, terminations — maintaining accurate records and cap-table integrity in partnership with Finance and Legal.
  • Own global benefits administration across markets, covering statutory and supplemental programs while balancing employee value, compliance, and cost.
  • Monitor benefits utilization, market competitiveness, employee feedback, and spend; recommend changes supported by data.
  • Own payroll and equity data integrity across BambooHR, Justworks, Remote, and Carta, including workflows, integrations, permissions, and reporting.
  • Manage global employment operations, including EOR/PEO relationships from a payroll perspective, own provider governance — contracts, funding, service levels, reconciliations, escalations, and periodic performance reviews.
  • Identify recurring failure points and manual work across these programs and implement sustainable fixes rather than workarounds.

Skills and Qualifications

Must-have:

  • 7+ years of progressive experience across global payroll, total rewards, benefits, HRIS, or people operations, with meaningful ownership of multi-country payroll.
  • Demonstrated experience managing direct-entity, EOR/PEO, and contractor populations across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Hands-on experience calculating bonuses or variable compensation and building review and approval controls.
  • Experience designing or administering equity and long-term incentive programs.
  • Experience auditing an HRIS (e.g., BambooHR), including data governance, workflows, permissions, integrations, and reporting.
  • Working knowledge of payroll compliance, equity tax considerations, audit requirements, and stock-based compensation accounting concepts such as ASC 718.
  • Evidence of improving complex or manual processes in a scaling, distributed organization.

Nice to have:

  • Familiarity with equity platforms such as Carta, Shareworks, or Pulley.

You'll Thrive Here If You…

  • You trace a discrepancy to its root cause instead of accepting the first explanation.
  • You'd rather build the calendar and the checklist than answer the same question twice.
  • You treat a payroll error as your problem to close out, not someone else's to escalate.
  • You ask the clarifying question before the work starts, not after it's wrong.
  • You can explain a stock-comp technicality to an executive in one sentence they'll actually remember.
  • You hold sensitive employee information with real discretion, not just a policy about it.
  • You'd rather fix the process than route around it one more time.
  • You're comfortable owning ambiguity across payroll, equity, benefits, and systems in the same week.

Compensation

  • The compensation range for this role is: €3,500 - €4,000 gross per month.
  • Final compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, skills, qualifications, and alignment with the role's requirements.

Vice President of Finance
Location: Remote / United States
Department: Finance
Reports To: Executive Leadership


Position Overview:
We are looking for an experienced, highly capable Vice President of Finance to take ownership of our financial strategy and operations across both the United States and Mexico.
This is a senior-level position for someone who can operate independently, identify opportunities and risks, and provide leadership with clear financial insight to support business growth and decision-making.
The ideal candidate is self-sustaining, strategic, analytical, and hands-on. We are looking for someone with significantly more experience than a traditional finance specialist—someone who can build processes, analyze the business, challenge assumptions, and develop financial strategies rather than simply report on historical results.

Key Responsibilities:
* Lead financial strategy and planning for operations in both the U.S. and Mexico.
* Oversee budgeting, forecasting, cash-flow management, financial reporting, and financial analysis.
* Develop financial models and provide recommendations to executive leadership.
* Analyze profitability, operating costs, revenue trends, and opportunities for improvement.
* Establish and monitor financial KPIs and provide regular reporting to leadership.
* Support strategic decisions involving staffing, expansion, investments, pricing, and operational growth.
* Identify financial risks and develop strategies to mitigate them.
* Evaluate the financial impact of business initiatives and provide recommendations before major decisions are made.
* Help optimize the financial relationship and flow of funds between U.S. and Mexico operations.
* Work closely with accounting, payroll, HR, operations, and executive leadership.
* Improve and establish financial processes, controls, reporting structures, and internal procedures.
* Ensure financial information is accurate, timely, and useful for decision-making.
* Coordinate with external accountants, CPAs, tax professionals, banking partners, and other financial advisors as needed.
* Monitor compliance considerations affecting U.S. and Mexico operations in coordination with appropriate professional advisors.
* Identify opportunities to improve margins, reduce unnecessary expenses, and increase financial efficiency.
* Provide leadership with forward-looking analysis rather than simply historical financial reporting.
* Take ownership of financial projects and initiatives from beginning to completion.

What We’re Looking For:
* 8+ years of progressive finance, accounting, FP&A, or financial leadership experience.
* Experience in a senior finance management, Director of Finance, VP Finance, CFO, or similar role.
* Strong understanding of financial strategy, forecasting, budgeting, cash flow, and financial modeling.
* Experience working with U.S. and Mexican financial operations strongly preferred.
* Ability to understand complex financial information and translate it into clear business recommendations.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent Excel/Google Sheets and financial modeling skills.
* Experience working with accounting/ERP and financial reporting systems.
* Strong communication skills in English; Spanish proficiency strongly preferred.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* High level of ownership, accountability, and business judgment.

The Person We’re Looking For
This position is not intended to be a traditional accounting or finance specialist role.
We are looking for someone who can come into the organization, understand how the business operates, identify what needs to be improved, and take ownership of the finance function without needing to be directed through every step.
The right person will be comfortable saying:“Here is what our numbers are telling us, here is the risk I see, here are our options, and here is what I recommend we do.”
We want a strategic financial partner to the executive team—someone who can help us make better decisions as we grow.

Compensation
Compensation will be competitive and based on experience, qualifications, and demonstrated ability. We are open to a mid-to-high market compensation package for the right candidate.

Why Join Us?
This is an opportunity to have a meaningful impact on a growing organization and help shape the financial infrastructure and strategy of operations across two countries.
The person in this role will have significant visibility with executive leadership and the opportunity to directly influence business strategy, growth, and long-term financial performance.

Program Administrative Assistant (Volunteer)

Mothers to Daughters

About Mothers to Daughters:

Mothers to Daughters (M2D) is a 501(c)(3) non-profit dedicated to empowering women across generations through leadership and entrepreneurship training, educational workshops, and networking opportunities. Through intergenerational mentorship and community service, M2D advances gender equality, fosters leadership, and equips women to drive social and economic change in their communities. This handbook outlines our values, policies, and operational procedures to guide team members in fulfilling our mission.

Our Mission at Mothers to Daughters is to accelerate the personal and professional growth of women by connecting them with the lived experiences, authentic insights, and transformative wisdom of successful women. Through intergenerational mentorship, we foster a legacy of economic empowerment, social resilience, and impact-driven innovation, equipping women to lead, innovate, and build sustainable solutions that transcend generations.

Our Vision is a world where women of all generations thrive through the power of intergenerational wisdom, driving inclusivity and gender equity for lasting global impact. By bridging generations, amplifying voices, and breaking down barriers, we aim to create a future where women are elevated to the heights they deserve—leading, innovating, and shaping a more equitable and prosperous world for all.

Our Core Values at Mothers to Daughters are:

  • UnwaveringRespect

    • We honor diverse perspectives and experiences, fostering an environment where every voice is valued.

    • We believe in mutual respect between generations, recognizing the wisdom of experience and the disruptive innovation of youth.

    • We encourage bold yet respectful dialogue in discussions around gender equality, relationships, and personal development.

  • Purpose driven-Trust

    • We prioritize transparency, accountability, and credibility, ensuring that our members, mentors, and sponsors feel confident in our work.

    • We believe trust is the cornerstone of meaningful mentorship, enabling honest, courageous conversations and impactful guidance.

    • We commit to upholding the integrity of our mission, maintaining the highest ethical standards in all our partnerships and programs.

  • Synergistic Collaboration

    • We recognize that transformative change happens when we work together across generations, cultures, and industries.

    • We actively forge alliances with organizations that align with our mission, including men’s groups working toward gender equity.

    • We foster a culture of dynamic knowledge-sharing, ensuring that mentorship is a two-way exchange where both mentors and mentees grow together.

  • Transformational Empathy

    • We understand that each woman’s journey is unique, committing to creating a safe space for shared experiences and personal growth.

    • We recognize societal and personal challenges women face and approach solutions with compassion and pragmatic action.

    • We champion vulnerability as a strength, encouraging open discussions about both breakthroughs and setbacks.

  • Impact-Driven Entrepreneurial Spirit

    • We believe in equipping women with the skills, mindset, and resources to take ownership of their futures—whether through career advancement, leadership, or business ventures.

    • We encourage innovation, agility, and adaptability, ensuring our programs evolve to meet the shifting needs of our global community.

    • We emphasize bold resilience, helping women break barriers, embrace risk, and lead with confidence.

  • Unapologetic Authenticity

    • We embrace and celebrate individuality, encouraging women to bring their whole selves to the table.

    • We champion unapologetic self-expression, ensuring that every woman’s voice is heard, respected, and amplified.

    • We commit to honest, transparent communication, rejecting performative feminism in favor of practical, high-impact actions that drive real change.

  • Future-focused Innovation

    • We embrace bold, transformative thinking, pushing boundaries to create solutions that redefine possibilities for women.

    • We leverage technology, data, and creativity to amplify mentorship, leadership, and economic empowerment initiatives.

    • We foster a culture of continuous learning and reinvention, ensuring that women stay ahead in an ever-evolving global landscape.

Position Overview:

Be involved in projects with our Power Delivery Project Management Team and be a part of a growing organization that meets our clients' objectives and solves their challenges.

This Opportunity

The Project Management Area Lead (PMAL) is responsible for managing the day-to-day activities of the local and/or regional project management team to produce a product consistent with WSP mission statement and our culture. The PMAL is expected to lead by example in adhering to WSP's culture and defined project management and business practices and to achieve the goals of the business plan, maintain WSP's high-quality standards, promote internal teamwork and meet the needs of our clients. The position requires a focus on division goals to enhance client connection, maintain uncompromising quality and build a better future together. Building a team atmosphere is critical to the success of our Department.

Provides project management for the development, execution, management, control and monitoring of high voltage and EHV projects in support of company, regional, and national business line goals. Ensures responsibilities throughout the project lifecycle (proposal phase, planning and project startup, project execution, reporting, and project closeout) are adhered to, delivered, and audited with a level of quality that meets or exceeds corporate and client project excellence and delivery standards. Provides innovation, administration, and pragmatic direction to address current and future project management challenges in a rapidly changing and complex business and operations climate.

As one of the world’s leading professional services firms, WSP now brings world-class expertise in power delivery and project management with the recent acquisition of POWER Engineers, Inc. Our vision is to be the preeminent pure-play global consulting firm for the world’s energy transition. And we need your help.

Your Impact

  • Provide PM leadership for small/medium/large scale/more complex high voltage and EHV projects ensuring support for preparing and overseeing project detailed design, budgets, forecasts, margins and KPIs, monitoring external events and risk contingencies, ensuring satisfactory performance, and managing the contractual obligations to deliver the project or assigned portfolio of assigned project(s) as defined in the contract and client’s expectations.
  • Support the development of and execution of the BU and department recruiting plans. Monitor and address retention
  • Oversee the employee review process for all staff. Perform reviews for all direct reports. Summarize recommendations for position and salary adjustments for all direct reports.
  • Support the preparation, monitoring and execution of PE to PM plans for internal transfers and new external hires. Ensure a strong mentoring relationship is established with all new PM’s
  • Develop and foster effective strategies to engage project stakeholders at all levels, maintain effective relationships, and report on project progress.
  • Provide guidance with pursuit/initiation activities for projects meeting defined criteria or risk profile; including “Go / No-Go” decisions, contract reviews, risk mitigation strategies, pricing reviews, etc.
  • May participate, and at times, leading the contract negotiations and client presentations
  • Actively drive the appropriate levels of technical review required for the project, selecting appropriately qualified staff to perform the required reviews, and adherence to the QA/QC plan.
  • Provide verbal and/or written inputs to multi-disciplinary project teams and contribute to providing high level strategic advice to clients.
  • Manage and provide performance guidance and leadership to assigned staff.
  • Ensure updates occur with system and process documentation including: Risk (REF/RMP), Project Management Plan (PMP), Project Quality Plan (QP), Project Safety (PSP), and Communications Plan where applicable.
  • Lead project kick-off meetings with key stakeholders.
  • Coordinate with area/technical managers to address project resource and subcontracting requirements in a timely manner.
  • Maintain regular communications with the client including reporting on monthly status, safety incidents, and major issues together with scope and budget impacts.
  • Participate in and oversee problem project reviews, providing input about root cause issues and potential solutions. Assist with developing project recovery plans.
  • Ensure regular project reporting and updates are provided to clients, technical areas, and business unit managers, identifying any emergent issues with scope, risk, and/or budget.
  • Complete formal project closeout activities, along with facilitating and documenting a lessons-learned meeting with key project staff.
  • Collaborate with professionals from a variety of disciplines to provide “trusted advisor” service and future ready solutions for clients.
  • Exercise responsible and ethical decision-making regarding company funds, resources and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.
  • Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's in Engineering, Construction Management or other related field within the Power & Energy Market, or equivalent experience in a technical or engineering firm.
  • 15 years of relevant post education experience in a project management role within the Power Delivery/Utility Industry
  • Minimum of 5 years applicable industry experience working and/or providing engineering services for IOUs, IPPs, Co-Ops, Munis, etc.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience leading engineering and/or construction teams on medium to large electrical utility scale clients for high voltage and/or extra high voltage power delivery type projects.
  • Knowledge and experience with project management processes and tools required, including:
    • Contract Management
    • External and Internal Team Meeting Management
    • Earned Value Management
    • Change Management
    • Risk Management
    • Schedule Management (this includes experience with CPM project schedules such as Primavera P6 or equivalent
    • Financial Management
  • Highly proficient understanding of project delivery process within the Power Delivery/Utility industry and strong background and experience in project management.
  • Advanced proficiency with analytical and organizational skills, with business acumen to bridge the business and project management.
  • Advanced proficiency with critical thinking and problem-solving skills to make assessments and calculations involving the application of project management principles, with a sound understanding of intent, impact, and optimal outcomes.
  • Advanced proficiency with interpersonal and communication skills to interact effectively, persuasively, and tactfully with leadership, subcontractors, and employees at all levels of the organization.
  • Excellent self-leadership with attention to detail, multi-tasking, and adjusting readily to the changing prioritization of responsibilities in a dynamic work environment.
  • Works independently and provides guidance and leadership to mid-level to senior level team or project members, with strict adherence to QA/QC.
  • Advanced proficiency with technical writing, office automation, relevant software, MS Office suite products (e.g., Word, Excel, Visio, Project, SharePoint), technology, spreadsheets, and PM tools.
  • Ability to elicit cooperation from a wide variety of sources, including senior management, subcontractors, consultants, and company-wide staff, including those with whom no formal hierarchical relationship exits.
  • Proven track record of upholding workplace safety and ability to abide by WSP’s health, safety and drug/alcohol and harassment policies.
  • Strong ability to quickly adapt to change and demonstrate flexibility to a variety of schedules and hours to meet project-specific needs.
  • Occasional travel is required and travel frequency will depend on client and project-specific requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Essential project management certification (e.g., PMP).
  • PE Licenses
  • Master’s Degree in Engineering, Engineering Management, or Business Administration

WSP Benefits:

WSP provides a comprehensive suite of benefits focused on providing health and financial stability throughout the employee’s career. These benefits include coverage related to medical, dental, vision, disability, and life; retirement savings; paid sick leave; paid vacation (or other personal time); paid parental leave; and paid time off for purposes of bereavement, voting, and/or attendance at naturalization proceedings.

Job Title: Consultant - MedTech Consulting Services

Job Overview

Provides high-quality, on-time consulting support to client projects within the MedTech sector, including medical devices and diagnostics. Assignments range from conducting primary market research, including quantitative and qualitative analysis, to developing strategic recommendations and client deliverables. The Consultant will work closely with cross-functional and global teams, contribute to client-facing presentations, and support the development of actionable insights that help clients make informed business decisions.

This is a 100% remote role with travel limited to an annual team meeting and occasional business needs.

Essential Functions

  • Assists with the review and analysis of client business questions, market challenges, and research objectives to support the development of client solutions.
    • Conducts primary market research and quantitative analyses to identify key findings, trends, and strategic implications for MedTech clients.
    • Supports survey design, data analysis, interpretation of research findings, and synthesis of actionable insights.
    • Develops clear, compelling client presentations and reports using data-driven storytelling techniques.
    • Creates and delivers client-ready project deliverables utilizing established consulting frameworks and methodologies.
    • Collaborates effectively with colleagues and stakeholders across multiple geographies and functions.
    • Demonstrates sound business judgment, problem-solving skills, and the ability to escalate issues appropriately when needed.
    • Builds expertise in MedTech markets, including medical devices and diagnostics, through project delivery and continuous learning.
    • May lead portions of projects or workstreams under the guidance of Senior Consultants, Engagement Managers, or Principals.
    • Contributes to a culture of curiosity, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing across the team.

Qualifications

Required

• Bachelor's Degree required.

  • 3-5 years of related experience required.
    • Experience in consulting, primary market research, MedTech, medical devices, diagnostics, or a related healthcare industry.
    • Demonstrated experience conducting primary market research and quantitative analysis.
    • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and translate findings into business recommendations.
    • Experience developing client-facing reports and presentations using Microsoft PowerPoint.
    • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other analytical tools used for quantitative research.
    • Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
    • Works willingly and effectively with others in and across the organization to accomplish team goals.
    • Knowledge and understanding of the fundamental processes of business, their interaction, and the impact of external and internal influences on decision making, growth, and decline.
    • Knowledge of consulting methods, tools, and techniques.
    • Knowledge of current events and developments within the industry and across major competitors.
    • Knowledge and understanding of the marketplace.
    • Knowledge of professional/trade associations, key people, and companies.
    • Effective time management and project prioritization skills.

Preferred

    • Experience supporting consulting engagements for MedTech clients.
    • Working knowledge of medical device and/or diagnostics markets.
    • Experience working with stakeholders across international regions and time zones.
    • Demonstrated intellectual curiosity and a strong desire to continuously learn, ask insightful questions, and develop expertise across new topics and business challenges.

jobs.excerpt: Working at Omnisend is...  kind of boring.  Not the soul-crushing kind of boring — more like the “no drama, no chaos, just smart people doing great work” kind.
jobs.description:
Working at Omnisend is... kind of boring.
Not the soul-crushing kind of boring — more like the “no drama, no chaos, just smart people doing great work” kind. The kind that lets you focus on what matters, without pointless meetings, micromanagement, or bureaucracy. We’re data-driven. We test, we iterate, we improve. Gut feelings don’t drive decisions — insights do. We trust each other. We’re transparent, give actionable feedback, and honestly listen. No egos, no hand-holding — just a team of experienced professionals moving fast, adapting easily, and delivering impact. Omnisend is customer-funded and customer-driven. Our work is rooted in solving real problems that help ecommerce brands grow. No empty promises — we bring in results. And yes, we have fun. But the grown-up kind — workations, team gatherings, the occasional party. No forced fun, no awkward icebreakers. Just genuine moments with a team that actually enjoys working together.
We are looking for a Deliverability & Compliance Manager with a cross-channel focus and deep SMS
expertise to help protect sender reputation, maintain compliance, and improve customer outcomes across Omnisend’s messaging channels. The primary focus of this role will be SMS operations, including toll-free number and Sender ID verification, 10DLC registration, carrier policies, delivery-receipt analysis, rejection investigation, opt-in and opt-out correctness, provider coordination, and customer-impacting incident resolution.
The role will also contribute to broader Deliverability & Compliance initiatives across email and SMS byimproving shared processes, documentation, standards, escalation workflows, and operational reporting. This is a hands-on individual-contributor role that does not involve people managemen

What you’ll do

  • SMS deliverability and compliance
  • Investigate rejected, failed, delayed, or partially delivered SMS messages.
  • Analyze delivery receipts, provider responses, error codes, carrier behavior, and account
    configuration.
  • Diagnose whether an issue is related to customer setup, content, provider behavior, carrier
    filtering, account security controls, or a potential product defect.
  • Manage toll-free number, 10DLC, Sender ID, and related SMS registration workflows.
  • Review business documentation and identify missing or incorrect information required for
    verification or number porting.
  • Investigate rejection patterns and recommend actions to prevent repeat failures.
  • Apply carrier policies, content restrictions, opt-in requirements, opt-out handling, and suppression
    rules.
  • Coordinate with SMS providers on verification delays, rejected submissions, delivery issues, and
    suspected provider-side incidents.
  • Support customer-impact remediation, including escalation to Billing when provider incidents
    result in failed messages or credit-impacting issues.
    Cross-channel deliverability and compliance
  • Contribute to deliverability and compliance operations across email and SMS.
  • Support email authentication and sender-reputation initiatives involving SPF, DKIM, DMARC,
    domain or IP warmup, bounce monitoring, complaint monitoring, and blocklist prevention.
  • Participate in compliance audits for relevant senders, accounts, and customer cohorts.
  • Identify patterns that affect deliverability across channels and recommend shared controls or
    process improvements.
  • Help establish consistent standards for consent, suppression, sender identity, content
    compliance, escalation, and incident documentation.
  • Apply channel-specific requirements while maintaining a consistent cross-channel operating
    framework.
    Incident investigation and escalation
  • Own complex deliverability and compliance cases from initial investigation through resolution.
  • Prepare concise escalation summaries that include the issue, impact, evidence, root-cause
    hypothesis, requested action, and next steps.
  • Coordinate with Customer Support, Technical Support, Billing, Product, Engineering, Legal or
    Compliance, and external providers.
  • Identify when an issue requires a product fix, provider escalation, policy clarification, customer
    action, or operational workaround.
  • Follow up with responsible teams and confirm that resolution and prevention actions have been
    completed.
  • Contribute to post-incident reviews and ensure that recurring issues are tracked over time.
    Documentation and operational improvement
  • Create and maintain playbooks, SOPs, templates, troubleshooting guides, and escalation
    workflows.
  • Improve the speed, consistency, and quality of SMS registration and approval processes.
  • Standardize internal and customer-facing explanations for common verification, rejection,
    deliverability, and compliance scenarios.
  • Identify opportunities for small operational automations that reduce manual effort, errors, and
    unnecessary handoffs.
  • Turn recurring incidents into prevention measures, product feedback, or process changes.
  • Share knowledge with CX, Deliverability & Compliance, Product, and Engineering teams.
    Communication and stakeholder management
  • Explain technical deliverability and compliance topics clearly to technical and non-technical
    audiences.
  • Provide Customer Support teams with accurate guidance and customer-ready language.
  • Communicate provider delays, verification decisions, compliance restrictions, and technical
    findings in a concise and practical way.
  • De-escalate difficult customer-impacting situations while maintaining policy consistency.
  • Keep stakeholders informed about risks, blockers, progress, and expected resolution paths.

We expect that you’ll bring:

  • Experience in deliverability, messaging operations, SMS operations, telecommunications,
    technical support, compliance operations, trust and safety, or a related field.
  • Strong practical knowledge of SMS registration and deliverability, including toll-free verification,
    10DLC, Sender ID, carrier filtering, delivery receipts, and provider workflows.
  • Familiarity with email deliverability concepts such as SPF, DKIM, DMARC, sender reputation,
    domain or IP warmup, bounces, and complaints.
  • Strong investigation and root-cause analysis skills.
  • Ability to manage complex operational cases from intake through resolution.
  • Experience coordinating escalations across Support, Engineering, Product, Billing, Compliance,
    or external providers.
  • Strong written communication skills and the ability to create clear documentation.
  • Excellent attention to detail when reviewing account information, customer documentation,
    message content, provider responses, and incident evidence.
  • Ability to work independently while maintaining clear stakeholder communication.
  • Good judgment when applying policies and deciding when to escalate.

What we offer in return:

  • Gross salary starting from 3000 EUR/month based on experience
  • An unlimited learning budget for self-improvement complying with the best interest of Omnisend
  • Working methods and best practices inspired by the best tech companies in Silicon Valley
  • Senior colleagues that enable us to have a high-performing, productive environment where your growth will accelerate
  • Private health insurance
  • Remote work possibilities
  • Unlimited access to psychotherapy
  • A workstation budget
  • Personalized work anniversary gifts (house cleaning, spas, international flights & more that you choose depending on the year)
  • Attractive workations and team-led team-building events

We have a fantastic opportunity for an experienced technical and commercially aware Fleet Director to join and lead our national fleet team. This role will remote with national travel.

The Fleet Director will have strong technical knowledge to oversee fleet standards, performance and efficiency. This is a key senior hire responsible for ensuring our ambulances operate safely, reliably and efficiently.

This role must provide technical assurance that our maintenance practices are safe, ensuring consistent and robust SOPs across around 40 fleet assistants nationwide. At the same time they must provide strategic leadership, including fleet planning, upgrade programmes, and continuous improvement to increase reliability and reduce costs.

EMED is a product of several mergers and acquisitions, giving a variety of operating models. In some places maintenance is largely outsourced to local suppliers, while in others we undertake heavy work in-house. This role needs to work with all of these, while determining the right balance and future operating model.

Benefits for the role include

  • Remote with national travel
  • Competitive Salary plus Car allowance
  • 33 days annual leave (inclusive of bank holidays).
  • Life Assurance – providing colleagues and their family financial peace of mind and protection to the value of £5,000.
  • Private Medical Healthcare
  • 24/7 online/telephone GP Consultation and access to prescriptions.
  • 2nd opinion medical support following diagnosis or where a colleague is on a treatment pathway.
  • Cash-plan benefits, providing colleagues the option of protecting themselves in case of illness and recuperation, including dental, optical, chiropody.
  • Access to mental health and physiotherapy consultations.
  • Access to legal advice on domestic issues e.g. motoring offences, wills and probate, and personal injury.
  • Financial guidance re retirement planning, tax savings and state benefits.
  • Long Service Recognition Scheme – recognising colleagues for their continued service after 5 years and at 5-year intervals with an increase in annual leave.

Role Responsibilities

Technical authority for fleet within EMED

  • Be the technical authority and source of assurance for all fleet and equipment maintenance related matters, ensuring safety and compliance
  • Undertake a skills gap analysis and create a training plan to ensure every fleet employee meets appropriate standards
  • Create SOPs and method statements for maintenance activities, ensuring safety and compliance
  • Establish change control methodology to safely and robustly implement change
  • Establish an audit regime
  • Ensure comprehensive incident investigation and learnings, in line with technical best practice
  • Stay up to date with industry and vehicle technology developments

Supporting fleet operations

  • Implement governance structures to scrutinise and support regional fleet teams

  • Lead the EV strategy, including vehicles and charging infrastructure
  • Lead other innovations to support business development
  • Lead the telematics strategy

Fleet administration

  • Lead a team which manages fleet allocation and cascades across the business
  • Lead a team to which ensures all fleet admin tasks, including paperwork and systems, are up to date
  • Support the finance team in overall fleet strategy and procurement planning

Do you have what it takes?

  • Extensive technical and mechanical expertise (eg vans, HGVs, PSVs), with the ability to operate as a subject matter expert
  • Professional engineering or fleet-related qualifications (or equivalent experience)

  • Excellent problem-solving skills
  • Analytical skills

EMED Group is an established healthcare logistics provider that enables access to health and social care through our four specialist divisions. We are one of the largest health and care partners to the NHS with 4,000 colleagues across over 60 bases UK-wide.

jobs.description:
**PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH**

Location: Remote – Latin America
Work Arrangement: Fully Remote (Telecommute)
Employment Type: Full-Time Independent Contractor
Industry: Construction / General Contracting
Compensation:$1,600–$1,900 USD/month
Schedule: Full-Time | Availability to work during U.S. business hours
English Proficiency: Professional written and spoken English required

About the Company

Our client is a U.S.-based construction company specializing in the development of community parks, amenity centers, recreational spaces, monuments, and other outdoor environments for residential developers and communities.

The company works closely with project managers, construction managers, landscape architects, and other industry partners to deliver high-quality projects with a strong focus on execution, cost control, and operational excellence.

As the organization continues to manage a growing portfolio of active construction projects, it is strengthening its financial and project accounting capabilities to provide greater visibility into project performance and costs.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Job Cost Accountant to own the accuracy and integrity of job cost data across an active portfolio of construction projects.

This role is dedicated to project financial performance and will be responsible for running and reviewing job cost reports, maintaining accurate cost coding, reconciling project financial data between Sage 100 and Procore, managing the monthly Work in Progress (WIP) schedule, and partnering directly with Project Managers and Construction Managers.

This is not a passive reporting role. The Job Cost Accountant will be embedded with project teams and serve as a financial partner to operations, helping ensure that costs are accurately captured, forecasts remain current, and project leadership has reliable financial information for decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

Job Cost Reporting & Accuracy

  • Run, review, and distribute weekly and monthly job cost reports from Sage 100 for all active projects.

  • Reconcile Procore commitments, change orders, and invoicing against Sage 100 job cost detail.

  • Identify financial variances and work with project teams to resolve discrepancies at the source.

  • Review cost coding for AP invoices, subcontractor billings, labor, and equipment charges before they close to the job.

  • Identify misallocated expenses and coordinate corrections with the appropriate project stakeholders.

  • Maintain an accurate cost code structure in collaboration with finance and project leadership.

  • Ensure job cost information rolls up accurately for financial reporting, project analysis, and estimating feedback.

Project Management & Construction Management Partnership

  • Conduct formal monthly job cost reviews with Project Managers and Construction Managers.

  • Review budget vs. actual costs, committed costs, job cost detail, and forecast-to-complete estimates.

  • Partner with project teams to identify and correct misallocated expenses.

  • Serve as a primary finance resource for questions related to job costs, cost code selection, and committed cost reconciliation.

  • Escalate recurring coding or accountability issues to finance and project leadership when appropriate.

WIP & Percentage of Completion

  • Own the monthly WIP schedule across all active projects.

  • Maintain accurate calculations for:

    • Cost to date

    • Estimated cost at completion

    • Percentage complete

    • Earned revenue

    • Over/under billings

  • Partner with Project Managers to validate monthly cost-to-complete estimates.

  • Identify and challenge outdated or unsupported project forecasts.

  • Deliver a clean, accurate, and defensible WIP package as part of the monthly financial close process.

Specialized Cost Tracking

  • Partner with project leadership to capture the true cost of specialized construction activities when deeper cost analysis is required.

  • Establish tracking approaches before activities begin, including appropriate cost codes, labor tracking, equipment capture, and reporting structure.

  • Ensure cost information is collected accurately in real time rather than reconstructed after project activities are completed.

  • Prepare actual-cost reporting that can support future estimating, purchasing, project planning, and strategic decision-making.

Systems, Reporting & Documentation

  • Work extensively in Sage 100 and Procore as the primary systems for project cost accounting.

  • Maintain accurate and consistent financial data across both systems.

  • Build and maintain Excel reporting workbooks summarizing job cost, WIP, committed cost, and project financial performance.

  • Use AI-enabled tools and services, where appropriate, to improve reporting, reconciliation, and document review processes.

  • Maintain organized documentation and strong data hygiene across project accounting workflows.

Required Qualifications

  • 3–6 years of job cost accounting experience with a general contractor, specialty contractor, or construction company.

  • Construction industry accounting experience is required.

  • Hands-on experience with construction job costing and project financial reporting.

  • Working proficiency with Sage 100 Contractor or Sage 100 construction job cost modules.

  • Working proficiency with Procore, including commitments, change orders, and invoicing.

  • Experience preparing and maintaining WIP schedules and percentage-of-completion calculations.

  • Strong understanding of cost codes, committed costs, project budgets, actual costs, and cost-to-complete forecasting.

  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookup functions, reconciliations, and reporting workbooks.

  • Experience reconciling financial information across accounting and project management systems.

  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.

  • Ability to identify discrepancies, investigate root causes, and coordinate corrections with operational teams.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

  • Ability to work effectively with U.S.-based finance, project management, and construction teams in a fully remote environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience supporting multiple active construction projects simultaneously.

  • Experience working directly with Project Managers and Construction Managers on monthly financial reviews.

  • Knowledge of construction revenue recognition and percentage-of-completion accounting.

  • Experience with AP coding, subcontractor billing, change orders, commitments, and construction cost controls.

  • Experience using AI or automation tools to improve accounting, reconciliation, or reporting workflows.

What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate will ensure that project financial data is accurate, timely, and actionable. Project Managers and Construction Managers will have a reliable financial partner who understands their projects, WIP reporting will be accurate and defensible, cost coding issues will be identified and corrected quickly, and leadership will have greater visibility into the true financial performance of every active project.

  • This is a remote/telecommute position.

  • Experiência prática em ELT utilizando dbt, Data Lake/Lakehouse e orquestração com Airflow;

jobs.description:
Are you obsessed with owning marketing outcomes, not just marketing tasks?

What if your campaigns didn't just hit a KPI, but shaped how millions of people grow, learn, and act on their potential?

This isn't a "manage an agency and report up" marketing job.

We're not looking for someone who orchestrates other people's execution. We're looking for someone who runs the campaigns themselves, leveraging AI to operate at the scale of a full marketing team.

And you deserve it because you are…

  • 🛠️ You're not "a marketing manager who briefs agencies." You're a builder. You see an opportunity and your hands itch to write the campaign, launch it, and read the results yourself.

  • 🤖 You don't fear AI, you leverage it. Claude Code, prompt pipelines, and automation tools are core to how you work, you treat AI as a team of interns that lets you run what used to require five hires.

  • ⚡️ You'd rather launch a scrappy campaign this week than a perfect plan next quarter. Bias to action is your default setting.

  • 📊 You make decisions with data. You can read performance across channels, kill what doesn't work fast, and double down on what does.

3–5 years under your belt, ready to own marketing outcomes end to end in a startup.

Full-time, remote or Dubai office. French and English fluency required.

About Paradox

WHAT WE DO

At Paradox, we are convinced that greatness is trainable.

That’s why we want to empower people at scale, by leveraging cutting edge technologies like AI, and crafting user experiences with outstanding aesthetics.

We do that by merging :

- Human Intelligence (coaches, peers, and mentors)

- Structured Intelligence (protocols, mental models, rituals),

- Technological Intelligence (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys)

To create one seamless ecosystem: Paradox OS.

OUR BELIEFS

We believe self-help is broken.

Most learning platforms are used the same way : consuming generic theories, getting quick highs, ending with no real change.

At Paradox, we believe people deserve more.

More than content. More than motivation.

They deserve a system that knows them, one that adapts, challenges, and grows with them.

We believe that every human learns differently, and that technology can do more than entertain or save time.
It can translate insight into transformation, through AI personalization, lean experimentation, and deep psychological understanding.

Because learning shouldn’t just make you feel inspired for a day, it should change how you live, think, and create.

OUR VISION

At Paradox, we want to re-invent how people grow.

We do not build another course or coaching app but the Operating System for Greatness.

Founded by David Laroche, a creator followed by over 2 million people and known for his interviews with icons like Tony Parker, Mike Horn, Richard Branson, and Gad Elmaleh, Paradox aims to build something that will live beyond any individual (including its founder), for decades to come.

Our ambition is to compete with players like Mindvalley (150M ARR), but with a sharper vision, grounded protocols for achievers, people who want more for their life, refusing mediocrity.

To do that, we bring together designers, tech, coaches, and filmmakers to create learning experiences that are cinematic, precise, and effective.

We move fast, aim high, and hold ourselves to the standards of Apple, Spotify, and MasterClass. No fluff, focused on meaningful impact.

While others hide their numbers, we want to let our results speak loudly for us.

Get obsessed with transforming our clients’ lives and let those transformations be our marketing.

And that’s where you come in.

YOUR MISSION 🚀

Own marketing performance across channels, not as a coordinator, but as an operator. You set the strategy, but you also execute it, using AI leverage to punch well above the size of your team.

YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  1. Own channel strategy & execution : You set priorities across paid, organic, and lifecycle marketing, and you execute the core of it yourself rather than fully delegating.

  2. Run campaigns hands-on : Briefs, copy, targeting, launch, analysis. You touch the full loop, not just the strategy slide.

  3. AI leverage : You leverage Claude Code daily to build campaign assets, automate reporting, generate creative variations, and run processes that would otherwise require a full team. This is expected, not optional.

  4. Read the data & reallocate fast : You live in GA4, ad platforms, and Looker Studio. You reallocate budget/effort toward what compounds within days, not months.

  5. Coordinate the extended team : You brief and align Growth, Social, and Content Factory efforts so channels reinforce each other instead of working in silos.

  6. Report outcomes, not activity : You bring data-backed recommendations to leadership, not just a status update.

You'll own KPIs: CAC/LTV by channel, pipeline/revenue attributable to marketing, campaign velocity (launches per month).

Desired outcomes: A marketing engine that runs lean, compounds over time, and doesn't require headcount growth to scale output.

DO YOU RECOGNIZE YOURSELF?

Experience

  • 3–5 years in marketing, ideally with both strategic and hands-on execution experience (not pure agency-management background).

  • You can show us what you've built and shipped : tests, landing pages, automations, audiences. Portfolio > pedigree. A scrappy before/after beats a polished CV.

  • You already use AI daily to create leverage and solve complex issues.

Personality

  • Curiosity: You relentlessly dig into why users behave the way they do until you uncover the insight behind the data.

  • Hands-On Execution : you build, you don't just brief.

  • Precision: You care about clarity in hypotheses, clean data, and unambiguous results.

  • Agility: You move fast, adapt instantly to new findings, and turn insights into tests within hours, not weeks.

Language

French: Native / Bilingual

English: Fluent English, you can hold a conversation on specific details with English-speaking colleagues.

Our chosen language for written communication is English.

IT MIGHT NOT BE FOR YOU

  1. You want a strict separation between work and life. Execution speed is our biggest advantage right now. A 9-to-5 mindset guarantees you'll fall behind.

  2. You need clarity, stability, and established process before you can act. We're still building the machine. If you need everything defined before you move, wrong place.

  3. You want to be told exactly what to do. We hire people who bring solutions, not people who wait for instructions.

WHY JOIN US ❤️

Help us market a product that fuses neuroscience, design, and AI to reinvent how humans grow.

Work with filmmakers, psychologists, engineers, and creatives obsessed with impact.

In the heart of our headquarters stands the 100 000 Dreams Wall,

Every photo on that wall is a life rewritten:

“I ran a marathon.”

“I started my company.”

“I found peace with my father.”

You will play a crucial role in the development of an Iconic Product.

Growth & Ambition

-> 🏅Being surrounded by A-players who strive to perform

Impact & Meaning

->Playing a crucial role in the development of a company whose content and products will be used by millions of people

->Waking up in the morning feeling like you are making a difference is something!
We receive messages every day from clients who have successfully lost weight, quit smoking, reach a milestone in their business, built better relationships, and made positive changes in their lives.

-> ❤️ Contributing to the Paradox Foundation (our non-profit), dedicated to empower teenagers

But that's not all, we believe that driven people deserve…

Freedom & Well Being 🗽

-> 😎A company culture based on autonomy & accountability

-> 🗽Flexible working hours

-> 🌎A remote culture from day one with the freedom to work from wherever you want

-> 💻Work on Mac, for us it counts :)

HIRING PROCESS 📃

📃 A 6 to 8 minutes application survey.

💻 A 15-30 minutes video call, to assess the fit between the position, the company, and your own career path.
💻 A video-call focused on your career to review your background & see how we can match your desires with our needs.
💻 Aculture-fit video call to check in depth the alignment between you and our values and culture.
💼 Reference calls to get in-depth insights about how you work in different environments, make your onboarding easier, and give everybody on the team the insurance to be surrounded by A-Players.
🤗 Welcome aboard!

If you’re not joining to tweak landing pages.
If you’re here to engineer behavioral change at scale, for millions.

Welcome to Paradox.

Let’s build the Operating System for Greatness.
