Description

🤓 TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

We're launching a program for experienced engineers transitioning into system architecture roles. The curriculum is being built by a team of senior authors. What we need now is the person who brings it to life for students: hosts the live sessions, reviews the work, runs the architecture review boards, and sets the technical bar for the people supporting alongside you.

This is a teaching and review role. You'll be the senior technical presence the cohort learns from week to week. You'll run live sessions and office hours, give real architectural feedback on student deliverables, and act as the escalation point for a team of supporting instructors who handle first-line questions. The best person for this is someone who has actually designed and shipped systems at scale, has opinions about what good architecture looks like, and can tell an experienced engineer why their design is wrong, not just whether it runs.

Your audience: experienced engineers leveling up to system architecture roles. Many already write production code daily. They will spot shallow feedback instantly, so the bar here is real seniority, not familiarity.

Format: Async-first with scheduled live sessions. Live sessions and office hours are timed around a US-based cohort. Estimated 15 to 25 hrs/week.

Areas of expertise

We will bring on three Experts, each focused on one of the following areas.

Expert A — System Foundations, API & Data

  • Module 1 — Foundations of System Engineering (Architecture principles, OpenTelemetry, distributed systems)
  • Module 2 — API & Service Architecture (REST, GraphQL, gRPC, service boundaries, DDD)
  • Module 3 — Data Architecture & Storage Patterns (SQL/NoSQL, sharding, replication, Redis caching)

Expert B — Cloud, Distributed Systems

  • Module 4 — Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Engineering (Kubernetes, Terraform, GitOps, CI/CD, FinOps)
  • Module 5 — Distributed Systems & Event-Driven Architecture (CAP theorem, event-driven, Kafka, alert routing)

Expert C — Security, AI Systems & Architecture Leadership

  • Module 6 — Security & Compliance Architecture (Zero-trust, threat modeling, compliance, secure CI/CD)
  • Module 7 — AI Systems Design & Integration (LLM integration, RAG, ML reliability, AI governance)
  • Module 8 — Architecture Documentation & Leadership (ADRs, C4 diagrams, technical communication)

Please indicate in your application which area fits you best. If you have overlapping skills, don’t hesitate to apply and indicate it in your application. Submit all resumes or CV's in English.

What you will do

  • Mentor students through 1:1 video calls, Q&A sessions, and group events, helping them clarify concepts and navigate assignments.
  • Host webinars and workshops on program topics, industry insights, and extracurricular skills.
  • Review and assess student projects, providing clear, constructive feedback aligned with program standards.
  • Engage with students on the Hub through written guidance, ongoing communication, and curated learning resources.
  • Share professional expertise to equip students with practical skills and career strategies.
  • Foster a collaborative learning environment that builds confidence, encourages interaction, and supports student growth.
  • Conduct Mock Interviews providing constructive feedback on both their technical responses and interview skills.
  • Record instructional videos for the curriculum, clearly explaining key concepts, methodologies, and course topics to support student learning.

Requirements

  • 5+ years as a senior software/systems architect, platform engineer, or senior backend/infrastructure engineer
  • Has designed and shipped systems at scale in a real company, not just coursework or side projects
  • Depth across the architectural spine: system design, API and service architecture, cloud and infrastructure (AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD), and distributed systems
  • Can explain why a decision was made, not just how it was implemented, and can diagnose and critique someone else's architecture live
  • Strong technical communication: comfortable leading a live session and writing clear, specific review feedback
  • Strong English C1+ — instruction and review are in English for a US-based audience
  • Comfortable using AI tools in day-to-day technical work

What we can offer you

  • Milestone-based payments tied to deliverables
  • Fully remote work with flexible hours
  • A digital office — we use modern tools (Notion, Miro, Slack, Figma) to keep collaboration smooth
  • Professional trust and autonomy — no micromanaging
  • The chance to see real impact: our metric is graduates landing jobs in tech
  • Join a diverse, international, and close-knit team excited to work with you

Highlights:

About Fundraise Up

We’re Fundraise Up - a global fundraising platform built to make donating to nonprofits fast, seamless, and accessible to all. Every month, our technology powers tens of millions of dollars in donations across the globe. We focus on innovation that directly impacts results: faster load times, higher conversion rates, global payment support, and accessibility-first design.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading nonprofits, including UNICEF, the Alzheimer’s Association, and a wide range of global NGOs. With a 4.9/5 rating across top software review platforms, we’re recognized not just for our impact - but for the quality of the product we deliver.

A Truly Global Product

We operate in the enterprise segment, serving nonprofit organizations across North America, the United Kingdom, Australia, and Europe.

We’re building a large and complex product ecosystem that serves nonprofits, donors, and partners around the world. The platform includes a modern checkout experience and customizable widgets (each a standalone SPA), donor, organization, and partner portals, admin tools, and several internal apps.

The Team

We are a distributed team of 160+ product professionals, including 80+ engineers. Our team members are mainly based across Spain, Poland, Portugal, Georgia, Armenia, Serbia, Turkey, and Cyprus. Despite our scale, we operate like a focused team — where every task matters and every voice is heard. We value thoughtful collaboration, strong engineering practices, and a product mindset.

About the Role

You'll run the programs employees feel most directly: payroll, variable compensation, equity, and benefits, across every country, entity, and contractor arrangement we operate in. You'll bring order to a complex, distributed environment — building calendars, controls, and processes that make sure people get paid accurately and on time, every time. This is a hands-on role for someone who traces issues to the source rather than passing them along, and who builds systems other people can trust.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end global payroll delivery for employees and contractors, ensuring payments, deductions, reimbursements, and changes are accurate, timely, compliant, and reconciled.
  • Calculate and validate variable compensation and bonuses for executives and non-GTM employees, coordinating finalized inputs, payroll execution, controls, and reconciliation with the GTM variable-pay partner.
  • Build and run a global payroll calendar with clear cutoffs, review cycles, approvals, funding timelines, and reimbursement service levels.
  • Design and administer equity and long-term incentive programs — grants, vesting, exercises, terminations — maintaining accurate records and cap-table integrity in partnership with Finance and Legal.
  • Own global benefits administration across markets, covering statutory and supplemental programs while balancing employee value, compliance, and cost.
  • Monitor benefits utilization, market competitiveness, employee feedback, and spend; recommend changes supported by data.
  • Own payroll and equity data integrity across BambooHR, Justworks, Remote, and Carta, including workflows, integrations, permissions, and reporting.
  • Manage global employment operations, including EOR/PEO relationships from a payroll perspective, own provider governance — contracts, funding, service levels, reconciliations, escalations, and periodic performance reviews.
  • Identify recurring failure points and manual work across these programs and implement sustainable fixes rather than workarounds.

Skills and Qualifications

Must-have:

  • 7+ years of progressive experience across global payroll, total rewards, benefits, HRIS, or people operations, with meaningful ownership of multi-country payroll.
  • Demonstrated experience managing direct-entity, EOR/PEO, and contractor populations across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Hands-on experience calculating bonuses or variable compensation and building review and approval controls.
  • Experience designing or administering equity and long-term incentive programs.
  • Experience auditing an HRIS (e.g., BambooHR), including data governance, workflows, permissions, integrations, and reporting.
  • Working knowledge of payroll compliance, equity tax considerations, audit requirements, and stock-based compensation accounting concepts such as ASC 718.
  • Evidence of improving complex or manual processes in a scaling, distributed organization.

Nice to have:

  • Familiarity with equity platforms such as Carta, Shareworks, or Pulley.

You'll Thrive Here If You…

  • You trace a discrepancy to its root cause instead of accepting the first explanation.
  • You'd rather build the calendar and the checklist than answer the same question twice.
  • You treat a payroll error as your problem to close out, not someone else's to escalate.
  • You ask the clarifying question before the work starts, not after it's wrong.
  • You can explain a stock-comp technicality to an executive in one sentence they'll actually remember.
  • You hold sensitive employee information with real discretion, not just a policy about it.
  • You'd rather fix the process than route around it one more time.
  • You're comfortable owning ambiguity across payroll, equity, benefits, and systems in the same week.

Compensation

  • The compensation range for this role is: €4,000 - €4,750 gross per month.

About Mothers to Daughters:

Mothers to Daughters (M2D) is a 501(c)(3) non-profit dedicated to empowering women across generations through leadership and entrepreneurship training, educational workshops, and networking opportunities. Through intergenerational mentorship and community service, M2D advances gender equality, fosters leadership, and equips women to drive social and economic change in their communities. This handbook outlines our values, policies, and operational procedures to guide team members in fulfilling our mission.

Our Mission at Mothers to Daughters is to accelerate the personal and professional growth of women by connecting them with the lived experiences, authentic insights, and transformative wisdom of successful women. Through intergenerational mentorship, we foster a legacy of economic empowerment, social resilience, and impact-driven innovation, equipping women to lead, innovate, and build sustainable solutions that transcend generations.

Our Vision is a world where women of all generations thrive through the power of intergenerational wisdom, driving inclusivity and gender equity for lasting global impact. By bridging generations, amplifying voices, and breaking down barriers, we aim to create a future where women are elevated to the heights they deserve—leading, innovating, and shaping a more equitable and prosperous world for all.

Our Core Values at Mothers to Daughters are:

  • UnwaveringRespect

    • We honor diverse perspectives and experiences, fostering an environment where every voice is valued.

    • We believe in mutual respect between generations, recognizing the wisdom of experience and the disruptive innovation of youth.

    • We encourage bold yet respectful dialogue in discussions around gender equality, relationships, and personal development.

  • Purpose driven-Trust

    • We prioritize transparency, accountability, and credibility, ensuring that our members, mentors, and sponsors feel confident in our work.

    • We believe trust is the cornerstone of meaningful mentorship, enabling honest, courageous conversations and impactful guidance.

    • We commit to upholding the integrity of our mission, maintaining the highest ethical standards in all our partnerships and programs.

  • Synergistic Collaboration

    • We recognize that transformative change happens when we work together across generations, cultures, and industries.

    • We actively forge alliances with organizations that align with our mission, including men’s groups working toward gender equity.

    • We foster a culture of dynamic knowledge-sharing, ensuring that mentorship is a two-way exchange where both mentors and mentees grow together.

  • Transformational Empathy

    • We understand that each woman’s journey is unique, committing to creating a safe space for shared experiences and personal growth.

    • We recognize societal and personal challenges women face and approach solutions with compassion and pragmatic action.

    • We champion vulnerability as a strength, encouraging open discussions about both breakthroughs and setbacks.

  • Impact-Driven Entrepreneurial Spirit

    • We believe in equipping women with the skills, mindset, and resources to take ownership of their futures—whether through career advancement, leadership, or business ventures.

    • We encourage innovation, agility, and adaptability, ensuring our programs evolve to meet the shifting needs of our global community.

    • We emphasize bold resilience, helping women break barriers, embrace risk, and lead with confidence.

    • We embrace and celebrate individuality, encouraging women to bring their whole selves to the table.

    • We champion unapologetic self-expression, ensuring that every woman’s voice is heard, respected, and amplified.

    • We commit to honest, transparent communication, rejecting performative feminism in favor of practical, high-impact actions that drive real change.

  • Future-focused Innovation

    • We embrace bold, transformative thinking, pushing boundaries to create solutions that redefine possibilities for women.

    • We leverage technology, data, and creativity to amplify mentorship, leadership, and economic empowerment initiatives.

    • We foster a culture of continuous learning and reinvention, ensuring that women stay ahead in an ever-evolving global landscape.

The Chief Sustainability Officer (CSO) is responsible for leading the organization's environmental, social, and governance (ESG) strategy and sustainability initiatives. The CSO drives the integration of sustainable business practices into corporate strategy, operations, risk management, and stakeholder engagement. This role ensures the organization meets regulatory requirements, sustainability goals, and long-term ESG commitments while enhancing corporate reputation and business resilience.

Key Responsibilities

ESG & Sustainability Strategy

  • Develop and execute the organization's ESG and sustainability strategy aligned with corporate objectives.
  • Establish sustainability goals, targets, and long-term roadmaps.
  • Integrate ESG principles into business operations, investments, and decision-making processes.

Environmental Sustainability Initiatives

  • Lead initiatives focused on carbon reduction, energy efficiency, waste management, and climate resilience.
  • Develop strategies to reduce environmental impact and support net-zero objectives.
  • Monitor environmental performance metrics and sustainability benchmarks.

Social Impact & Corporate Responsibility

  • Drive diversity, equity, inclusion (DEI), employee well-being, and community engagement initiatives.

Governance & Compliance

Stakeholder & Investor Engagement

Risk Management & Resilience

  • Assess environmental and social risks impacting business operations and investments.
  • Develop climate risk and sustainability risk management frameworks.
  • Support enterprise resilience and long-term sustainability planning.

Leadership & Culture Development

  • Promote a sustainability-focused culture across the organization.
  • Lead and mentor ESG, sustainability, and CSR teams.
  • Drive employee awareness and engagement in sustainability initiatives.

  • Strong strategic and sustainability leadership capabilities.

  • Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills.
  • Analytical and risk assessment abilities.
  • Change management and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Performance Metrics

  • Achievement of ESG and sustainability targets.
  • Reduction in environmental impact and carbon footprint.

  • Stakeholder and investor engagement outcomes.
  • Success of sustainability and CSR initiatives.

Overview

LMI is seeking an Applied Statistician, Forecasting & Simulation to support passport demand forecasting for the Department of State, Bureau of Consular Affairs, Passport Services.

This role is focused on applied statistics, forecasting, predictive modeling, econometrics, and simulation. The successful candidate will develop, evaluate, and refine statistical models used to forecast passport demand and help government stakeholders understand demand drivers, uncertainty, and potential future scenarios.

The ideal candidate has a strong statistical foundation, experience with time series and forecasting methods, and the ability to critically evaluate model assumptions, performance, and limitations.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain statistical, econometric, and time series models to forecast passport demand.
  • Apply forecasting methods such as regression, ARIMA, exponential smoothing, state space models, Bayesian methods, and other appropriate techniques.
  • Develop simulations and scenario analyses to evaluate uncertainty and potential future outcomes.

We’re looking for a revenue leader to own all distribution, servicing, and customer success across SafeLease’s full suite of self-storage insurance products — tenant protection, tenant insurance, and specialty property & casualty. You will run the commercial engine of the business unit, responsible for how our products reach the market through both our direct-to-operator channel and our growing network of retail agents and brokers, how partners and customers are served day-to-day, and how we retain and expand relationships over time.

This role sits within the Storage Products business unit alongside the General Manager. Customer Success:

  • Deep familiarity with the self-storage industry. Existing relationships with storage operators, REITs, and industry partners that allow you to hit the ground running are critical.

  • Proven track record of building and scaling distribution channels, ideally in specialty or commercial insurance.

  • Experience owning a revenue number (quota, retention target, or P&L line) and consistently delivering.

  • Comfort operating in a high-growth, evolving organizational structure where you’ll need to build processes and teams from scratch.

  • Strong cross-functional instincts. That means you know how to partner with product, marketing, underwriting, and engineering without needing direct authority.

  3. Hunt what works : You proactively test hooks, formats, and posting times. If a format underperforms, you kill it fast and move to the next test.

  4. AI leverage : You leverage Claude Code daily to automate repurposing (long-form → shorts), generate caption/hook variations, and build lightweight pipelines that let you ship at the pace of a small team, alone.

  5. Read the data : You live in native platform analytics + GA4. You double down on what compounds and kill vanity metrics.

  6. Contribute to growth loops : You work with Growth and Content to spot winning angles and feed them back into new formats.

You'll own KPIs: Follower growth rate, engagement rate, views-to-follow conversion, X posts shipped per week.

Desired outcomes: Consistent daily output without external agencies. A social presence that compounds instead of resetting every month.

DO YOU RECOGNIZE YOURSELF?

Experience

  • 2–3 years in social media management/content creation, ideally in a fast-moving brand or creator context. Or self-taught with a portfolio that proves it.

  • You can show us what you've shipped: reels, shorts, growth numbers. Portfolio > pedigree.

  • You already use Claude (or equivalent AI tools) weekly to edit, caption, or automate, not just to brainstorm ideas.

  • Comfortable being on camera or directing talent if needed is a plus.

Personality

  • Curiosity: You relentlessly dig into why users behave the way they do until you uncover the insight behind the data.

  • Hands-On Execution : you build, you don't just brief.

  • Precision: You care about clarity in hypotheses, clean data, and unambiguous results.

  • Agility: You move fast, adapt instantly to new findings, and turn insights into tests within hours, not weeks.

Language

French: Native / Bilingual

English: Fluent English, you can hold a conversation on specific details with English-speaking colleagues.

Our chosen language for written communication is English.

IT MIGHT NOT BE FOR YOU

  1. You want a strict separation between work and life. Execution speed is our biggest advantage right now. A 9-to-5 mindset guarantees you'll fall behind.

  2. You need clarity, stability, and established process before you can act. We're still building the machine. If you need everything defined before you move, wrong place.

  3. You want to be told exactly what to do. We hire people who bring solutions, not people who wait for instructions.

WHY JOIN US ❤️

Help us market a product that fuses neuroscience, design, and AI to reinvent how humans grow.

Work with filmmakers, psychologists, engineers, and creatives obsessed with impact.

In the heart of our headquarters stands the 100 000 Dreams Wall,

jobs.excerpt: Are you interested in joining an organization with a global reach?
jobs.description:
Are you interested in joining an organization with a global reach? In a world of shifting threats, Concentric is your trusted ally. Powered by elite professionals from military, government, and intelligence backgrounds. If you are passionate about intelligence, risk analysis, threat management, executive protection, security operations, or business resiliency, Concentric may be the organization you’ve been searching for!

Concentric is a risk consultancy specializing in delivering strategic security and intelligence services. We provide holistic, intelligent security solutions for private clients and corporations globally. Concentric offers strategic advisory services, risk assessments, physical protection, threat intelligence, open-source monitoring, program audits, secure embedded staffing, and training for security teams and intelligence analysts.

Our ultimate goal is to be recognized as the most innovative, capable, and trusted Risk Management partner in the world, and we do this by following these core values:

Integrity – Collaboration - Relationships – Excellence – Creativity - Results

Join Us,

Concentric - "Your World Secured"

We are currently hiring a Behavioral Threat Assessment Manager to join our team embedded with our client in Sydney, Australia! This is a remote position open to those based in Australia.

*This is a full-time position with a four-day, 10-hour shift schedule, though shifts are subject to change based on business needs.

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Threat Assessment Manager will be responsible for comprehensive threat assessment management for client staff and operations, while contributing to and protecting client culture and business interests. This role provides behavioral threat assessments, case management, and other related security management services to address external threats to the client company.
Working within an embedded program environment, the Threat Assessment Manager uses client-provided equipment, networks, and platforms to conduct investigations, manage active cases, and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to support timely incident response and risk mitigation.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop and maintain comprehensive threat research regionally.
  • Identify, investigate, analyze, and manage threats to executive staff, employees, and the broader partner community as directed by the client.
  • Produce actionable and concise threat analysis products in a timely manner to inform cross-functional groups, executive staff protection, and enterprise-wide security operations.
  • Conduct thorough open-source intelligence investigations—drawing on public and government databases, social media, and deep/dark-web sources—to identify and assess known or emerging threats that could affect platform users or the broader business community.
  • Manage safety and security team relationships with local law enforcement partners and other investigative, research, and intelligence groups and vendors.
  • Partner closely with customer service and operational teams to support threat intake, response coordination, and case resolution.
  • Maintain global situational awareness of potential and developing threats and prepare impact analyses.
  • Work on complex security incidents with multiple stakeholders, including those without experience in the threat and intelligence fields.
  • Lead Threat Management Team meetings involving various stakeholders to coordinate response on immediate high level threat issues.
  • Assist in program development with workflow creation, threat methodology research, and other planning products.
  • Have a team-focused approach to problem-solving.
  • Be comfortable communicating with everyone from senior executives to entry-level employees.
  • Have the ability to translate complex security issues in a way that your specific audience can consume and understand them.
  • Conform to and abide by all regulations, policies, work procedures, and instructions.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Must be able to legally work in the country where this position is located without visa sponsorship.
  • 7-10+ years of experience in threat analysis, ideally behavioral threat assessment, and threat management and Law Enforcement.
  • Experience supporting a comprehensive threat management program and direct experience conducting investigations, intelligence collection and analysis, and case management.
  • Extensive experience with utilizing open-source research, criminal background information, and other online investigative techniques.
  • Current member (or ability to become a member) of professional threat assessment organizations (i.e., Association of Threat Assessment Professionals).
  • Ability to work some non-traditional hours (e.g., nights, weekends, or holidays) and respond to emergent or time-sensitive situations.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills, demonstrated during the interview process.
  • Must be a highly adaptable, flexible professional who brings a strong, positive attitude and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
  • Ability to build partnerships and work collaboratively and cross-functionally.
  • Professionally proficient in Google Workspace applications and macOS, and experienced in leveraging AI tools to enhance productivity.
  • Ability to travel 10% of the time
  • This is a full-time position located in the APAC region (Singapore or Australia). A typical week’s schedule consists of four 10-hour days, often requiring one shift on a weekend day as job duties demand.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Current Member of APATAP
  • Willingness to pursue CTM certification exam per the Association of Threat Assessment Professionals (ATAP) standards.
  • A Bachelor’s Degree is preferred (years of experience may be substituted).
  • International experience and/or regional expertise (APAC).
  • Language proficiency and cross-cultural fluency.
  • Experience with data analysis, reporting, and trend tracking.
  • Experience drafting planning products and policy documentation.
  • Training and exercise design or facilitation experience.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

  • MSH Life, AD&D, PTD - Life, AD&D (Accidental Death & Dismemberment), PTD (Permanent Total Disability)
  • Pension Scheme
  • Time Off and Leave
  • $150.00/mo stipend for internet
  • Free access to our Risk Intelligence Dashboard and GEAR App. Providing 24/7 access to trusted risk intelligence and remote support, helping you stay informed, prepared, and protected wherever you operate.
  • Coaching and Mentoring Opportunities
Australia Pay Range
$135,000—$135,000 AUD

jobs.excerpt: About AbridgeAbridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare.
jobs.description:
About Abridge

Abridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare. Our AI-powered platform was purpose-built for medical conversations, improving clinical documentation efficiencies while enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most—their patients.

Our enterprise-grade technology transforms patient-clinician conversations into structured clinical notes in real-time, with deep EMR integrations. Powered by Linked Evidence and our purpose-built, auditable AI, we are the only company that maps AI-generated summaries to ground truth, helping providers quickly trust and verify the output. As pioneers in generative AI for healthcare, we are setting the industry standards for the responsible deployment of AI across health systems.

We are a growing team of practicing MDs, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to empower people and make care make more sense. We have offices located in the Mission District in San Francisco, the SoHo neighborhood of New York, and East Liberty in Pittsburgh.

The Role

We're looking for a Design Operations Manager to help scale, support, and streamline operations across our growing product design organization. This role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution—you'll shape how the design team operates while staying deeply involved in the day-to-day work that makes great design possible.

You'll partner closely with product design leadership, research, engineering, and product management to ensure the design team can deliver high-quality, high-impact work at speed and scale. This role reports to the VP of Product Design and is based in our San Francisco HQ. We offer relocation assistance.

What You'll Do

  • Coordinate and land a blank slate product re-design of Abridge

  • Partner with design leadership to identify and implement programs, processes, and tools that help the team operate more effectively

  • Lead operational planning and execution for key initiatives—team-wide rituals, hiring coordination, onboarding, resource allocation, and internal communications.

  • Build and maintain scalable systems that support team growth, execution excellence, and strong collaboration across research, engineering, and product.

  • Oversee asset management practices across the design org, ensuring shared libraries, templates, and systems are version-controlled, accessible, and consistently used.

  • Manage external vendors and contractors—handling onboarding, scoping, resourcing, contract workflows, and performance tracking to extend the team's capacity with quality and accountability.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering Operations to align OKRs, roadmaps, and delivery milestones.

  • Drive intake, prioritization, and resource planning for design work in a fast-moving, highly collaborative product environment.

  • Bring clarity to ownership, roles, and execution timelines—ensuring the right people are in the loop at the right time.

  • Facilitate retrospectives, team health check-ins, and continuous improvement efforts to help the team operate at its best.

  • Roll up your sleeves where needed—whether standing up a new system, running a sprint planning session, onboarding a vendor, or troubleshooting a tool.

What You'll Bring

  • 8+ years of experience in design operations within high-growth technology environments.

  • A track record of building and scaling 0-to-1 operational systems across multidisciplinary teams—balancing long-term vision with hands-on execution.

  • A nuanced orientation toward process: you know when to advocate for it, when to hold it loosely, and what it can and can't solve.

  • Deep familiarity with the design and product development lifecycle—from early research and concepting through delivery and iteration.

  • Experience managing shared design tools, assets, and libraries to support consistency and efficiency at scale.

  • Vendor and contractor management experience, with a focus on enabling seamless collaboration and high-quality outcomes.

  • High organizational rigor paired with a bias for action—you're comfortable getting in the weeds to move things forward.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with experience working across senior leadership, technical partners, and designers of all levels.

  • The ability to thrive in fast-paced environments and solve problems in real time to help teams keep moving.

Bonus Points If…

  • You've worked in a healthcare technology or regulated-industry environment and understand the nuance that comes with it.

  • You have experience supporting design teams through periods of rapid organizational or product scale.

Why Work at Abridge?

At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month.

Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business.

Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients.

We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you.

How we take care of Abridgers:

  • Generous Time Off: 14 paid holidays, flexible PTO for salaried employees, and accrued time off for hourly employees

  • Comprehensive Health Plans: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for all full-time employees and their families.

  • Generous HSA Contribution: If you choose a High Deductible Health Plan, Abridge makes monthly contributions to your HSA.

  • Paid Parental Leave: Generous paid parental leave for all full-time employees.

  • Family Forming Benefits: Resources and financial support to help you build your family.

  • Pre-tax Benefits: Access to Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Commuter Benefits.

  • Lifestyle Wallet: Monthly contributions for fitness, professional development, coworking, and more.

  • Mental Health Support: Dedicated access to therapy and coaching to help you reach your goals.

  • Sabbatical Leave: Paid Sabbatical Leave after 5 years of employment.

  • Compensation and Equity: Competitive compensation and equity grants for full time employees.

Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

Instacart's mission is to create a world where everyone has access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Online Grocery is the heart of that mission — the products millions of customers rely on every day and the team that builds them. We're looking for a Chief of Staff, Online Grocery to partner with the General Manager who leads this business and its product and R&D organization of ~200 people across product, design, research and technical program management.

People, operations and programs are the core of the work — but what should energize you is what that work makes possible. A Chief of Staff here helps the organization operate at its best: more cohesive, clearer in its purpose, sharper and faster in how it makes decisions and operates, and enabled to do the thing that matters most — building products our customers love. If you're motivated by improving how a team works, and serve as a multiplier on everything the team can ship, this is your role.

This is a highly strategic and operational individual-contributor role (no direct reports) for someone exceptionally organized, has strong business and strategic sense, high in empathy, and who has an understanding of how product, design, and engineering teams work.

About the Job

Run the operating rhythm

  • Own and continuously improve the business rhythm for the GM and the organization — leadership team syncs, all-team meetings, monthly and quarterly business reviews, planning reviews, organizational communications, and Online Grocery segments of company-wide all-hands.
  • Manage the operating cadence for the GM — prioritizing and delegating workstreams, ensuring the right things get the right attention at the right time.
  • Improve how the organization decides: clarify decision rights and the questions that matter, build the frameworks and pre-reads that bring options into focus, and remove the friction that slows good calls.
  • Once decisions are made, capture and sharpen them, ensure they're communicated to the right stakeholders, and close the loop on execution — keeping leadership priorities, decisions, and commitments visible and on track (R&D execution itself is owned by TPM).
  • Shape and run the substance of the leadership team offsites: objectives, agenda, pre-reads, the hard discussions, decisions, and follow-through (logistics and events are handled separately).
  • Be a trusted thought partner to the GM and a credible problem-solving partner to product and R&D leaders, and build strong relationships with chiefs of staff across the organization to partner effectively in getting your responsibilities done.
  • Prepare briefings and coordinate research for the GM's meetings with partners and key leaders — identifying goals, talking points, and relevant context.
  • Partner with the GM, HR and finance to manage the organization's headcount budget

Plan executive communication

  • Drive the calendar, planning, and content for upward communication and alignment with the C-suite and the board on Online Grocery priorities.
  • Support the GM in preparing content for speaking engagements (working with our comms team).

Strengthen people, culture, and organizational health

  • Help the GM spot, diagnose, and get ahead of issues across the organization — bringing structured, candid read-outs and early signals, not just status.
  • Partner with the GM and HR to address relationship and culture dynamics across the team and create a high-trust, high-performance leadership team culture.
  • Turn signals like engagement surveys into action — working across the organization to develop the right plans, pressure-test them, and ensure they get executed and the loop gets closed with teams.

Drive priority programs

  • Help the GM kick off and drive annual and long-range planning for Online Grocery.
  • Take ambiguous new efforts for the GM from unclear to fully underway — creating clarity and a plan, identifying DRIs, setting up the decisions that need to be made, aligning stakeholders, and developing the right operating rhythm to track progress.
  • Proactively identify and take ownership of emerging opportunities and risks before they become blockers.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of work experience
  • R&D experience — earned in a direct R&D role (product, design, engineering, or technical program management), an adjacent role embedded with R&D teams, or as a Chief of Staff within an R&D organization
  • Consulting, corporate strategy/operations, or finance background and experience working directly with executives
  • Working fluency to navigate a product, design, and engineering organization at scale, and to be a true problem-solving partner to R&D leaders rather than a coordinator.
  • High EQ and a genuinely people-oriented instinct — builds trusted relationships, reads organizational dynamics, and bridges leadership and teams.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication at an executive level
  • Strong analytical skills, and a commitment to consistently high-quality work.
  • Exceptional program management: organized, effective, and relentless at driving multiple hard initiatives forward to deadline at once.
  • Ability to travel 10%

Preferred Experience

  • Experience designing and facilitating leadership offsites and driving organizational, culture, or operating-model change.
  • Experience building with AI (e.g., prototypes, automations, or agents) in a professional setting.
  • Experience within high-growth, technology-driven companies.

About Intermedia

About The Role:
The ServiceNow Developer is a hands-on technical contributor within the IT organization, responsible for designing, developing, configuring, and supporting ServiceNow solutions that improve business workflows, operational efficiency, and user experience. This role partners closely with IT, Security, HR, Finance, and other business stakeholders to translate process needs into scalable, maintainable platform capabilities.
As a ServiceNow Developer, you will help build and enhance the ServiceNow platform, develop integrations and automations, support ITSM and related workflows, and ensure solutions are secure, well-documented, and aligned with platform standards.
For internal candidates, this role represents advancement into a specialized platform development path, requiring strong technical aptitude, disciplined configuration practices, and the ability to deliver reliable ServiceNow solutions while collaborating across functional teams.

What you will bring to the role:

  • ServiceNow Platform Development: Design, develop, configure, and maintain ServiceNow applications, modules, forms, lists, flows, business rules, client scripts, UI policies, script includes, notifications, service catalog items, and related platform components.
  • Workflow Automation and Process Enablement Build and improve workflows using Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, approvals, catalog workflows, and automation capabilities that reduce manual effort and improve service delivery across the organization.
  • ITSM and Enterprise Service Management Support: Support and enhance ITSM processes such as Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Knowledge, Asset, and Configuration Management. Partner with stakeholders to extend ServiceNow capabilities into additional business functions when appropriate.
  • Integrations and Data Management: Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot integrations with enterprise systems using REST/SOAP APIs, MID Server, import sets, transform maps, scheduled jobs, and other integration patterns. Ensure data quality, reliability, and traceability across connected systems.
  • Platform Quality and Release Management: Participate in development, testing, code review, deployment, and post-release validation. Promote changes through development, test, and production environments using disciplined release and change management practices.
  • Security, Governance, and Compliance: Implement role-based access controls, ACLs, data policies, audit practices, and secure development standards. Partner with Information Security and platform owners to ensure solutions align with organizational policies and compliance expectations.
  • Troubleshooting and Operational Support: Serve as an escalation resource for ServiceNow defects, performance issues, workflow failures, integration errors, and user-impacting incidents. Conduct root cause analysis and implement durable fixes.
  • Documentation and Knowledge Sharing: Maintain clear technical documentation, configuration notes, solution designs, support runbooks, and user guidance. Share knowledge with administrators, support teams, and business stakeholders to improve platform adoption and supportability.
  • AI and Platform Innovation: Evaluate and responsibly apply ServiceNow AI, automation, and virtual agent capabilities where they improve user experience, operational efficiency, and service quality. Follow approved guardrails for AI-assisted development and platform use.
Additional Responsibilities:
  • Embody Core Values: Lead by example in upholding Intermedia's Core Values: Deliver Exceptional Experiences, Learn and Improve, Act with Integrity, Be Transparent, Succeed as One Team.
  • Operational Excellence: Contribute to platform stability, performance, scalability, and supportability through thoughtful design, disciplined configuration, and continuous improvement.
  • Stakeholder Partnership: Work closely with process owners, business analysts, administrators, and end users to understand needs, validate requirements, and deliver practical solutions.
  • Confidentiality and Compliance: Handle sensitive information with discretion and adhere to all organizational policies, security standards, and regulatory requirements.

What you will bring to the role:

  • 3-6 years of progressive experience developing, administering, or supporting ServiceNow in an enterprise environment.
  • Demonstrated success delivering ServiceNow enhancements from requirements through production deployment.
  • Experience working in ITSM, enterprise service management, or business workflow automation environments.
Technical Expertise:
  • Strong hands-on experience with ServiceNow configuration and development, including forms, lists, tables, business rules, client scripts, UI policies, script includes, notifications, catalog items, and Flow Designer.
  • Proficiency with JavaScript and ServiceNow scripting concepts; familiarity with HTML, CSS, APIs, and web application fundamentals.
  • Experience with ServiceNow ITSM processes; exposure to CMDB, Discovery, Service Catalog, Knowledge, Asset, or Change Management preferred.
  • Experience building and troubleshooting integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, IntegrationHub, MID Server, import sets, transform maps, and scheduled data loads.
  • Understanding of ServiceNow security concepts including roles, groups, ACLs, data policies, and secure development practices.
  • Familiarity with ServiceNow release management, update sets, application repository/source control concepts, testing practices, and platform upgrade readiness.
Professional Skills:
  • Strong communicator and collaborative partner, able to work effectively with a Senior ServiceNow Developer to translate business requirements into scalable, maintainable ServiceNow solutions. Skilled at clarifying requirements, explaining platform behavior, identifying dependencies, and bridging communication between technical teams and business stakeholders.
  • Collaborative problem-solver with the ability to balance stakeholder priorities, ServiceNow best practices, platform standards, and long-term maintainability.
  • Detail-oriented and quality-focused, with a bias toward durable solutions, clean documentation, and continuous improvement.

jobs.excerpt: We are seeking an experienced Senior Claims Analyst with deep expertise in hospital claims adjudication, stop loss reporting, high-cost/catastrophic claims, and DRG (Diagnosis-Related Group) reimbursement methodology.
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Claims Analyst with deep expertise in hospital claims adjudication, stop loss reporting, high-cost/catastrophic claims, and DRG (Diagnosis-Related Group) reimbursement methodology. This individual will analyze itemized hospital bills and claims data to identify billing errors, coding discrepancies, DRG misassignments, and other overpayment opportunities, then work directly with claims administrators on behalf of our ASO clients to secure claim adjustments, recoveries, and repricing.

This is a highly analytical, client-facing role requiring both technical claims expertise and strong negotiation/communication skills.

This is a remote role.

Key Responsibilities

Claims Analysis & Review

  • Perform detailed audits of hospital and facility claims, including itemized bills, UB-04 claim forms, medical records, and remittance advices, to validate billing accuracy.

  • Analyze DRG assignments and coding to identify DRG upcoding, unbundling, duplicate billing, and other irregularities that affect reimbursement.

  • Review high-cost and catastrophic claims (typically $100K+) to identify overpayments, contract misapplication, and opportunities for negotiated adjustments.

  • Evaluate claims against plan documents, provider contracts, reference-based pricing methodologies, and CMS guidelines to determine appropriate reimbursement.

Stop Loss & High-Cost Claims Expertise

  • Understand and apply stop loss (specific and aggregate) provisions, laser terms, and reporting requirements as they relate to claim adjustments and client financial exposure.

  • Coordinate with stop loss carriers and reinsurers as needed to ensure adjustments and recoveries are properly reflected in stop loss reimbursement calculations.

  • Identify claims nearing or exceeding specific deductible thresholds and prioritize review accordingly.

Client Advocacy & Claims Administrator Negotiation

  • Serve as the subject matter expert and advocate on behalf of ASO clients in disputes with claims administrators (TPAs) and carriers regarding claim payment accuracy.

  • Prepare clear, well-documented findings packages (clinical, contractual, and coding rationale) to support requested claim adjustments and appeals.

  • Lead or support negotiations with claims administrators to reach adjusted payment resolutions.

  • Track disputes through resolution, escalating unresolved cases appropriately and maintaining strong working relationships with TPA claims and provider relations teams.

Data & Reporting

  • Analyze large claims data sets to identify trends, outlier claims, and systemic overpayment patterns across client populations.

  • Build and maintain claim tracking logs, savings reports, and client-facing summaries of identified and recovered savings.

  • Partner with internal data/analytics teams to refine claim-flagging logic and improve identification of high-value review opportunities.

Required Qualifications

  • Hospital/Surgical/ICU Nursing background (RN) and clinical coding background for clinical validation of DRG and medical necessity issues.

  • 5+ years of experience in hospital claims analysis, medical bill review, claims auditing, or payment integrity, with direct exposure to self-funded/ASO plans.

  • Strong working knowledge of DRG methodology (MS-DRG/APR-DRG), UB-04 billing, ICD-10-CM/PCS, CPT/HCPCS coding, and hospital chargemaster structures.

  • Demonstrated understanding of stop loss insurance, including specific/aggregate deductibles, laser provisions, and how claim adjustments impact stop loss reimbursement.

  • Experience analyzing high-cost/catastrophic claims and identifying overpayment or billing error patterns.

  • Prior experience interacting with or negotiating against TPAs, insurance carriers, or claims administrators on disputed claims.

  • Proficiency with claims data analysis tools (Excel required; SQL, Access, or claims analytics platforms a plus)

  • Knowledge of policy terms, coverage guidelines, statutory/regulatory compliance requirements and litigation/dispute workflows.

  • Ability to interpret and translate in common terms legal contracts, summary plan descriptions (SPDs), and statutory guidelines

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build persuasive, well-supported adjustment requests and appeals.

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage a high volume of complex claims simultaneously.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certified Professional Coder (CPC), Certified Coding Specialist (CCS), Certified Medical Bill Review Specialist, or similar credential.

  • Prior experience at a TPA, insurance carrier, hospital billing/coding department, or payment integrity/cost containment vendor.

  • Familiarity with reference-based pricing (RBP), Medicare fee schedules, and out-of-network claims repricing.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent identification of material overpayments and billing errors on high-cost hospital claims.

  • Strong track record of securing favorable claim adjustments through negotiation with claims administrators.

  • Clear, professional communication that strengthens client trust and TPA relationships.

  • Measurable contribution to client savings and stop loss cost containment.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Agentic Commerce
jobs.excerpt: About VGSVGS is building the trust infrastructure for a new era of commerce.
jobs.description:
About VGS

VGS is building the trust infrastructure for a new era of commerce. As commerce becomes agentic, payments are increasing dramatically in volume, speed, and complexity, and the companies driving that shift need a foundation they can fully trust.

That's where VGS comes in. We're the world's leader in payment tokenization, trusted by the most innovative AI and Fortune 500 companies, merchants, banks, and fintechs to power modern payments and agentic commerce. We store more than 9 billion tokens and process more than 10 billion monthly interactions, touching a third of all e-commerce. That scale isn't incidental. It's why leading companies embed our universal token vault and credential management platform directly into their stack, taming the complexity of payment data so they can move faster.

Come build the platform that enables modern payments for the world's largest companies. We're helping businesses unlock new possibilities in an industry that never stops moving. And that takes exceptional people.

About the Role

In this role, you will work with the world’s largest wallets, card networks, and AI/agent platforms. This includes coordinating directly with the networks (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover), and emerging AI commerce and agent-payments providers. You will be focusing on building seamless token APIs, defining and implementing protocols, and trust frameworks that let agents pay securely on behalf of humans. This industry is evolving before our eyes, and you will define what "agent-ready" payments infrastructure looks like before the rest of the industry has agreed on the answer.

What You’ll Do

  • Product Strategy & Discovery: Work directly with partner engineering teams (networks, wallets, AI platforms) to translate emerging standards like Agentic Tokens, ACP, UCP, MPP, etc… into concrete product requirements and roadmaps.

  • Own and drive multi-partner technical integrations end-to-end - you'll be in the weeds with partner engineers, not just handing off specs.

  • Represent VGS in emerging standards conversations, helping define how agent-initiated transactions are authorized, tokenized, and secured across networks.

  • Design browser automation tooling that allow for AI systems to perform human-like interactions in a way that keeps the AI system out of scope with

  • Help build a product point of view on how agentic commerce should work technically, then use that conviction to influence partners and internal engineering roadmaps.

  • Understand, integrate with, and build on top of pre-existing VGS tokenization and payments infrastructure.

What You Bring

  • Experience: 3+ years as a Product Manager, with prior experience in a technically-hands-on role - solutions engineering, technical account management, integration engineering, or software engineering - within payments, fintech, or API platforms.

  • Direct experience delivering APIs, SDKs, or protocols in a partner-facing capacity. You've been the person on the call debugging an integration in real time, and understand what’s needed to fully operationalize a product concept. This includes designing reporting, observability, and other similar systems.

  • Genuine, demonstrated interest in AI/agentic systems - side projects, contributions, or professional work exploring how AI agents interact with external systems.

  • Communication Skills: Comfortable moving between deeply technical partner engineering conversations and executive/GTM conversations about strategy and roadmap.

Mindset:

  • Partner-savvy strategist: You've spent years sitting at the intersection of technical specs and business relationships. This includes interpreting protocol docs, negotiating requirements with vendor and partner teams, and translating product ideas into a roadmap that gets delivered.

  • Curious about the frontier: You're drawn to agentic commerce because it's genuinely unsolved, not just because it's trendy.

  • Technical credibility with product instincts: You can hold your own in a technical design review, but you're increasingly motivated by shaping "what should we build" over "how do we build it.". This means that you can confidently define the differences between various agentic protocols, understand API specs across vendors, and create easy to use interfaces that solve the underlying technical problems rather than giving the issues to the end-consumer to solve.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with tokenization, payment processing, or security products

  • BA/BS degree

  • A knack for out-of-the-box thinking that thrives in a fast-paced startup environment

  • Prior work with AI agent frameworks, LLM tooling, or agent-to-agent protocols.

We're looking for passionate professionals who take pride in their craft and want to help grow a team tackling some of the most critical problems in payments. People who thrive here are curious by nature, unafraid of hard problems, and motivated by the chance to build something that matters at scale.

If you're driven to make a meaningful impact, work at the leading edge of payment technology, and grow your career alongside a team that values ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning, you'll feel right at home at VGS.

How We Work

At VGS, we embrace a remote-first philosophy because we believe flexibility leads to great work and a healthy work-life balance. That said, if you live within 30 miles of one of our office locations, you'll be on a hybrid schedule with some in-person time, because we know there's real value in coming together.

We're not about being in the office every day. We are about connection, collaboration, and the energy that comes from a great brainstorm, a team lunch, or celebrating a big win in person.

Our Benefits

Das gesamte Sales Team, besonders unser VP Sales, unterstützt dich tatkräftig beim Closing von neuen Deals.

  • Mit unserer Lösung unterstützt du deine Kunden, ohne einfach an jeden zu verkaufen, der ein Budget hat. Kundenbindung steht bei uns an erster Stelle, und sie beginnt bereits beim Verkaufsprozess.   • Vorherige Sales Erfahrung. Mind. 3+ Jahre Erfahrung in einem B2B-/SaaS-Unternehmen als Account Executive.

  • Unbegrenzter bezahlter Urlaub

🌍 simpleclub heißt jeden willkommen. Ja, jeden:
Bei simpleclub widmen wir uns dem Aufbau eines Arbeitsumfeldes, das Gleichheit, Integration und Vielfalt fördert. jobs.description:
We are seeking a Data Developer to support a large-scale CRM consolidation initiative, migrating data from multiple legacy systems into Salesforce Health Cloud. This role is critical to ensure accurate, compliant, and high-quality patient, provider, and program data during system consolidation and cutover.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with Salesforce data migrations, healthcare data, and complex transformation logic, and can operate confidently in regulated environments involving PHI.

Key Responsibilities

CRM Consolidation & Data Migration

  • Design and develop data migration pipelines to consolidate multiple legacy CRMs, flat files, and APIs into Salesforce Health Cloud
  • Extract, transform, and load high-volume datasets (patients, enrollments, cases, activities, clinical timelines)
  • Map legacy data models to Salesforce Health Cloud standard and custom objects
  • Implement full-load and incremental (delta) migration strategies
  • Support cutover planning, execution, and rollback readiness

Salesforce Health Cloud Data Development

  • Develop data loads using Salesforce Bulk API v2, REST, and Composite APIs
  • Implement upsert strategies using External IDs
  • Manage Salesforce governor limits and performance constraints during large migrations
  • Load and validate Person Accounts, Care Programs, Care Plans, and related objects
  • Support multi-org consolidation into a single target Health Cloud org

Data Quality, Identity & Validation

  • Perform data profiling, cleansing, normalization, and de-duplication
  • Implement patient identity resolution and survivorship logic
  • Validate referential integrity across related objects
  • Produce reconciliation reports (record counts, field-level validation)
  • Partner with business SMEs to validate migrated data

Compliance, Security & Governance

  • Ensure HIPAA-compliant handling of PHI and PII
  • Apply data masking strategies in non-production environments
  • Support consent, auditability, and data retention requirements
  • Maintain traceability and documentation for regulatory review

Testing & Cutover Support

  • Support migration dry runs and parallel testing
  • Resolve data defects during UAT
  • Participate in go-live cutover and post-migration stabilization
  • Monitor data load errors and remediate issues quickly

Collaboration & Documentation

  • Work closely with Salesforce Architects, Admins, Integration teams, and Compliance partners
  • Document data mappings, transformation rules, and load procedures
  • Communicate risks, dependencies, and data issues clearly to stakeholders

Required Qualifications

Technical Skills

  • 5+ years of experience in data development or data engineering
  • 3+ years of hands-on Salesforce data migration experience
  • Strong SQL and data transformation skills
  • Experience with ETL tools (Informatica, Talend, MuleSoft, Boomi, SSIS) or custom Python-based pipelines
  • Proficiency with REST/SOAP APIs

Salesforce & Healthcare Experience

  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce Health Cloud
  • Strong understanding of Person Accounts and CRM data relationships
  • Experience migrating healthcare, pharmacy, hub services, or patient services data
  • Familiarity with healthcare data standards (FHIR / HL7 – preferred)

Compliance & Quality

  • Experience working with PHI / PII
  • Understanding of HIPAA data handling requirements
  • Strong focus on data accuracy, completeness, and auditability

Nice-to-Have Qualifications

  • Experience consolidating multiple CRMs into a single Salesforce org
  • Prior hub services or patient assistance program experience
  • Exposure to CTI, omnichannel, or case management data
  • CI/CD experience for data pipelines
  • Experience supporting Salesforce Health Cloud reporting and analytics

Our Story

TopDog Law is not your typical law firm. We're a nationally scaling personal injury firm built for impact and growth — owning the client experience end-to-end, from marketing and intake through litigation. Now we're applying that same discipline and innovation to firm operations, case management, and national scale — intentionally building the infrastructure, systems, and teams to grow without sacrificing quality, culture, or accountability.

We are a fully remote team that share trust, open communication, and a commitment to doing great work. If you love ownership, thrive in a fast-moving environment, and want to help build something exceptional, you'll feel right at home here.

The Opportunity

TopDog Law is seeking a strategic and hands-on Director of Treasury to lead the firm’s treasury function and ensure the organization has the liquidity, cash visibility, banking infrastructure, and financial controls needed to support continued growth.

This role will oversee daily cash management, banking relationships, cash forecasting, liquidity planning, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and treasury risk management. The Director of Treasury will partner closely with Accounting, Finance, Executive Leadership, and other business leaders to ensure capital is efficiently managed and financial decisions are supported by accurate, timely cash-flow information. This role will also support our Trust Operations department, which processes settlement receipts and disbursements.

The ideal candidate is highly analytical, operationally minded, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. This person will build scalable treasury processes while remaining close to the day-to-day execution of the function.

  • Manage banking relationships, including account structures, banking services, fees, credit facilities, and ongoing relationship management.

  • Oversee cash disbursements, wires, ACH activity, transfers, and other treasury-related payment processes.

  • Assist with debt management, credit facilities, financing activities, and other capital structure initiatives.
  • Develop and maintain reporting that provides leadership with actionable insight into cash balances, liquidity, forecast accuracy, and treasury activity.
  • Identify and mitigate treasury-related risks, including fraud, counterparty, liquidity, interest-rate, and operational risks.
  • Establish scalable treasury processes that can support TopDog Law’s continued growth and expansion.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Finance, Accounting, Legal, Operations, and Executive Leadership on projects involving cash, banking, payments, and financial risk.
  • Provide analysis and recommendations to senior leadership regarding liquidity, cash management, and treasury strategy.
  • Lead, develop, and mentor treasury team members as the function grows.
  • Take ownership of special projects and other strategic financial initiatives as needed.

What You Bring

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of progressive experience in treasury, corporate finance, banking, or a closely related function.
  • Experience leading or managing a corporate treasury function in a high-growth or complex organization.
  • Strong understanding of cash management, liquidity forecasting, banking operations, and treasury controls.
  • Demonstrated experience managing banking relationships and financial institutions.
  • Experience managing IOLTA accounts and knowledge of IOLTA compliance laws.
  • Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills with the ability to build and analyze complex cash-flow models.
  • Experience with treasury management systems, banking platforms, ERP/accounting systems, or financial automation tools.

jobs.title: Jr. Salesforce Administrator / QA Tester
jobs.excerpt: Role Summary Prove Partners is consolidating two Salesforce orgs and migrating a legacy system of record into Salesforce.
jobs.description:
Role Summary
Prove Partners is consolidating two Salesforce orgs and migrating a legacy system of record into Salesforce. The program runs in continuous release cycles, and every cycle changes objects, page layouts, permission sets, flows, Apex, and integrations. Each of those changes has to be proven out end to end before it reaches production users.

We are looking for a junior Salesforce administrator (remote) who wants to spend the bulk of their time in structured, repeatable quality assurance. This person will execute full end-to-end test passes in our sandboxes, over and over, across each release: building and maintaining the test scripts, running them, logging what breaks, retesting fixes, and confirming regressions have not been introduced elsewhere.

Repetition is the job, not a side effect of it. The right candidate is someone who is genuinely comfortable running the same 200-step regression pass every sprint and catching the one step that changed — and who is methodical enough to keep the documentation accurate while doing it.

Engagement at a Glance

Working titleJunior Salesforce Administrator / QA TesterReports toDirector of Program Management & CRMLocationOffshore / nearshore, fully remoteTime zone requirementMinimum 6 hours of daily overlap with 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. US EasternCommitmentFull-time, 40 hours per weekDuration6–12 months, with option to extendEngagement typeOpen — vendor staff augmentation, individual contractor, or employer-of-recordSeniorityJunior (1–3 years); this is a hands-on execution role, not a lead role
Time zone is a hard requirement. Testing is iterative and conversational — the tester needs to be able to ask an administrator or developer a question and get an answer inside the same working session. Candidates should be located where the standard working day overlaps with US Eastern.

Key Responsibilities

End-to-end and regression testing (primary, ~60% of time)

  • Execute full end-to-end test passes across core business processes in the sandbox environments, following documented scripts, for every release cycle.
  • Run regression suites after each configuration or code change to confirm that existing functionality still behaves as expected.
  • Test across the full record lifecycle — record creation, field updates, stage and status transitions, automation firing, downstream record effects, and reporting output.
  • Retest and close out defects after fixes are deployed, and confirm the fix has not broken adjacent functionality.
  • Validate behavior after sandbox refreshes and deployments, including smoke testing of critical paths.

Test design and documentation (~20% of time)

  • Write and maintain test cases and test scripts from user stories, acceptance criteria, and process documentation.
  • Keep the test case library current as requirements change; retire cases that no longer apply and add coverage for new functionality.
  • Log defects with clear, reproducible steps, expected vs. actual results, affected records, screenshots, and severity.
  • Maintain test execution records so that release readiness can be assessed at a glance.

Test data and environment support (~10% of time)

  • Prepare and refresh test data sets, including bulk loads via Data Loader or Data Import Wizard.
  • Write basic SOQL queries to verify data state and confirm expected record changes.
  • Test across multiple user profiles and permission sets to confirm record visibility, field-level security, and sharing behave correctly for each role.

Light administrative configuration (~10% of time)

  • Perform straightforward declarative configuration under supervision — custom fields, page layouts, list views, validation rules, simple reports and dashboards.
  • Assist with user setup, permission set assignment, and access troubleshooting.
  • Support user acceptance testing cycles: prepare UAT scripts, walk business testers through them, and consolidate their feedback.

Required Qualifications

  • 1–3 years of hands-on experience in a Salesforce environment as an administrator, QA tester, business analyst, or support analyst.
  • Working knowledge of the Salesforce platform: standard and custom objects, record types, page layouts, profiles and permission sets, validation rules, and Flow.
  • Demonstrated experience executing manual test cases and logging defects in a tracked system (Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar).
  • Ability to read a user story or acceptance criteria and translate it into concrete test steps.
  • Comfort with repetitive, detail-intensive work and a track record of sustained accuracy in it.
  • Basic SOQL and comfort with Data Loader or a comparable data tool.
  • Clear written and spoken English — defect reports and test notes are read by developers and business stakeholders, so writing quality matters.
  • Availability for the required daily overlap with US Eastern business hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Salesforce Certified Administrator (ADM-201) — preferred, not required. Hands-on experience carries more weight than the credential, and we will consider candidates who are working toward it.
  • Experience testing during a data migration or multi-org consolidation.
  • Exposure to integration testing between Salesforce and external systems, including basic API concepts.
  • Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, or comparable tracking and documentation tools.
  • Any experience with test automation (Selenium, Provar, Playwright) or reading Apex test results — useful, but this role is manual-first.
  • Background in healthcare, insurance, legal services, or another regulated environment where access control and audit trails matter.

What Success Looks Like

  • By 15 days: has run a full end-to-end pass on at least one core process independently, using existing scripts, and is logging usable defects without rework.
  • By 30 days: is authoring new test cases from user stories with minimal correction, and owns the regression suite for at least one functional area.
  • By 60 days: is the reliable go-to for release readiness on their areas — the team trusts that if this person has signed off, the release is safe to deploy.
